Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high.
Let the bar settle and lower it to the thighs.
Reset your stance.
Keep the bar close to your body.

added.name: Barbell Hang Clean High Pull
added.namePl: High pull ze sztangą z zawisu
instructions: Hold a barbell just above the knees with an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips and keep your back flat.
Explode up through the legs and shrug.
Pull the bar to chest height with high elbows.
Lower to the hang position.
Reset and repeat. Keep the bar close.

added.name: Medicine Ball Overhead Toss
added.namePl: Rzut piłki lekarskiej nad głową
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball overhead.
Reach back slightly and brace your abs.
Throw the ball forward powerfully.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball and reset.
Keep your back neutral.

added.name: Medicine Ball Backward Overhead Toss
added.namePl: Rzut piłki lekarskiej nad głową w tył
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball in front of your thighs.
Squat down and swing the ball between your legs.
Drive up and extend your hips.
Throw the ball up and backward over your head.
Retrieve the ball and reset.
Keep your arms long and make sure the space behind you is clear.

added.name: Band Seated Twist
added.namePl: Skręty tułowia w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Usiądź na podłodze z nogami wyciągniętymi przed sobą i prostymi plecami.
Owiń taśmę wokół talii i trzymaj końce obiema rękami.
Napnij mięśnie brzucha i powoli skręć tułów w jedną stronę, utrzymując proste plecy i stopy na podłodze.
Zatrzymaj się na chwilę na końcu skrętu, a następnie powoli wróć do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz skręt w drugą stronę.
Kontynuuj naprzemienne wykonywanie ruchu na obie strony przez zalecaną liczbę powtórzeń.

added.name: Barbell Fat Bar Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion nachwytem ze sztangą z grubym gryfem
instructions: Hold a fat barbell with an overhand grip.
Stand with elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.

added.name: Cable Seated Single Arm Lats Focused Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w siadzie na wyciągu na najszersze grzbietu
instructions: Sit at the cable station with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall and let the arm extend with a slight stretch in the lat.
Pull your elbow down and back toward your hip, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze the lat for a moment, then slowly let the handle return.
Keep your torso still and shoulders down. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lever Isometric Squat Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Izometryczny przysiad z odwodzeniem bioder na maszynie
instructions: Set the machine pads against the outsides of your knees.
Lower into a half squat and keep your chest up.
Press your knees outward against the pads.
Hold the position steadily for the target time.
Release and stand up slowly.

added.name: Weighted Plate Lu Raise
added.namePl: Lu raise z talerzem z obciążeniem
instructions: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at thigh height.
Raise the plate out and up in a wide arc until it is about overhead.
Pause briefly, keeping your ribs down and core tight.
Lower the plate back along the same path with control.
Use a light plate and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Barbell Decline Close Grip Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie wąskim chwytem na ławce skośnej głową w dół ze sztangą
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grab the bar with hands about shoulder width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest with locked elbows.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and use a spotter.

added.name: Smith Incline Close Grip Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie wąskim chwytem na ławce skośnej na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly narrower than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pulled back.

added.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Single Arm Clean Press
added.namePl: Zarzut z wyciskaniem hantla jednorącz w półklęku
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the dumbbell on the floor by your front foot and grab it.
Pull the dumbbell up to your shoulder in one smooth motion, rotating your wrist.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Medicine Ball Overhead Slam Circle
added.namePl: Kółka z uderzeniem piłką lekarską nad głową
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball overhead.
Circle the ball to one side and around as you start to bend your knees.
Slam the ball hard into the floor in front of you.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up, and reset overhead.
Alternate the circle direction every set and keep your core braced.

added.name: Cable Lateral Step Up
added.namePl: Boczne wejście na podwyższenie na wyciągu
instructions: Stand sideways to a box with the cable handle held at your chest.
Place the near foot on the box and press through that heel.
Step up until your leg is straight and stand tall on top.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch.

added.name: Band Twisting Overhead Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę ze skrętem z gumą
instructions: Stań w rozkroku na szerokość barków i umieść taśmę pod stopami.
Trzymaj uchwyty taśmy na wysokości barków, dłonie skierowane do przodu.
Napnij mięśnie brzucha i wypchnij taśmę nad głowę, w pełni prostując ramiona.
Wypychając taśmę, skręć tułów w jedną stronę, utrzymując biodra stabilne.
Zatrzymaj się na chwilę w górnej pozycji, a następnie wróć do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz wypchnięcie ze skrętem po przeciwnej stronie.
Kontynuuj naprzemienne wykonywanie ruchu na obie strony przez zalecaną liczbę powtórzeń.

added.name: Cable Unilateral Step Up
added.namePl: Jednonóż wejście na podwyższenie na wyciągu
instructions: Face a box with the cable handle held at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel and stand up straight on the box.
Lower your trailing foot back to the floor slowly.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Standing Isometric Shoulder External Rotation with Towel
added.namePl: Izometryczna rotacja zewnętrzna barku w staniu z ręcznikiem
instructions: Stand next to a wall with a towel between the back of your hand and the wall.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Press your hand outward into the towel.
Hold the effort for 10 to 20 seconds.
Relax, then switch sides.

added.name: Band Underhand Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie podchwytem z gumą
instructions: Przymocuj taśmę do wysokiego punktu zaczepienia, takiego jak drążek do podciągania lub stabilna belka.
Stań przodem do punktu zaczepienia, stopy w rozkroku na szerokość barków.
Chwyć taśmę podchwytem, dłonie nieco szerzej niż na szerokość barków.
Wyprostuj ramiona w pełni nad głową, utrzymując łokcie lekko ugięte.
Napnij mięśnie najszersze grzbietu i ściągnij taśmę w dół w kierunku klatki piersiowej, ściskając łopatki.
Zatrzymaj się na chwilę w dolnej fazie ruchu, a następnie powoli zwolnij napięcie i wróć do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz zalecaną liczbę razy.

added.name: Standing Isometric Biceps Hold
added.namePl: Izometryczne trzymanie bicepsa w staniu
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and your elbows at your sides.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with palms facing up.
Squeeze your fists and flex your biceps hard.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows pinned, then rest and repeat.

added.name: Sitting Isometric Hamstring Curl Hold with Exercise Ball
added.namePl: Izometryczne uginanie nóg w siadzie z piłką gimnastyczną
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs out and the ball under your heels.
Lean back on your hands.
Press your heels into the ball and slide it in until knees bend.
Hold the position steadily.
Slowly extend your legs again.

added.name: Band V-up
added.namePl: V-up z gumą
instructions: Połóż się płasko na plecach z prostymi nogami i ramionami wyciągniętymi nad głową, trzymając taśmę.
Angażując mięśnie brzucha, unieś nogi oraz górną część ciała jednocześnie, sięgając dłońmi w kierunku palców stóp.
Zatrzymaj się na chwilę w górnej pozycji, a następnie powoli opuść nogi i górną część ciała z powrotem do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz zalecaną liczbę razy.

added.name: Band Vertical Pallof Press
added.namePl: Pionowe wyciskanie Pallofa z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands at the middle of your chest, with tension on it.
Brace your core and press your hands straight up overhead.
Hold briefly without letting your body turn toward the anchor.
Bring your hands back to your chest, finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Band Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków z gumą
instructions: Usiądź na ławce lub krześle, stopy płasko na podłodze.
Trzymaj taśmę obiema rękami, dłonie skierowane do góry, i oprzyj przedramiona na udach.
Powoli uginaj nadgarstki w górę, ściskając przedramiona.
Zatrzymaj się na chwilę w górnej pozycji, a następnie powoli opuść nadgarstki z powrotem do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz zalecaną liczbę razy.

added.name: Box Jump Drop 2 Foot Land
added.namePl: Zeskok z podwyższenia z lądowaniem na dwie nogi
instructions: Stand on a sturdy box with your toes near the edge.
Step off the box, do not jump.
Land on both feet at the same time with soft, bent knees.
Sink into a quarter squat to absorb the impact and hold the landing.
Step back up and repeat. Keep your knees in line with your toes.

added.name: Bodyweight Box Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad do skrzyni z masą ciała
instructions: Place a box behind you and stand with feet a bit wider than shoulders.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower toward the box.
Lightly touch the box without dropping onto it.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Band Y-raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w y z gumą
instructions: Stań w rozkroku na szerokość barków i trzymaj taśmę przed udami, dłońmi skierowanymi do wewnątrz.
Utrzymując ramiona wyprostowane, unieś je w górę i na boki, tworząc ciałem kształt litery „Y”.
Ściśnij łopatki na szczycie ruchu.
Powoli opuść ramiona z powrotem do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz odpowiednią liczbę razy.

added.name: Band Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy z gumą
instructions: Stań w rozkroku na szerokość barków i umieść taśmę pod stopami, trzymając jej końce dłońmi.
Utrzymuj ramiona proste i rozluźnione, pozwalając taśmie zwisać przed udami.
Napnij mięśnie czworoboczne, unosząc barki w górę, jak najwyżej to możliwe.
Utrzymaj napięcie przez chwilę, a następnie powoli opuść barki z powrotem do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz zalecaną liczbę razy.

added.name: Burpee over the Dumbbell
added.namePl: Burpee przez hantel
instructions: Stand beside a dumbbell lying on the floor.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump your feet back and do a push up.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Jump up and sideways over the dumbbell, landing softly.
Turn and repeat in the other direction at a steady pace.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Twist
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli przodem w staniu ze skrętem
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in both hands at thigh level.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side, turning from the ribs while your hips face forward.
Rotate back to the center and lower the dumbbell with control.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the weight light.

added.name: Resistance Band Alternating Split Stance Pallof Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne pallof press w rozkroku z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways to it in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the band straight out in front of you without letting your torso turn.
Hold for a second, then bring the hands back to your chest.
Switch which foot is forward on each set or rep and keep your hips square.

added.name: Dumbbell Bear Plank Alternating Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie naprzemienne z hantlami w podporze niedźwiedzia
instructions: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.

added.name: Dumbbell Pullover to Press Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek z pullover i wyciskaniem hantla
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the dumbbell back overhead in a pullover arc.
Pull it back over your chest and press it straight up.
Lower your hips with control and repeat, keeping your ribs down.

added.name: Jump Up Side Jump
added.namePl: Wyskok z bocznym skokiem
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly and immediately hop sideways to one side.
Land on both feet with soft knees and reset your balance.
Alternate the side of each hop and keep a steady rhythm.

added.name: Standing Bend Alternating Toe Touch
added.namePl: Naprzemienne dotykanie palców stóp w staniu
instructions: Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and arms out to the sides.
Hinge forward and twist to reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with arms out.
Reach the other hand to the opposite foot.
Keep a flat back and move at a lively pace.

added.name: Weighted Plate Deadlift Rear Lunge with Overhead Press
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z talerzem i wykrokiem w tył z wyciskaniem nad głowę
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the plate toward your shins, then stand up.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge as you press the plate overhead.
Return the foot and bring the plate back to your thighs.
Keep a flat back and repeat, alternating the lunging leg.

added.name: Landmine Single Arm Push Press
added.namePl: Push press jednorącz z landmine
instructions: Stand facing the landmine end and hold it at your shoulder with one hand.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower the end back to your shoulder with control.
Keep your ribs down and brace your core. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Clock Goblet Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad goblet zegar
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and picture a clock on the floor around you.
Step to 12 o'clock and squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and return to the center.
Step to the next position on the clock and squat again.
Work your way around the clock with control and switch direction on the next set.

added.name: Kettlebell Side Swing
added.namePl: Swing boczny z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and a kettlebell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the bell up toward chest height, angled to one side.
Let it swing back down with a flat back.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch.

added.name: Burpee Power Sled Push
added.namePl: Burpee z pchaniem sań
instructions: Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.

added.name: Barbell Half Kneeling Thor Lift
added.namePl: Thor lift ze sztangą w półklęku
instructions: Kneel on one knee holding one end of a barbell in a landmine setup near your hip.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Lift the bar diagonally across your body and up toward the opposite shoulder.
Return the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your hips square. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Shoulders Complex
added.namePl: Kompleks barków z hantlami
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Do a set of lateral raises, then straight into front raises.
Move into a set of overhead presses without putting the weights down.
Lower the dumbbells under control and rest.
Keep the weights light and your torso still throughout.

added.name: Medicine Ball Horizontal Smash
added.namePl: Poziome uderzenie piłką lekarską o podłoże
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall or rebound surface holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Wind the ball slightly away from the target.
Rotate and throw the ball hard against the wall with both hands.
Catch it, reset your stance and go again.
Use your hips and keep your core tight. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Sled Alternating Single Leg Negative Press
added.namePl: Negatywne naprzemienne wypychanie jednej nogi na suwnicy
instructions: Sit in the sled with feet on the platform and release the safety.
Press the platform up with both legs and lock out gently.
Shift the load to one leg and lower it slowly for 3-4 seconds.
Press back up with both legs.
Alternate the lowering leg each rep and never let your lower back round.

added.name: Dumbbell Cross Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Krzyżowy rumuński martwy ciąg z hantlami
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
Reach one dumbbell across toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Alternate the crossing side each rep.

added.name: Band Side Crunch
added.namePl: Skłony boczne z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and kneel or stand beside it.
Hold the band at your shoulder with the near hand.
Bend sideways toward your hip.
Return to upright under control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Band Standing Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nogi w staniu z gumą
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or one ankle and anchor it.
Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one straight leg forward to hip height.
Lower slowly.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Band Standing Rear Delt Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na tylne aktony stojąc z gumą
instructions: Stań w rozkroku na szerokość barków i umieść taśmę pod stopami.
Trzymaj uchwyty taśmy dłońmi zwróconymi do siebie, ramiona wyciągnięte przed sobą.
Ugnij lekko kolana i pochyl się do przodu w biodrach, utrzymując proste plecy.
Przyciągnij taśmę w kierunku klatki piersiowej, ściskając łopatki.
Zatrzymaj się na chwilę w górnej pozycji, a następnie powoli zwolnij napięcie i wróć do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz zalecaną liczbę razy.

added.name: Band Straight Back Stiff Leg Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg na prostych nogach z prostymi plecami z gumą
instructions: Stań w rozkroku na szerokość barków i umieść taśmę wokół górnej części nóg.
Trzymaj taśmę obiema rękami przed udami, dłonie skierowane do ciała.
Utrzymując proste plecy i lekko ugięte kolana, pochyl się w biodrach i opuść taśmę w kierunku podłogi.
Poczuj rozciąganie w mięśniach dwugłowych uda podczas opuszczania taśmy.
Napnij pośladki i mięśnie dwugłowe uda, aby unieść ciało z powrotem do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz zalecaną liczbę razy.

added.name: Assisted Single Leg Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie jednej nogi na maszynie z asystą
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Lower back with control.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Assisted Standing Triceps Dip
added.namePl: Dipy w staniu na maszynie z asystą
instructions: Set the assistance and stand on the pad holding the handles.
Keep your elbows close and your chest up.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until they are at 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move smoothly.

added.name: Lever Parallel Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie równoległe na maszynie
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit back.
Grip the handles with your elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

added.name: Lever Pec Deck Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki na maszynie butterfly
instructions: Sit on the pec deck with your back flat and the arms at chest level.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze for a moment, then open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.

added.name: Lever Standing Hip Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie biodra w staniu na maszynie
instructions: Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Lever Alternate Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Naprzemienne uginanie ramion na maszynie
instructions: Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grab the handles.
Curl one handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower it slowly while curling the other arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid swinging.

added.name: Plank Jump in Squat
added.namePl: Skok z deski do przysiadu
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet forward, landing outside your hands in a wide squat.
Stand or hop up briefly if you like, then lower your hands.
Jump your feet back to the plank.
Keep a tight core and land softly.

added.name: Kettlebell Strong Russian Twist
added.namePl: Mocny russian twist z kettlebellem
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Rotate your torso to bring the bell beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side in a smooth motion.
Keep your chest lifted and feet raised for more challenge.

added.name: Lever Belt Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski na maszynie z pasem
instructions: Set up in the belt squat machine and place your back foot on the bench behind you.
Stand tall with the front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Kroc Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie kroc z hantlem
instructions: Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lever Triceps Extension V. 2
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion na maszynie v. 2
instructions: Sit and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Return slowly without lifting your shoulders.

added.name: Dumbbell Powell Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie powell z hantlem
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with the arm hanging in front of your body.
Raise the arm out and back in an arc until it is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Use a light weight and switch sides after your set.

added.name: Resistance Band Weighted Standing Pronation Twist Curl (Arm Wrestler)
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z gumą ze skrętem nachwytem w staniu (siłowanie na ręce)
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handle with your palm turned to the side.
Curl the handle up while rotating your wrist.
Finish with your palm facing you and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly and untwist back to the start.
Keep your elbow tucked. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lever Side Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie nogi w bok na maszynie
instructions: Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Superman Pulse
added.namePl: Pulsowanie superman
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower and rest after your set.

added.name: Lever Side Hip Adduction
added.namePl: Przywodzenie nogi w bok na maszynie
instructions: Stand next to the machine with the inner side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Pull your leg across your body, squeezing your inner thigh.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Lever Standing Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nogi w staniu na maszynie
instructions: Stand facing the machine with your hands on the support.
Place the front of your thigh against the pad.
Raise your leg forward until the thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your torso tall. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Resistance Band Sitting Floor Tibialis Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie piszczeli w siadzie na podłodze z gumą
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out and loop a band around your foot, anchored in front.
Keep your leg straight and your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin against the band.
Hold briefly, then slowly release.
Do all reps on one foot, then switch.

added.name: Kettlebell Sitting Tibialis Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie piszczeli w siadzie z kettlebellem
instructions: Sit on a bench or box with a kettlebell hanging from the top of one foot.
Plant your heel on the floor.
Lift the toes up toward your shin to raise the kettlebell.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Use a light weight. Finish the reps, then switch feet.

added.name: Lever Standing Rear Kick
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie nogi w tył w staniu na maszynie
instructions: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Lever Chair Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad na krześle na maszynie
instructions: Position yourself in the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit back and down.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Weighted Sandbag Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z workiem z piaskiem z obciążeniem
instructions: Stand over a sandbag with feet hip width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the bag.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall with the bag.
Push your hips back and lower the bag to the floor.
Keep your back flat throughout.

added.name: Weighted Sandbag Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z workiem z piaskiem z obciążeniem
instructions: Hold a sandbag in a bear hug against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
Keep the bag tight to your body.

added.name: Weighted Sandbag Shouldering
added.namePl: Zarzut worka z piaskiem na bark z obciążeniem
instructions: Stand over a sandbag and grip it firmly with both hands.
Lift the bag, driving through your legs and hips.
Pull it to your lap, then heave it up onto one shoulder.
Lower it to the floor with control.
Alternate shoulders each rep.

added.name: Weighted Sandbag Carry (Shoulders)
added.namePl: Przenoszenie worka z piaskiem na barkach z obciążeniem
instructions: Lift the sandbag onto your shoulders and hold it there.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Carry for a set distance or time, then set the bag down carefully.

added.name: Weighted Sandbag Carry (Bear Hug)
added.namePl: Przenoszenie worka z piaskiem w objęciu z obciążeniem
instructions: Lift the sandbag and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady steps.
Keep your arms squeezing the bag tight.
Carry for a set distance or time, then lower the bag with care.

added.name: Weighted Sandbag Military Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie żołnierskie z workiem z piaskiem z obciążeniem
instructions: Hold a sandbag at your upper chest or shoulders.
Stand with feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Press the bag straight overhead.
Lock out the arms, then lower the bag with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Weighted Sandbag Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie z workiem z piaskiem z obciążeniem
instructions: Stand over a sandbag, hinge forward and grab it with both hands.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Row the bag toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly back to full arm extension.

added.name: Lever Full Squat
added.namePl: Pełny przysiad na maszynie
instructions: Step into the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.

added.name: Lever Pistol Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad pistolet na maszynie
instructions: Step into the machine and put one foot on the platform with the other leg lifted or extended.
Brace your core and release the safety.
Lower slowly into a deep squat on one leg.
Press through your heel to stand.
Keep your knee in line with your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Lever Lying Chest Press (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Wyciskanie w leżeniu na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.

added.name: Steel Mace Squat (Weighted)
added.namePl: Przysiad z maczugą stalową (z obciążeniem)
instructions: Rest the mace on your shoulders and hold it with both hands.
Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

added.name: Steel Mace Halo (Weighted)
added.namePl: Halo z maczugą stalową (z obciążeniem)
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and hold the mace upright near your chest.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Circle the mace around your head in a smooth, controlled arc.
Keep your elbows close and your head still.
Do all reps, then reverse the direction.

added.name: Weighted Lying Neck Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie szyi w leżeniu z obciążeniem
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.

added.name: Sandbag over the Shoulder Toss (Weighted)
added.namePl: Rzut worka z piaskiem przez ramię (z obciążeniem)
instructions: Stand over the sandbag with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bag and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bag up the front of your body.
Extend fully and throw the bag back over your shoulder.
Reset and repeat, facing the same way.

added.name: Weighted Lying Neck Flexion
added.namePl: Zginanie szyi w leżeniu z obciążeniem
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on your forehead.
Hold the weight with a hand for control.
Slowly curl your head up, tucking your chin.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and avoid jerking.

added.name: Cable Single Arm Low Row (With Rope)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz nisko na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit facing the stack with your feet braced.
Hold the rope in one hand with your arm extended.
Pull your elbow back along your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause, then let the arm extend slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Two Ropes Climb
added.namePl: Wspinanie po dwóch linach
instructions: Grab one rope in each hand and hang with arms long.
Pull up with one arm while you bend your elbow close to your body.
Reach higher with the other hand and pull again.
Keep your core tight and your legs steady.
Climb to a safe height, then lower under control.

added.name: Barbell Seated Military Press (Inside Squat Cage)
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi nad głowę w siadzie (w klatce do przysiadów)
instructions: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.

added.name: Cable Close Grip Front Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka wąskim chwytem do przodu na wyciągu
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Rear Lateral Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla w bok w tył jednorącz w leżeniu v. 2
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: One Leg Kickback (With Bench Support)
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie jednonóż (z podparciem o ławkę)
instructions: Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Smith Calf Raise (With Block)
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce na maszynie smitha (na podwyższeniu)
instructions: Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

added.name: Cable Reverse Narrow Grip Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka odwrotnym wąskim chwytem na wyciągu
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs.
Grab the bar with a narrow underhand grip.
Lean back a little and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

added.name: Seated Single Leg Tibialis Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie piszczeli jednonóż w siadzie
instructions: Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Single Leg Knee Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie jednej nogi w kolanie w staniu z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around one ankle or behind the knee.
Stand tall and hold on for balance if needed.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Pause with the leg extended.
Bend slowly back, then switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Weighted Seated Single Leg Knee Extension V. 2
added.namePl: Prostowanie jednej nogi w kolanie w siadzie z obciążeniem v. 2
instructions: Strap a light ankle weight on and sit tall on a chair.
Hold the seat edge for support.
Straighten the knee until your leg is level.
Hold for a second and squeeze your thigh.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Lying Bent Knee Tibialis Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie piszczeli w leżeniu z ugiętym kolanem
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one foot under the other for light resistance.
Lift the toes of the lower foot toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

added.name: Standing Single Leg Concentration Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż w staniu z koncentracją
instructions: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Elevated Single Leg Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy jednonóż z podwyższeniem
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Lying Floor Svend Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie svenda w leżeniu na podłodze
instructions: Lie on your back holding a plate between your palms at your chest.
Squeeze the plate firmly.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep squeezing as you lower it back to your chest.
Repeat with steady control.

added.name: Medicine Ball Split Stance Torso Twist
added.namePl: Skręty tułowia w rozkroku z piłką lekarską
instructions: Stand in a split stance and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips steady.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Complete all reps, then switch the front foot.

added.name: Resistance Band Overhead Hit
added.namePl: Uderzenie gumą nad głową
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handles with both hands.
Stand with a staggered stance and your arms raised.
Pull the handles down and forward in a controlled hit.
Brace your core as you finish.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Plank Alternating Hit the Ball
added.namePl: Deska z naprzemiennym uderzaniem piłki
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with a ball in front of you.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the ball.
Return the hand and tap with the other.
Keep your hips as still as possible.

added.name: Medicine Ball Sit Up Slam
added.namePl: Brzuszki z uderzeniem piłką lekarską
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up in one motion, bringing the ball forward.
Slam the ball down in front of your feet.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up.
Lie back with control and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Full Front Raise Catch
added.namePl: Pełne unoszenie hantli przodem z chwytem
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it straight up in front of you to overhead.
Control it at the top and keep your core braced.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a moderate weight and avoid arching your back.

added.name: Barbell Bench Press Catch
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi na ławce z chwytem
instructions: Lie on a bench with a spotter or safety pins set.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chest under control.
Stop it just above the chest and press up.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pinched.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift Pass
added.namePl: Podanie kettlebella w martwym ciągu jednonóż
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Ipsilateral Reverse Lunge High Knee
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z wysokim kolanem po tej samej stronie z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Lower into a lunge.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Barbell Lying Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie sztangi przodem w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell at arm's length over your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a soft elbow.
Raise the bar in an arc until it is above your chest.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a light weight and keep your back flat.

added.name: Resistance Band Seated Single Leg Hugging Knee Flexion
added.namePl: Przyciąganie kolana jednonóż w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with a band around one foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Pull the knee up and bend it toward your chest.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Incline Jack Plank
added.namePl: Deska skośna z rozkrokiem
instructions: Place your hands on a bench in an incline plank.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and the pace steady.

added.name: Resistance Band Lateral Hit
added.namePl: Boczne uderzenie gumą
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Keep your hips square throughout.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Medicine Ball Pullover Catch
added.namePl: Pullover z piłką lekarską z chwytem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Pull the ball forward over your chest to throw it up toward a partner or wall.
Catch the ball with soft elbows as it returns.
Let it travel back overhead in a controlled arc.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.

added.name: Cable 90 Degrees Internal Rotation Catch
added.namePl: Rotacja wewnętrzna 90 stopni na wyciągu z chwytem
instructions: Set the cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Raise your upper arm out to the side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
Let the cable pull your forearm back into external rotation.
Catch it, then rotate the forearm forward and down smoothly.
Keep your upper arm still and level.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Medicine Ball Lying Floor Close Press Catch
added.namePl: Wyciskanie wąskim chwytem w leżeniu na podłodze z piłką lekarską z chwytem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball above your chest.
Press the ball up quickly with your hands close together.
Catch it as it comes down with soft elbows.
Lower it to just above your chest.
Keep your back flat and ribs down.
Repeat for controlled, crisp reps.

added.name: Barbell One Leg Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż ze sztangą
instructions: Set your upper back on a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend one leg or hold it bent in the air.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top without twisting.
Lower under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Weighted One Leg Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż z obciążeniem
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench and place the weight on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly.
Complete the reps, then change legs.

added.name: Barbell Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo ze sztangą
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.
Brace your core and sit down between your legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to thigh level or lower, then push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

added.name: Glute Ham Developer Full Sit Up
added.namePl: Pełne brzuszki na maszynie ghd
instructions: Lock your feet in the machine and sit with your hips on the pad.
Lean back until your torso is in line with or just below your hips.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up until your chest reaches your thighs.
Lower back slowly with a braced core.
Avoid yanking on your neck.

added.name: Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands together at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back between your legs.
Keep your knees over your toes and chest upright.
Lower to thigh level.
Push through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

added.name: Lever Incline Prone Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na skosie w leżeniu przodem na maszynie
instructions: Lie chest-down on the incline pad and grab the handles.
Let your arms extend fully.
Pull the handles back, driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your head neutral.

added.name: Lying Hip Lift (On Stability Ball)
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder w leżeniu (na piłce gimnastycznej)
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels resting on the stability ball.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips under control.
Keep the ball steady throughout.

added.name: Resistance Band Explosive Push Up
added.namePl: Wybuchowa pompka z gumą
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your palms.
Set up in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest to the floor with control.
Push up hard so your hands briefly leave the floor.
Land softly with elbows slightly bent.
Keep your hips in line.

added.name: Band Standing on Bosu Ball Single Leg Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie jednonóż na piłce bosu z gumą
instructions: Place a band around your ankles and stand on the bosu with one foot.
Hold your core tight and stay tall.
Lift your free leg out to the side against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Return slowly without leaning.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Resistance Band Assisted Single Arm Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie jednorącz z gumą wspomagającą
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding your wrist or the band.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving the elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Switch arms after each set.

added.name: Ring Resistance Band Assisted Single Arm Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie jednorącz na kółkach z gumą wspomagającą
instructions: Hang a band from the rings or bar and place your foot in it.
Grip one ring with one hand and hold the other ring loosely or let it go.
Pull your chest toward the ring.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Repeat, then switch sides.

added.name: Ring Rocky Pull Up Pulldown
added.namePl: Podciąganie i ściąganie rocky na kółkach
instructions: Hang from the rings with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest up toward the rings.
At the top, drive the rings down toward your hips.
Pause with your arms close to your sides.
Return to the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Planche Press
added.namePl: Planche press
instructions: Start in a deep planche lean with hands under your shoulders.
Protract your shoulders and squeeze your glutes.
Lean forward and lift your feet from the floor.
Press into the ground and hold the position.
Lower under control.
Warm up your wrists first.

added.name: Elbow Planche
added.namePl: Planche na łokciach
instructions: Place your hands on the floor and tuck your elbows into your waist.
Lean forward over your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor one at a time.
Hold your body level with a tight core.
Keep your shoulders pressed forward.
Lower down after the hold.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Single Arm Horizontal Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie poziome jednorącz w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back along your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Extend the arm slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Band Kneeling Single Arm Horizontal Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie poziome jednorącz w klęku z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the band with one hand and keep your torso upright.
Pull the elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade in.
Return slowly against the tension.
Switch arms after the set.

added.name: Lever Stack Seated Incline Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na skosie w siadzie na maszynie z wagą
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height.
Sit back with your feet flat and shoulder blades pinched.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly to a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

added.name: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown V. 3
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the bar.
Hinge slightly forward.
Pull the bar down to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

added.name: Lever Stack Seated Incline Single Arm Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz na skosie w siadzie na maszynie z wagą
instructions: Sit on the machine and grab one handle at upper-chest height.
Brace your core to avoid twisting.
Press the handle forward and up.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder pulled back.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lever Stack Seated Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie w siadzie na maszynie z wagą
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest.
Sit back and pull your shoulder blades together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause without locking out.
Return slowly to a gentle chest stretch.
Keep your feet flat.

added.name: Lever Stack Seated Single Arm Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz w siadzie na maszynie z wagą
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Brace your core and keep your torso square.
Press the handle forward in a smooth line.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder down.
Do the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

added.name: Kettlebell Back Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad ze sztangą z kettlebellem na plecach
instructions: Hold the kettlebell behind your neck on your upper back with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back.
Lower to parallel while keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows pointing down.

added.name: Landmine Squat Jump
added.namePl: Przysiad ze skokiem z landmine
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest.
Jump up explosively through your feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

added.name: Weighted Backpack Walking
added.namePl: Marsz z obciążonym plecakiem
instructions: Put on a backpack and tighten the straps snug.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk at a steady pace on flat ground.
Take natural strides and breathe evenly.
Keep your core lightly braced.
Walk for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.

added.name: Weighted Backpack Running
added.namePl: Bieg z obciążonym plecakiem
instructions: Strap a snug backpack with a modest load on your back.
Start with an easy jog on flat ground.
Keep your torso tall and your steps light.
Maintain a pace where you can breathe steadily.
Cut back the load if your form suffers.
Run for 10-20 minutes.

added.name: Cable Kickback V. 3
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Hinge forward and hold a handle with elbow bent.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm back.
Squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly and switch sides.

added.name: Cable Twist V. 3
added.namePl: Skręty tułowia na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand sideways to the pulley and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the stack.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

added.name: Suspender Arm Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows to pull yourself up.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Suspender Bent Knee Inverted Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie odwrócone z ugiętymi kolanami na pasach
instructions: Lie under the straps and grip the handles.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Lift your hips and pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Weight Plate Lying Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z talerzem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Hold the plate on your chest.
Curl your shoulders up.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Suspender Chest Dip
added.namePl: Dipy na pasach
instructions: Support yourself on the straps with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep the straps steady.

added.name: Aquabike
added.namePl: Aquabike
instructions: Stand in chest-deep water, holding the pool edge.
Lift your knees alternately.
Pedal at a steady rhythm.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for several minutes.

added.name: Suspender Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na pasach
instructions: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles at chest level.
Lean forward in a straight line.
Press your body away.
Squeeze the chest.
Return slowly.

added.name: Weighted Sandbag Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Rumuński martwy ciąg z workiem z piaskiem z obciążeniem
instructions: Hold a sandbag in front of your thighs with a firm grip.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your back flat.

added.name: L Sit Rope Climb
added.namePl: Wspinanie po linie w l-sit
instructions: Grip the rope and hang with your legs raised in front of you.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Pull with one hand over the other while staying in the L position.
Reach up and repeat.
Lower under control.
Stop if your legs drop.

added.name: Side to Side Jump over Stepbox
added.namePl: Skoki z boku na bok przez stopień
instructions: Stand beside a low box with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms.
Jump sideways over the box.
Land softly on both feet.
Jump back the other way at once.
Keep the pace fast but controlled.

added.name: Hanging Alternating Knee Raise
added.namePl: Naprzemienne unoszenie kolan w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and lift the other knee.
Avoid swinging.
Alternate for the reps.

added.name: Box Jump Through the Arms
added.namePl: Wyskok na skrzynię przez ręce
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump onto the box, driving your arms through.
Land softly with both feet.
Stand tall at the top.
Step down and reset.

added.name: Suspender Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki na pasach
instructions: Face away from the anchor, hands at chest level.
Lean forward with arms together.
Open your arms wide.
Pull back together.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

added.name: Kneeling to Box Jump
added.namePl: Wyskok na skrzynię z klęku
instructions: Kneel in front of a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and drive your hips forward.
Pop up from your knees onto your feet.
Jump onto the box in one motion.
Land softly and stand tall.
Step down and reset.

added.name: Resistance Band Seated Single Leg Knee Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie jednej nogi w kolanie w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Sit on a bench and secure a band around one ankle.
Anchor the other end behind you.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Squeeze the front of your thigh at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.

added.name: Quick Feet in Out Run
added.namePl: Szybkie kroki biegowe do środka i na zewnątrz
instructions: Stand tall with feet together.
Jog in place.
Quickly move your feet in and out.
Stay light on your toes.
Continue for the set time.

added.name: Walk Leg Kick
added.namePl: Marsz z wymachem nogi
instructions: Stand tall.
Step forward and kick the opposite leg up.
Alternate legs.
Swing your arms.
Continue for the set time.

added.name: Suspender Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion przodem na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms down.
Keep your body straight.
Raise your arms overhead.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Calf Jump
added.namePl: Skoki na łydkach
instructions: Stand tall.
Keep knees nearly straight.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly.
Repeat quickly.

added.name: Resistance Band Seated Knee Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie kolan w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with a band looped around your foot and anchored low.
Hold the seat edge and brace your core.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the foot slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Leg Calf Jump
added.namePl: Skoki na łydkach jednonóż
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Rebound right away into the next hop.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Leg Calf Jump Step Box Supported
added.namePl: Skoki na łydkach jednonóż z podparciem na skrzyni
instructions: Stand beside a step box and rest a hand lightly on it for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Hop up using mostly your ankle and calf.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Keep the hops small and quick.
Switch legs after your set.

added.name: Calf Forward Jump
added.namePl: Skoki na łydkach do przodu
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Push off the balls of your feet and hop forward a short distance.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Hop back or turn around and repeat.
Stay light and quick through the whole set.

added.name: Calf Side to Side Jump
added.namePl: Skoki na łydkach z boku na bok
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Spring off your toes and hop to one side.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop to the other side.
Keep your chest up and hips level.
Continue alternating for the set.

added.name: Medicine Ball Skater Hop
added.namePl: Skoki łyżwiarza z piłką lekarską
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Hop sideways onto one leg.
Land softly with a bent knee.
Pause briefly, then push off to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
Alternate for the reps.

added.name: Suspension Hamstring Runner
added.namePl: Biegacz na pasach (dwugłowy uda)
instructions: Lie on your back with both heels in the straps and lift your hips.
Press your arms into the floor for balance.
Curl one heel toward your glutes while the other leg extends.
Switch legs in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your hips high and level.
Continue for the set.

added.name: Resistance Band Toe Walk
added.namePl: Chód na palcach z gumą
instructions: Place a band around your forefeet or ankles.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk for 20-30 steps.

added.name: Resistance Band Toe Side Walk
added.namePl: Boczny chód na palcach z gumą
instructions: Place a band around your ankles.
Rise onto your toes with knees slightly bent.
Step sideways in small steps.
Keep tension on the band.
Do not let your heels drop.
Walk one way, then back.

added.name: Toe Side Walk
added.namePl: Boczny chód na palcach
instructions: Stand tall and rise onto your toes.
Bend your knees slightly.
Step sideways with small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk one way, then return.

added.name: Lever Seated Single Leg Curl (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Uginanie jednej nogi w siadzie na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit on the machine and set the pad above your ankle.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl one leg down and back.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Sled Lying Single Leg Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż w leżeniu na saniach
instructions: Lie back on the sled with one foot on the platform.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knee and lower the sled toward you.
Stop before your lower back lifts.
Push through your heel to extend the leg.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Suspension Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie nogi na pasach
instructions: Put one foot in a strap and stand tall on the other leg, holding the anchor for balance.
Brace your core.
Sweep the strapped leg out to the side.
Pause briefly at the end.
Bring it back under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Suspension Hip Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy na pasach
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly without touching down.
Repeat for reps.

added.name: Lying Neck Flexion
added.namePl: Zginanie szyi w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Relax your shoulders.
Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
Keep the motion small and smooth.

added.name: Lying Neck Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie szyi w leżeniu
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead hanging near the edge of a bench or resting just off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your head a few centimeters, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Use small, controlled reps.

added.name: Suspension Hyperextension
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja na pasach
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and lie face down, hands behind your head or across your chest.
Brace your core.
Lift your chest by extending your back and hips.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Lower slowly.
Avoid overarching at the top.

added.name: Suspension Inverted Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie odwrócone na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended and body straight.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control to full arm extension.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

added.name: Suspension Jackknife Pike
added.namePl: Scyzoryk z piką na pasach
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your hips high toward the ceiling.
Roll to an inverted V shape.
Lower back to plank slowly.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Wrist Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja nadgarstka z hantlem
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back.
Move slowly with control.
Switch arms.

added.name: 4 Way Single Leg Hop V. 2
added.namePl: Skoki jednonóż w 4 kierunkach v. 2
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then out to the side and back.
Hop in the fourth direction.
Stick every landing.
Switch legs.

added.name: Split Stance Single Leg Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż w rozkroku
instructions: Stand in a split stance, front foot flat and back toes lightly touching the floor.
Keep most weight on the front leg.
Rise onto the ball of the front foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower the heel slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Suspension Jackknife
added.namePl: Scyzoryk na pasach
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull your knees toward your chest by rolling your hips up.
Pause briefly.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Balance Bent Leg Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie zgiętej nogi w staniu z gumą w równowadze
instructions: Place a band around your ankles or knees.
Balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Bend the other knee and lift it out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Suspension Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg na pasach
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high.
Extend your legs slowly.
Repeat for reps.

added.name: Suspension Mountain Climber
added.namePl: Wspinaczka na pasach
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs in a quick running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the set.

added.name: Dumbbell Lu Raise
added.namePl: Lu raise z hantlami
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms upward so the dumbbells point to the ceiling.
Pause, then lower back down the same path with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid shrugging.

added.name: Standing Floor Tibialis Raise Wall Supported
added.namePl: Unoszenie palców stóp w staniu z podparciem o ścianę
instructions: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.

added.name: Suspension Power Pull
added.namePl: Power pull na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull explosively with your arms and back.
Bring your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

added.name: Cable Side Leg Kick from Back
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie nogi w bok z tyłu na wyciągu
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Kick the working leg out and slightly behind you, keeping the knee mostly straight.
Pause, then return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your torso still. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Weighted Ball Reverse Hyperextension on Ghd
added.namePl: Odwrotna hiperekstensja z piłką z obciążeniem na ghd
instructions: Lie face down on the GHD with hips at the edge and a ball between your feet.
Hold the pad.
Lift your legs until they line up with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Deadlift Against Ball
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg jednonóż z piłką o ścianę z masą ciała
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a ball between your hand and the wall.
Lift one foot slightly.
Hinge at the hip as the free leg extends back.
Keep your back flat.
Return to standing.
Switch legs after the set.

added.name: Smith Seated Single Arm Neutral Grip Shoulders Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę jednorącz chwytem neutralnym w siadzie na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set a bench under the smith bar and sit upright with your back supported.
Hold the bar with one hand in a neutral grip and unhook it.
Press the bar overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower it slowly to around chin height.
Keep your torso steady. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

added.name: High Box Step Up
added.namePl: Wejście na wysokie podwyższenie
instructions: Stand facing a high box.
Place one foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Switch leading legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Romanian Deadlift on Bench
added.namePl: Rumuński martwy ciąg jednonóż z hantlem na ławce
instructions: Hold dumbbells with your rear foot resting on a bench.
Keep your front knee soft.
Hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the weights along your leg.
Squeeze your glutes to stand up.
Switch legs after the set.

added.name: Lever Bent over Single Arm Lats Focused Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w opadzie na najszersze grzbietu na maszynie
instructions: Set the machine and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Grip the handle with one hand and let the arm reach forward.
Pull the elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Lever Incline Prone Neutral Grip Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie chwytem neutralnym na skosie w leżeniu przodem na maszynie
instructions: Lie face down on the incline pad with your chest supported.
Grip the neutral handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Bosu Ball Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad na piłce bosu
instructions: Stand on the Bosu with feet shoulder width apart.
Hold your arms forward.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż na piłce bosu
instructions: Stand on one foot on the Bosu.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower into a controlled squat.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up.
Switch legs after the set.

added.name: Suspension Pull Through
added.namePl: Pull through na pasach
instructions: Face away from the anchor, holding the handles between your legs.
Step forward to create tension.
Hinge at the hips and let your hands pass between your legs.
Drive your hips forward.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your back flat.

added.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge Walk
added.namePl: Marsz w mostku biodrowym z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step your feet out and in sideways.
Keep the band tight.
Keep your hips high.
Lower after the set.

added.name: Weighted Plate Crunch (Hands Overhead)
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z talerzem (ręce nad głową)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a plate with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching the plate upward.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without dropping your head back.

added.name: Dumbbell Weighted Crunch (Hands Overhead)
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z hantlem (ręce nad głową)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold one dumbbell upright with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, driving the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Weighted Plate 45 Degrees Side Bend
added.namePl: Skłony boczne z talerzem pod kątem 45 stopni
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench or hyperextension frame, side-on, feet secured.
Hold a plate against your chest.
Lower your torso sideways with control.
Bend back up until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid twisting. Finish your reps and switch sides.

added.name: Weighted Plate Crunch (Hands Overhead) V. 2
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z talerzem (ręce nad głową) v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted.
Hold a plate with straight arms overhead.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor.
Keep your arms by your ears as you rise.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.

added.name: Weighted Dumbbell Crunch (Hands Overhead) V. 2
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z hantlem (ręce nad głową) v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell at one end with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Crunch up and let the dumbbell travel in an arc toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Suspension Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie na pasach
instructions: Hang from the handles with arms extended.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up between the handles.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Kneeling Plyo Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka plyo w klęku
instructions: Kneel in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.

added.name: Elastic Bed Toe Jump
added.namePl: Skoki na palcach na trampolinie
instructions: Stand on the elastic bed with feet together.
Rise onto your toes.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Stay quick and light.
Continue for the set.

added.name: Resistance Band Lying Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie nogi w leżeniu z gumą
instructions: Loop a band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side.
Stack your hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lift the top knee or leg away from the bottom one against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch sides.

added.name: Suspension Reverse Fly
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Do not shrug.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy jednorącz z hantlem
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulder straight up toward your ear.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch arms.

added.name: Eccentric Single Arm Pull Up
added.namePl: Ekscentryczne podciąganie jednorącz
instructions: Get into the top position of a pull-up, with one hand on the bar and the other assisting or at rest.
Let go of any help and shift your weight onto the working arm.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arm is straight.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Step back up to the top and repeat, then switch arms.

added.name: Resistance Band Assisted Single Arm Pull Up V. 2
added.namePl: Podciąganie jednorącz z gumą wspomagającą v. 2
instructions: Hang a band from the bar and place a foot or knee in the loop.
Grip the bar with one hand and keep the other arm across your chest.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving your elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower under control. Finish your reps and switch arms.

added.name: Hamstring Bridge V. 2
added.namePl: Mostek na dwugłowe uda v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, a bit further from your hips.
Press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Hamstring Bridge Leg Kick V. 2
added.namePl: Mostek na dwugłowe uda z odkopnięciem nogi v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Straighten one leg out in front, keeping hips level.
Bring the foot back to the floor without dropping your hips.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

added.name: Suspension Rollout
added.namePl: Rollout na pasach
instructions: Kneel holding the handles close to your chest.
Brace your core.
Push your arms forward as you lean out.
Keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Do not let your hips sag.

added.name: Lying Single Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie jednej nogi w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Straighten the other leg and tighten the thigh.
Raise it to the height of your bent knee.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch legs.

added.name: Bodyweight Quarter Squat
added.namePl: Ćwierć przysiad z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees a short way.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Press through your feet to stand tall.
Repeat at a steady pace.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Deadlift Hold
added.namePl: Trzymanie martwego ciągu jednonóż z masą ciała
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward from the hips as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold for several seconds, hips level.
Return upright and switch legs.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Deadlift Toe Touch
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg jednonóż z dotknięciem palców stopy z masą ciała
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward as the free leg lifts behind you.
Reach your hands toward the toes of the standing foot.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Stand back up with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

added.name: Resistance Band Seated Single Leg Knee Extension Hold
added.namePl: Trzymanie wyprostu jednej nogi w kolanie w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Sit on a chair with a band anchored around one ankle behind you.
Straighten that knee against the band.
Hold the leg straight for 10-20 seconds.
Keep the thigh tight and your back upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

added.name: Two to One Leg Jump
added.namePl: Skok z dwóch nóg na jedną
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and land on one foot.
