Absorb the landing with a bent knee and hold steady.
Reset and alternate landing legs.

added.name: Standing Wall Slide Quarter Squat Hold
added.namePl: Trzymanie ćwierć przysiadu ze ślizgiem po ścianie w staniu
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees bend about a quarter of the way.
Keep your back flat to the wall.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Slide back up.

added.name: Suspension Self Assisted Chest Dip
added.namePl: Dipy z asystą własnych nóg na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Lean your chest forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders down.

added.name: Suspension Self Assisted Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie z asystą własnych nóg na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with feet on the floor.
Lean back.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Use your legs for light help.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

added.name: Scapular Pull Up Swing
added.namePl: Huśtanie łopatek w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.
Swing your body forward and back in a small arc.
Keep the motion controlled.
Lower to a full hang and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Straight Arm Bicep Swing
added.namePl: Huśtanie hantla na prostych ramionach (biceps)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Swing the dumbbells forward and up in a controlled arc.
Lower them back down.
Keep your torso still and avoid momentum.

added.name: Suspension Self Assisted Triceps Dip
added.namePl: Dipy tricepsowe z asystą własnych nóg na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows close.

added.name: Ring Long Arms Push Up Hold
added.namePl: Pompka na prostych ramionach na kółkach w pozycji statycznej
instructions: Set the rings low and take a plank with your hands on them.
Keep your arms straight and rings close to your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and abs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor to rest.

added.name: L Sit Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg w l-sit
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands on parallettes or flat beside you.
Press down to lift your hips.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Raise your legs higher and lower them back to the L position.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders down.

added.name: Suspension Shoulder External Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja zewnętrzna barku na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Lean back slightly.
Rotate your forearms outward and upward.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Return slowly.
Keep the motion small.

added.name: Suspension Side Bend
added.namePl: Skłony boczne na pasach
instructions: Hold a handle and stand sideways to the anchor.
Brace your core.
Bend sideways away from the anchor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
Keep your hips still.

added.name: Dumbbell Hyperextension V. 2
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja z hantlem v. 2
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Lift until you are in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.
Do not overextend.

added.name: Suspension Side Bridge
added.namePl: Podpór boczny na pasach
instructions: Lie on your side with feet in the straps and your elbow below your shoulder.
Lift your hips.
Hold a straight line.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Jump Box
added.namePl: Skok na skrzynię z hantlami
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top.
Step down carefully and reset.

added.name: Dumbbell Kneeling to Jump Box
added.namePl: Skok na skrzynię z klęku z hantlami
instructions: Kneel in front of a box holding dumbbells at your sides.
Swing your arms and drive up to your feet.
Jump onto the box, landing softly.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully and reset to kneeling.

added.name: Tuck Planche on Parallette
added.namePl: Tuck planche na poręczach parallette
instructions: Place your hands on parallettes and squat down.
Lean forward over your hands, arms straight.
Lift your feet with knees tucked toward the chest.
Hold for a few seconds, rounding your upper back slightly.
Lower your feet gently.

added.name: Suspension Single Leg Split Squat (Self Assisted)
added.namePl: Wykrok jednonóż z asystą własnych nóg na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and place your back foot behind you.
Stand tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Use your arms for light help.
Press up through your front heel.
Switch legs.

added.name: Forward and Backward Crab Walk
added.namePl: Chód kraba w przód i w tył
instructions: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Keep your chest open and hips high.
Walk forward with alternating hands and feet.
Then walk backward the same way.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Wall Assisted Handstand to Tuck Planche Negative
added.namePl: Negatywne przejście ze stania na rękach przy ścianie do tuck planche
instructions: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on the wall.
Brace your core and keep your arms straight.
Slowly lower your body forward.
Tuck your knees as you reach the planche position.
Control the descent and then reset.

added.name: Wall Facing Single Leg Split Handstand Hold
added.namePl: Trzymanie szpagatu w staniu na rękach jednonóż przodem do ściany
instructions: Kick up into a handstand facing the wall.
Keep your arms straight and push the floor away.
Lift one leg off the wall.
Hold for 10-20 seconds with control.
Return the leg and come down safely.

added.name: Suspension Single Leg Split Squat
added.namePl: Wykrok jednonóż na pasach
instructions: Put your rear foot in the strap and step forward.
Stand tall.
Lower your hips, back knee down.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Press up.
Switch legs.

added.name: Suspension Single Leg Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward.
Sit back and lower.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Stand up.
Switch legs.

added.name: Hip Lift Low Back Off Floor
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder bez podparcia lędźwi
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips so your lower back comes off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Avoid swinging.

added.name: Dumbbell Underhand Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli przodem podchwytem
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows slightly soft.
Raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Scapular Pull Up V. 2
added.namePl: Podciąganie łopatek w zwisie v. 2
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let your shoulders relax up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift your body a few centimetres.
Keep your elbows locked straight the whole time.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to the full hang.

added.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Single Arm Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantla nad głowę jednorącz w półklęku
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is extended.
Lower it under control back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Single Arm Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantla nad głowę jednorącz w klęku
instructions: Kneel on both knees with your hips tall and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder without leaning sideways.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Suspension Straight Hip Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg z prostymi biodrami na pasach
instructions: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Curl your heels toward you.
Keep your hips high.
Extend slowly.
Repeat.

added.name: Suspension Triceps Dip
added.namePl: Dipy tricepsowe na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight.
Keep your body upright.
Lower by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows close.
Press back up.
Stay controlled.

added.name: Suspension Triceps Extension V. 2
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion na pasach v. 2
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward.
Keep your elbows bent and by your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep your body straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows still.

added.name: Lying Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie nogi w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your lower arm and keep your hips stacked.
Lift your top leg up and slightly back without rolling your torso.
Pause at the top, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then roll over and do the other side.

added.name: Seated Bent Knee Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie zgiętych kolan w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Place your hands on your outer knees.
Press your knees outward against your hands.
Hold briefly.
Release slowly.
Keep your back straight.

added.name: Seated Bent Knee Abduction Feet Floor Off
added.namePl: Odwodzenie zgiętych kolan w siadzie ze stopami nad podłogą
instructions: Sit tall and lift your feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees outward.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

added.name: Suspension Twist
added.namePl: Skręty tułowia na pasach
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your arms straight.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Return to centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your shoulders steady.

added.name: Resistance Band Seated Bent Knee Abduction Feet Floor Off
added.namePl: Odwodzenie zgiętych kolan w siadzie ze stopami nad podłogą z gumą
instructions: Sit tall with a band around your thighs and feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees against the band.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

added.name: Cable Standing High Cross Neutral Grip Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion chwytem neutralnym z wysokiego wyciągu w staniu
instructions: Set both pulleys high and stand in the middle, holding the handles with palms facing in.
Cross your hands in front of your chest with elbows tucked to your sides.
Press the handles down and out until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the handles rise back slowly without moving your elbows.

added.name: Smith Staggered Stance Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust w rozkroku na maszynie smitha
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the bar over your hips.
Stagger your feet, one slightly ahead.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips to full extension.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

added.name: Lever Staggered Stance Hip Thrust (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Hip thrust w rozkroku na maszynie z pasem (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad over your hips.
Stagger your feet.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips fully.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

added.name: Lever Belt Sumo Deadlift (V Bar)
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo na maszynie z pasem (uchwyt v)
instructions: Stand wide on the platform with toes angled out and grip the V bar.
Sit your hips back, chest up, and keep your arms straight.
Push through your heels to stand fully upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control, letting your knees track over your toes.

added.name: Lever Seated Scapular Retraction (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Ściąganie łopatek w siadzie na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles with straight arms.
Let your shoulder blades spread forward slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Cable Seated Scapular Retraction
added.namePl: Ściąganie łopatek w siadzie na wyciągu
instructions: Sit at a low cable station, feet braced, and hold the handle with straight arms.
Sit tall and let your shoulder blades stretch forward.
Pull your shoulder blades together, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the squeeze briefly.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Dumbbell Hip Supported Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Rumuński martwy ciąg z hantlami z podparciem bioder
instructions: Stand with your hips lightly against the support, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and keep your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

added.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Leg Kickback on Bench
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie nogi w klęku na ławce z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band and loop it around one foot, then kneel on a bench with hands on the front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the working leg back and up until the hip is fully extended.
Squeeze the glute for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly under control without letting the band yank your leg.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Suspender Twisting Jackknife
added.namePl: Skręty ze scyzorykiem na pasach
instructions: Set your feet in the straps and get into a straight-arm plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.
Pull both knees toward your chest, twisting them toward one elbow.
Pause briefly, then extend the legs back to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips from sagging as you return.

added.name: Cable Face Pull with External Rotation
added.namePl: Face pull z rotacją zewnętrzną na wyciągu
instructions: Set a rope at upper chest height and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high.
At the end, rotate your fists upward so your hands finish above your elbows.
Squeeze your rear shoulders for a second.
Reverse the rotation and return slowly.

added.name: Suspender Y Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w y na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.
Raise your arms up and out until they form a Y overhead.
Pause at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Step your feet forward to make it harder.

added.name: Dumbbell over the Chest Lying Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie ramion z hantlami w leżeniu nad klatką
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and hold a dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Raise your top leg without rotating your torso.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Suspender Arm Curl to Ears
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion do uszu na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with palms up and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and pull your hands toward your ears.
Keep elbows high and out to the sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.

added.name: Suspender Biceps Clutch
added.namePl: Biceps clutch na pasach
instructions: Grab the handles palms up and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body rigid.
Curl yourself up, drawing the hands in beside your head.
Hold the top position for a second and squeeze.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Walk your feet closer to make it easier.

added.name: Negative Front Lever Raise
added.namePl: Negatywne unoszenie front lever
instructions: Hang from a bar and pull your body up so your hips and legs are above you.
Straighten your body and keep your arms locked.
Lower slowly toward a horizontal position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Stop when you cannot hold the line, then bend your knees to come back up.
Rest and repeat for a few careful reps.

added.name: Single Arm Hanging Toes to Bar
added.namePl: Jednorącz unoszenie palców stóp do drążka w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a bar with one hand and keep your shoulder active.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Lift your toes up toward the bar.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

added.name: Landmine Kneeling 180s
added.namePl: Landmine 180 w klęku
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar with both hands in front of your chest.
Keep your hips squared and core tight.
Swing the bar in an arc to one side by rotating your torso.
Swing across to the other side in a controlled sweep.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.

added.name: Barbell 2 3 Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg 2 3 ze sztangą
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width and the bar over your mid foot.
Grip the bar, brace your core, and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up.
Lower the bar back toward the floor under control.
Reset each rep and keep your back neutral.

added.name: Suspender Body Saw
added.namePl: Body saw na pasach
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set up on your forearms.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Shift your body backward by pushing through the forearms.
Rock forward past the starting point in a short controlled motion.
Keep your hips level, do not let your lower back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

added.name: Suspender Close Grip Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie wąskim chwytem na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles close together and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest between the handles, elbows tucked close.
Pause when your chest is near your hands.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
Move your feet back to increase difficulty.

added.name: Suspender Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha na pasach
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a straight-arm plank.
Keep shoulders over hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest while rounding your spine slightly.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend your legs back to plank slowly.
Avoid dropping the hips as you return.

added.name: Suspender Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with palms facing in and lean back.
Keep your body straight and arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your forehead, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
Do not let your hips drop.

added.name: Suspender Handstand Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka w staniu na rękach na pasach
instructions: Set the straps low and place your hands in the handles in a pike position.
Kick or walk your feet up into an inverted position with a tight core.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the handles.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body steady, using a wall or spotter if needed.
Come down carefully when finished.

added.name: Suspender Incline Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka na skosie na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and walk your feet back so your body is at a slant.
Keep your body straight and core tight.
Lower your chest to the handles by bending the elbows.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Walk your feet back to make it harder.

added.name: Suspender Jump Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad ze skokiem na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with slightly bent arms and stand tall.
Lower into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your feet and jump up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink into the next squat.
Use the straps for balance only.
Keep knees tracking over toes.

added.name: Suspender Lunge Back Crossover
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył ze skrzyżowaniem na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and stand facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest tall and front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Suspender Middle Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie środkowe na pasach
instructions: Grip the handles and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands, elbows close by.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Step forward to ease the load.

added.name: Suspender Mountain Climber Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka ze wspinaczką na pasach
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set up in a high plank.
Do one push-up, keeping your body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then the other.
Alternate legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat the sequence for the set.

added.name: Suspender Oblique Rollout
added.namePl: Rollout skośnych na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles kneeling or standing, arms in front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Roll forward and angle your arms toward one side.
Go only as far as you can hold a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Suspender One Arm Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia jednorącz na pasach
instructions: Hold one handle palm up and lean back at an angle.
Keep your feet planted and body straight.
Bend the elbow and pull your body toward your hand.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

added.name: Suspender One Arm Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz na pasach
instructions: Hold one handle, lean forward and place your feet wide for balance.
Keep your hips square.
Bend your elbow and lower your chest toward the hand.
Resist twisting at the torso.
Press back to a straight arm.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Suspender One Arm Leg Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka jednorącz z nogą na pasach
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a plank with one hand on the floor.
Brace your core firmly.
Lower your chest by bending the supporting elbow.
Keep your hips level and avoid twisting.
Press back up.
Complete your reps, then switch hands.

added.name: Cable Standing Fly V. 3
added.namePl: Rozpiętki w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a staggered stance and lean slightly.
With soft elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest for a moment.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Woodchop V. 3
added.namePl: Woodchop w klęku na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Set the cable high, kneel side-on to it and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your hips square and your core tight.
Pull the handle diagonally across your body down toward the opposite hip.
Rotate through your torso, not your arms.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Overhead Squat V. 3
added.namePl: Przysiad z wyciskaniem nad głowę na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Set a cable low and hold the handle overhead with straight arms, standing tall.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep the handle over your head and chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Pulldown V. 3
added.namePl: Ściąganie w klęku na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the bar or handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle down toward your chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handle rise back slowly to a full stretch.

added.name: Cable Standing Reverse Fly V. 3
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Set the pulleys at shoulder height and hold the opposite handles, arms crossed.
Stand tall with soft elbows.
Pull your hands apart and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the crossed start.

added.name: Cable Lateral Lunge V. 3
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your chest.
Step wide to the side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push through the bent leg to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Bench Press V. 3
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na ławce na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

added.name: Cable Seated High Row V. 3
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie do góry w siadzie na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Sit at a cable station with the pulley set high and grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

added.name: Cable Standing Push Pull V. 3
added.namePl: Pchanie i przyciąganie w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance between two cables, one handle in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other back toward your ribs.
Reverse the roles slowly.
Alternate sides for the set.

added.name: Cable Standing Hip Extension V. 3
added.namePl: Prostowanie biodra w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand facing the machine, holding on for balance.
Keep your core tight and your torso upright.
Push your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Suspender One Leg Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie z jedną nogą na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles, lean forward and lift one foot off the floor.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest between your hands.
Press back up without letting the hips drop.
Keep the raised leg in line with your body.
Switch legs after your set.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Military Press V. 3
added.namePl: Wyciskanie żołnierskie w klęku na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Kneel between two low pulleys and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press both handles straight overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower under control to your shoulders.

added.name: Cable Standing Biceps Curl (Rope Attachment) V. 3
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion w staniu na wyciągu (z liną) v. 3
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold it with palms facing each other.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

added.name: Cable Lying Alternating Bent Leg Jackknife V. 3
added.namePl: Scyzoryk naprzemienny z ugiętą nogą w leżeniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet attached to a low cable and hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Bring one bent knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
Keep a controlled alternating rhythm.

added.name: Cable Single Arm Row with Rotation V. 3
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz z rotacją na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand facing a cable at chest height with a single handle in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and brace your core.
Row the handle to your ribs while rotating your torso slightly.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable Incline Bench Press V. 3
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na ławce skośnej na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Set an incline bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up and slightly together.
Squeeze your upper chest at the top.
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch.

added.name: Cable Standing Hip Flexion V. 3
added.namePl: Zginanie biodra w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley, face away from the machine, and hold on for balance.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Drive your working knee forward and up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction V. 3
added.namePl: Odwodzenie nogi w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the near side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Lift your outside leg out to the side.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Standing Hip Adduction V. 3
added.namePl: Przywodzenie nogi w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the far side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Sweep your working leg across in front of the other leg.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Squat V. 3
added.namePl: Przysiad na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Hold a cable handle at your chest and stand with feet shoulder width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

added.name: Cable Bent over Single Arm Row V. 3
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w opadzie tułowia na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Face a low pulley, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the handle.
Brace your core and keep your hips back.
Row the handle toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Suspender Pull Up V. 2
added.namePl: Podciąganie na pasach v. 2
instructions: Hold the handles overhead and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Bend your knees or lean back to make it easier.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Crunch V. 3
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w klęku na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Kneel under a high pulley and hold the rope beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Curl your torso down, bringing elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.

added.name: Cable Standing Torso Twist V. 3
added.namePl: Skręty tułowia w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand side-on to a cable set at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and feet planted.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Standing Biceps Curl to Arnold Press V. 3
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z wyciskaniem arnolda w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Hold low cable handles, palms forward, arms down.
Curl the handles up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms inward as you start to press.
Press overhead, turning your palms forward.
Reverse the move and lower under control.

added.name: Cable Lying Fly V. 3
added.namePl: Rozpiętki w leżeniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand over your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop at a comfortable stretch.
Bring the handles back together over your chest.

added.name: Cable Standing Alternating Diagonal Chest Press V. 3
added.namePl: Naprzemienne ukośne wyciskanie w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance holding a high cable handle in each hand.
Brace your core.
Press one handle forward and down diagonally.
Return slowly and press with the other arm.
Alternate for the set without twisting your hips.

added.name: Cable Side Plank Row V. 3
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w podporze bocznym na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Set up in a side plank with a low cable handle in your top hand.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Row the handle toward your ribs.
Keep your hips high and stable.
Extend slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Prone Single Leg Curl V. 3
added.namePl: Uginanie jednej nogi w leżeniu przodem na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Lie face down with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Cable Standing Front Raise V. 3
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion przodem w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle between your legs.
Keep your core tight and arm nearly straight.
Raise the handle forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable Standing Side Bend V. 3
added.namePl: Skłony boczne w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your side.
Keep your chest tall.
Bend sideways away from the machine.
Contract your obliques to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Overhead Triceps Extension V. 3
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia nad głową jednorącz w staniu na wyciągu v. 3
instructions: Hold a handle from a low pulley overhead, elbow bent, with your upper arm close to your head.
Brace your core.
Straighten your arm overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Suspender Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and get into a plank with hands under shoulders.
Keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest between the handles.
Keep the straps steady and elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Do not let the hips sag.

added.name: Glute Ham Developer Straight Arms Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki na maszynie ghd z prostymi ramionami
instructions: Set up on the GHD with your feet secured and hips on the pad.
Extend your arms overhead and lean back.
Curl up, bringing your arms forward.
Reach your torso over your knees.
Lower slowly with control.

added.name: Criss Cross Tuck Jump
added.namePl: Skok z podkurczeniem nóg ze skrzyżowaniem
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Cross your feet in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Uncross on the next jump, alternating the crossing foot.
Keep a steady quick rhythm.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Alternate Fly
added.namePl: Naprzemienne rozpiętki jednorącz z kettlebellem
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell over your chest in one hand.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell out to the side in an arc.
Bring it back over your chest.
Switch hands and alternate.

added.name: Resistance Band Lying Floor Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie w leżeniu na podłodze z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back with the band under your upper back and a handle in each hand.
Start with your hands at chest level.
Press your hands straight up until your arms extend.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly back to the start.

added.name: Kettlebell Standing Behind Back Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Rumuński martwy ciąg z kettlebellem za plecami w staniu
instructions: Hold a kettlebell behind your back in both hands, feet hip width.
Soften your knees and brace your core.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

added.name: Suspender Rear Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall, facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Press through the front heel to return.
Use the straps for balance only.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

added.name: Suspender Reverse Fly Wake Up
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki wake up na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight in front.
Keep your body in a line.
Open your arms wide, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Keep arms slightly bent and level with the shoulders.
Return slowly to the start.
Walk your feet forward to lighten the load.

added.name: Smith Bench Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad na ławkę na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back.
Unrack and step your feet slightly forward.
Sit down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

added.name: Lever Single Arm Reverse Grip Lateral Pulldown (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka jednorącz podchwytem na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit in the machine and grab one handle with an underhand grip.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Pull the handle down, driving your elbow toward your side.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Suspender Side Cross Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny ze skrzyżowaniem na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step one leg out and slightly behind the other, crossing the body.
Sink back into the hip with a flat back.
Push through the working foot to return.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Incline Close Grip Push Up with Chair Against Wall
added.namePl: Pompka wąskim chwytem na skosie z krzesłem przy ścianie
instructions: Brace a chair against a wall and place your hands close together on the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the chair, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line.

added.name: Standing Wall Slide Half Squat
added.namePl: Półprzysiad ze ślizgiem po ścianie w staniu
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to rise.
Repeat for the set.

added.name: Weighted Plate Hyperextension V. 2
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja z talerzem z obciążeniem v. 2
instructions: Set up on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured and hold a plate against your chest.
Keep your back straight and body in a line.
Lower your torso with control.
Raise until you are back in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without overarching.

added.name: Suspender Side Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and stand with feet together.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and heel down.
Push off to return to the start.
Alternate sides.

added.name: Suspender Single Arm Rear Delt Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz na tylne aktony na pasach
instructions: Hold one handle and lean back at an angle.
Keep your hips level and free hand on your chest or hip.
Pull the handle toward your shoulder with the elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear delt at the end.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Suspender Single Leg Plank Straight Arm
added.namePl: Deska jednonóż z prostymi ramionami na pasach
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lift one leg slightly higher.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower the leg and switch sides.
Breathe steadily throughout.

added.name: Suspender Single Leg Plank
added.namePl: Deska jednonóż na pasach
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and rest on your forearms.
Lift one leg a bit higher than the other.
Keep your hips square and abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.
Do not let the lower back arch.

added.name: Suspender Single Leg Squat Figure
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż figura na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee.
Lower as far as you can control.
Keep your knee over your toes and chest tall.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Suspender Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki na pasach
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and knees bent.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze the abs at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

added.name: Suspender Spiderman Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka spiderman na pasach
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
As you descend, bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Press up and extend the leg back.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips low and steady.

added.name: Suspender Split Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki rozkroczne na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and step into a split stance leaning forward.
Keep arms slightly bent and hands in front of you.
Open your arms out wide to the sides.
Squeeze at the end of the stretch without shrugging.
Bring the arms back together under control.
Switch the lead leg halfway through.

added.name: Suspender Sprinter
added.namePl: Sprinter na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and lean slightly forward.
Stand on one leg with the other knee raised.
Drive one knee up as the opposite arm moves.
Switch legs with a quick hop.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your core tight and pace steady.

added.name: Suspender Squat Arms Overhead
added.namePl: Przysiad z rękami nad głową na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles overhead with arms straight.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat.
Keep your arms up and chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Do not let the lower back round.

added.name: Suspender Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with arms extended.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through the heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.

added.name: Cable Standing Neutral Grip Overhead Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową chwytem neutralnym w staniu na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a rope or neutral handle to a low pulley and face away from the stack.
Hold it overhead with elbows bent and pointing forward, one foot slightly ahead.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and your ribs down.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to a deep stretch and repeat.

added.name: Suspender Standing Ab Rollout
added.namePl: Rollout brzucha w staniu na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles in front of you and lean forward.
Brace your abs and tuck the pelvis.
Extend your arms overhead as your body leans out.
Stop before your lower back arches.
Pull back to the start with your abs.
Take a smaller range if you need.

added.name: Suspender Star Plank
added.namePl: Deska gwiazda na pasach
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Spread your legs wide.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Brace the abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe steadily and do not sag.

added.name: Step Up (1st and 2nd Stairs Steps)
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie (pierwszy i drugi stopień schodów)
instructions: Stand facing the stairs with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot on the first step and push through the heel to climb up.
Continue onto the second step, then step back down in control.
Keep your torso tall and your knee tracking over your toes.
Alternate the leading leg each rep or finish all reps on one side first.

added.name: Standing Wall Slide Half Squat Hold
added.namePl: Trzymanie półprzysiadu ze ślizgiem po ścianie w staniu
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45-60 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Press through your whole foot and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-45 seconds, then slide back up.

added.name: Suspender Star Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka gwiazda na pasach
instructions: Place your feet in the straps spread wide in a high plank.
Keep your core tight.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up.
Hold the wide leg position the whole set.

added.name: Suspender Supine Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w leżeniu na plecach na pasach
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and legs up.
Place your arms flat on the floor.
Curl your hips up, pulling the knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
Do not swing the legs.

added.name: Suspender Supine Plank
added.namePl: Deska w leżeniu na plecach na pasach
instructions: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower under control.

added.name: Suspender Triceps Extension Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z prostowaniem ramion na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your forehead between the hands.
Keep elbows pointing forward.
Press back up to straight arms.
Move your feet back for more challenge.

added.name: Suspender Triceps Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie tricepsowe na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and hinge forward with elbows by your sides.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms and push them behind you.
Squeeze the triceps at the end.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your back flat.

added.name: Suspender Twist Side
added.namePl: Skręt boczny na pasach
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Twist your hips to one side, bringing the knees across.
Return to the center with control.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square.

added.name: Suspender Twist Up
added.namePl: Skręt w górę na pasach
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Pull your knees up and rotate them toward one elbow.
Pause and squeeze the obliques.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your hands firmly planted.

added.name: Lever Belt Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Rumuński martwy ciąg jednonóż na maszynie z pasem
instructions: Fasten the belt and stand on one leg on the platform with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as your torso lowers.
Let the free leg extend behind you for balance.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Suspender Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your body upright.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower the heels slowly below the start if comfortable.
Use the straps only for balance.

added.name: Suspender Single Leg Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg jednonóż na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Soften the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze the glute to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Suspender Pendulum
added.namePl: Wahadło na pasach
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Swing your legs together to one side.
Swing back through the center to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep your shoulders stable.

added.name: Lever Lying Leg Curl to Reverse Hyperextension
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg w leżeniu z przejściem do odwrotnej hiperekstensji na maszynie
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pads behind your lower legs.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, then lower with control.
Move into the reverse hyperextension position with the pad behind your legs.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs until they line up with your torso.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging.

added.name: Smith Unilateral Bulgarian Split Squat from Deficit
added.namePl: Jednonóż bułgarski przysiad z deficytu na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with the front foot on a low plate or step.
Place the rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel or deeper.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over the toes.
Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Side Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nogi w bok w staniu z gumą
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or above the knees and stand tall.
Hold onto something for balance if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side with a straight knee.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

added.name: Suspender Hip Hinge
added.namePl: Zawias biodrowy na pasach
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet hip width apart.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Lean on the straps for balance.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Hip Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie biodra w staniu z gumą
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or secure it low, and stand tall.
Hold a support for balance.
Keep your core tight.
Kick one leg straight back without arching the back.
Squeeze the glute at the end.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

added.name: Suspender Abduction Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w bok z TRX
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push the hips back.
Keep your chest up and the other leg straight.
Push off to return.
Alternate sides.

added.name: Burpee
added.namePl: Burpee
instructions: Zacznij w pozycji stojącej, ze stopami na szerokość barków.
Opuść ciało w pozycję przysiadu, uginając kolana i kładąc dłonie na podłodze przed sobą.
Wykop nogi do tyłu, przyjmując pozycję podporu do pompki.
Wykonaj pompkę, trzymając ciało w prostej linii.
Podskocz stopami z powrotem do pozycji przysiadu.
Wyskocz gwałtownie w górę, sięgając ramionami nad głowę.
Wyląduj miękko i natychmiast opuść się z powrotem w pozycję przysiadu, aby rozpocząć kolejne powtórzenie.

added.name: Rowing (With Rowing Machine)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie (na ergometrze wioślarskim)
instructions: Sit on the machine, strap in your feet and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, hips hinge, then knees bend to slide forward.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 10-30 minutes at a comfortable pace.

added.name: Lying Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

added.name: Smith Calf Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce na maszynie smitha v. 2
instructions: Set the bar on your shoulders and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Keep your knees almost straight and your torso upright.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower under control.

added.name: Resistance Band Side Lying Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie biodra w leżeniu bokiem z gumą
instructions: Lie on your side with the band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your legs straight and stacked.
Lift the top leg up without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Static Quadriceps Contraction (Isometric)
added.namePl: Statyczne napięcie mięśnia czworogłowego (izometryczne)
instructions: Sit or lie with one leg straight in front.
Relax your upper body.
Tighten the front of the thigh and press the knee down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax fully.
Repeat, then switch legs.

added.name: Static Glutes Contraction (Isometric)
added.namePl: Statyczne napięcie pośladków (izometryczne)
instructions: Lie on your back or stand with your body relaxed.
Squeeze both glute muscles together.
Keep your legs and back still.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Release fully.
Repeat for several reps.

added.name: Single Leg Pogo Jump
added.namePl: Pogo jump jednonóż
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop straight up by pushing through the ball of your foot, keeping the knee almost straight.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot and rebound right away.
Keep your hops small and quick, with your hips level and your core tight.
Hop for the planned time or reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Floor W Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w w na podłodze
instructions: Lie face down with arms bent and elbows out to the sides.
Rest your forehead lightly on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms and chest slightly.
Form a W shape with your arms and hold for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Barbell Standing Military Press (Without Rack)
added.namePl: Wyciskanie żołnierskie sztangi stojąc (bez stojaka)
instructions: Lift the barbell from the floor to your collarbone using a safe clean or deadlift and curl.
Set your feet hip-width apart with hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead to full lockout.
Lower to your collarbone under control and repeat.

added.name: Seated Single Leg Calf Raise on a Chair
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż na krześle w siadzie
instructions: Sit on a chair with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent to 90 degrees.
Lift the other foot off the floor or tuck it behind.
Press through the ball of the working foot and raise your heel.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Standing Glute Squeeze
added.namePl: Ściskanie pośladków stojąc
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed.
Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips.
Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can.
Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.

added.name: Weighted Plate Overhead Reverse Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z talerzem nad głową
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your ribs down and the plate stable over your head.
Push through the front foot to return, then alternate legs.

added.name: 45 Degree One Leg Hyperextension (Arms in Front of Chest)
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja 45 stopni jednonóż (ręce przed klatką piersiową)
instructions: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: 45 Degree Twisting Hyperextension
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja 45 stopni ze skrętem
instructions: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.

added.name: Bodyweight Rope Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie na linie z masą ciała
instructions: Hang from two ropes with arms straight and legs together.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull yourself up until your hands reach chest or chin level.
Keep your elbows pointing down and close.
Lower under control to a full hang.

added.name: Bodyweight Rope Inverted Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie odwrócone na linie z masą ciała
instructions: Set ropes at about waist height and lie under them, holding the ends.
Keep your body straight from heels to head, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Weighted Stone Standing Power Overhead Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie kamienia nad głowę stojąc z obciążeniem
instructions: Lift the stone to your chest, hugging it close.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your core.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Press the stone overhead to full lockout.
Lower it back to your chest with control.

added.name: Plyo Push Up V. 2
added.namePl: Pompka plyometryczna v. 2
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward so your hands leave the ground.
Land softly with slightly bent elbows.
Reset your body line and repeat.

added.name: Lever Incline Chest Supported Reverse Delt Fly (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki na maszynie na ławce skośnej z podparciem klatki (talerze)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the incline pad and grab the handles.
Start with arms forward and slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

added.name: Assisted Weighted Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z obciążeniem i asystą
instructions: Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up until your elbows are straight.
Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.

added.name: Barbell Incline Wide Reverse Grip Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi szerokim podchwytem na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you.
Unrack and hold the bar over your upper chest.
Lower it to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up to lockout.
Use a spotter, as this grip is less stable.

added.name: Diamond Push Up (On Knees)
added.namePl: Pompka diamentowa na kolanach
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Forward Leaning Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok z pochyleniem do przodu z hantlami
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.

added.name: Smith Bent over Row (Chest Supported)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na maszynie smitha z podparciem klatki
instructions: Set an incline bench under the bar and lie chest down on it.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Cable Seated Incline Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion na wyciągu na ławce skośnej w siadzie
instructions: Set a bench to incline and place a low pulley behind you.
Sit back with your arms hanging and grab the handles.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders, keeping elbows back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

added.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Supinated Grip Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz na wyciągu stojąc podchwytem
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip.
Stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Keep your torso still and resist twisting.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Lying Hammer Press V. 2
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli chwytem młotkowym w leżeniu v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Leg Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż z hantlem stojąc
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Jump Step Box
added.namePl: Wskok na skrzynię
instructions: Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.
Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.

added.name: Lateral Jump
added.namePl: Skok w bok
instructions: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready.
Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance.
Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes.
Immediately jump back to the starting side.
Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.

added.name: Explosive Hang Squat
added.namePl: Wybuchowy przysiad z zawisu
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Lower into a deep squat position.
Explode upward through your legs.
Absorb the movement softly and return to the start.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

added.name: Barbell Staggered Stance Stiff Legged Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg na prostych nogach ze sztangą w rozkroku krokowym
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish all reps, then switch the stance.

added.name: Flutter Kicks V. 2
added.namePl: Nożyce poziome v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

added.name: Single Arm Fingers Press with Ball
added.namePl: Wyciskanie piłki palcami jednorącz
instructions: Hold a small ball in one palm.
Press down on it with your fingers.
Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral.
Hold the press for 2-3 seconds.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

added.name: Kneeling Isometric Biceps Hold
added.namePl: Izometryczne trzymanie bicepsa w klęku
instructions: Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Hold your hands in front of you with palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your biceps and hold the position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

added.name: Single Arm Fingers Press with Ball V. 2
added.namePl: Wyciskanie piłki palcami jednorącz v. 2
instructions: Place a ball under one hand on a table or hold it in your palm.
Spread your fingers over the ball.
Press down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Release with control.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Back to Side to Front Arms Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli w opadzie tułowia: w tył, w bok, w przód
instructions: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Start with your arms back by your hips.
Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue forward in an arc, then reverse the path with control.
Use light weights and avoid swinging your torso.

added.name: Lying Simultaneous Alternating Straight Leg Raise
added.namePl: Naprzemienne jednoczesne unoszenie prostych nóg w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

added.name: Dumbbell Lying Single Straight Arm Press on Floor
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantla jednorącz prostym ramieniem z podłogi w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest.
Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight and the shoulder reaches forward.
Lower it back with control until your upper arm touches the floor.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lying Straight Leg Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Unoszenie prostych nóg w leżeniu v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.

added.name: Push Up (On Knees)
added.namePl: Pompka na kolanach
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

added.name: Smith Kneeling Rear Kick
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie w tył w klęku na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Weighted Inverted Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie odwrócone z obciążeniem
instructions: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it with extra weight on your torso.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

added.name: Alternate Straight Leg Raise (On Bosu Ball)
added.namePl: Naprzemienne unoszenie prostych nóg (na bosu)
instructions: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Curl with Isometric Hold
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia z hantlem jednorącz z izometrycznym przytrzymaniem
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward.
Curl the weight up until your elbow is bent to 90 degrees.
Hold that position for 2-3 seconds.
Finish the curl, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z kettlebellem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.

added.name: Hanging L Sit
added.namePl: L-sit w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep your toes pointed and your knees locked.
Avoid swinging.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower.

added.name: Stall Bar Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg na drabinkach
instructions: Hang on a stall bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Smith Step Up
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and stand in front of a bench.
Place one foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up fully.
Step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Weighted Twisting Crunch (On Bench)
added.namePl: Skośne spięcia brzucha z obciążeniem (na ławce)
instructions: Lie back on a bench with your knees bent and a weight held on your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your upper body up.
Rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly without letting go of tension.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Lever T Bar Close Grip Row (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie t-bar wąskim chwytem na maszynie (talerze)
instructions: Stand on the platform with your chest supported.
Grab the close-grip handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle toward your torso, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to full extension.

added.name: Weighted V Crunch (On Bosu Ball)
added.namePl: Spięcia v z obciążeniem (na bosu)
instructions: Sit on a bosu ball and lean back slightly, holding a weight in front of you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your legs bent or straight.
Bring your chest and knees toward each other in a V shape.
Lower back with control, keeping your spine long.
Stay stable on the ball throughout.

added.name: Incline Twisting Sit Up V. 2
added.namePl: Skośne brzuszki ze skrętem na ławce skośnej v. 2
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Triceps Press (Head Below Bench)
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na triceps (głowa poniżej ławki)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head just past the end, holding a weight overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your head.
Extend your arms to straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.

added.name: Iron Cross Plank
added.namePl: Deska żelazny krzyż
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

added.name: Lever Lying T Bar Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie t-bar na maszynie w leżeniu
instructions: Lie chest-down on the pad and grab the handles.
Start with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.

added.name: Lever Incline Hammer Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie klatki chwytem młotkowym na maszynie na ławce skośnej
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.

added.name: Dumbbell Alternate Biceps Curl V. 2
added.namePl: Naprzemienne uginanie ramion z hantlami v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.

added.name: Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Jumping Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie z wyskokiem
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.

added.name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull
added.namePl: Podciąganie sztangi wzdłuż tułowia w sumo
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and grip the barbell between your legs with hands close together.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to stand up.
As the bar passes your hips, pull it up to chest height with your elbows high.
Lower the bar back along the same path.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout.

added.name: Kettlebell Standing Slingshots (Advanced)
added.namePl: Slingshots z kettlebellem stojąc (zaawansowane)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Pass it around your waist from one hand to the other behind your back.
Continue the circle to the front, keeping the movement smooth.
Keep your core tight and your hips still.
After several reps, reverse the direction.

added.name: Cable Horizontal Pallof Press
added.namePl: Poziomy pallof press na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable One Arm Inner Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia do wewnątrz jednorącz na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the handle with one hand, palm up, and turn your elbow slightly out.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable One Arm Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka jednorącz na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

added.name: Cable One Arm Twisting Seated Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz ze skrętem na wyciągu w siadzie
instructions: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.

added.name: Cable Pull Through
added.namePl: Pull through na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.

added.name: Cable Twist (Up Down) V. 2
added.namePl: Skręty na wyciągu (z góry w dół) v. 2
instructions: Set the cable pulley high and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle above your shoulder, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally down across your body.
Keep your hips steady and your core braced.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Twisting Overhead Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę ze skrętem na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable low and stand sideways, holding the handle at your shoulder.
Brace your core and turn slightly toward the cable.
Press the handle overhead while rotating your torso to face forward.
Lower the handle back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Twisting Standing High Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie do góry ze skrętem na wyciągu stojąc
instructions: Set a cable at about head height and stand facing it with the handle in one hand.
Take a split stance and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest, turning your torso as you go.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Complete the set and switch sides.

added.name: Cable Twisting Standing One Arm Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz ze skrętem na wyciągu stojąc
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways with the handle in your inside hand.
Take a stable stance and hold the handle at your chest.
Press the handle forward while rotating your torso toward the press.
Return to the start with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Twisting Standing Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie ze skrętem na wyciągu stojąc
instructions: Set a cable at mid height and stand facing it, holding the handle with one hand.
Stand in a stable stance with a slight lean back.
Pull the handle to your ribs and rotate your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Vertical Pallof Press
added.namePl: Pionowy pallof press na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at a high or low position and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight up (or down) along a vertical line.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return to your chest, finish the set, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Grip 30 Degrees Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli podchwytem na ławce skośnej 30 stopni
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells held palms facing you.
Start with the dumbbells at your chest.
Press them up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to your chest.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

added.name: Dumbbell Side Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w bok z hantlami
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand or one at your chest and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.

added.name: Lever Seated One Leg Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż w siadzie na maszynie
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Set the pad on your thigh and release the safety.
Lower your heel for a stretch.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, lower slowly, then switch legs.

added.name: Lever Calf Raise (Bench Press Machine)
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce na maszynie do wyciskania
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the lower platform or press plate.
Push to straighten your legs and release the safety.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable.
