Start in a split stance with a slight bend in both knees.
Jump up and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance and row the handle to your ribs.
Alternate legs, and switch rowing arm for the next set.

added.name: Resistance Band Jump Lunge with Single Arm Row
added.namePl: Wykrok ze skokiem i wiosłowaniem jednorącz z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a lunge position with your chest up.
Jump and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge and pull the handle to your ribs.
Keep your front knee over your ankle on each landing.
Switch rowing arm for the next set.

added.name: Resistance Band Skier
added.namePl: Narciarz z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.

added.name: Resistance Band Squat with Horizontal Pallof Hold
added.namePl: Przysiad z poziomym utrzymaniem pallof z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest, then press it straight out.
Keep your hips and shoulders square as you squat down.
Stand back up while holding the band steady.
Complete your reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

added.name: Resistance Band Split Squat with Horizontal Pallof Hold
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z poziomym utrzymaniem pallof z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.

added.name: Resistance Band Punch
added.namePl: Cios z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Stand in a staggered stance with a braced core.
Punch one hand forward and rotate your torso slightly.
Return the hand and punch with the other side.
Keep the movement quick but controlled.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Reverse Row
added.namePl: Odwrotne wiosłowanie hantlami w opadzie tułowia
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and let the weights hang.
Pull the dumbbells to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

added.name: Elevated Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z podwyższeniem
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or box slightly wider than your shoulders.
Step back so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest to the edge with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

added.name: Starfish Crunch (Beginner)
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha rozgwiazda (początkujący)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Crunch up, bringing your elbows toward your knees as they pull in.
Lower back to the starfish position under control.
Breathe out as you crunch.

added.name: Front Plank Toe Tap
added.namePl: Deska przodem z dotykaniem stopami
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Tap one toe out to the side and bring it back.
Repeat with the other foot.
Keep your body steady and avoid rocking.

added.name: Crunch (Arms Straight)
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha (proste ramiona)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your arms straight toward your knees.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, keeping your arms reaching.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

added.name: Pulse Row
added.namePl: Pulse row
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and arms hanging.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pulse in short movements at the top.
Lower your arms under control.
Keep your neck neutral.

added.name: Decline Shoulder Tap
added.namePl: Dotykanie barku w pozycji z nogami wyżej
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep your hips from rocking.

added.name: Pseudo Planche Push Up
added.namePl: Pseudo planche pompka
instructions: Start in a plank with your hands turned out beside your lower ribs.
Lean your shoulders forward beyond your hands.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Press up while keeping the lean.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Mid Air Lateral Raises with Switching Palms
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion bokiem w powietrzu ze zmianą ułożenia dłoni
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height with palms down.
Turn your palms up in mid air, then back down.
Lower the weights slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

added.name: Lying Floor Hyperextension
added.namePl: Prostowanie pleców w leżeniu na podłodze
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

added.name: Bent over Row with Towel
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia z ręcznikiem
instructions: Hold a towel with both hands and stretch it taut.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pulling it apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

added.name: Lying Floor Hyperextension with Towel
added.namePl: Prostowanie pleców w leżeniu na podłodze z ręcznikiem
instructions: Lie face down holding a taut towel in front of you.
Lift your chest and legs off the floor.
Keep pulling the towel apart.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down with control.

added.name: Lying Double Legs Hammer Curl with Towel
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion chwytem młotkowym obiema nogami w leżeniu z ręcznikiem
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pushing your feet against it.
Pause, then slowly extend your arms.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

added.name: Lying Single Leg Reverse Biceps Curl with Towel
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion nachwytem jedną nogą w leżeniu z ręcznikiem
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around one foot.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward you while the foot resists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

added.name: Handboard Slope Hang
added.namePl: Zwis na listwie na pochyłej powierzchni
instructions: Grip the sloped hold with open hands.
Step off the ground and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders active and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully, then repeat.

added.name: Handboard Open Hand Grip
added.namePl: Zwis na listwie chwytem otwartym
instructions: Grip the edge with fingers extended and a slight arch.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down and rest before the next hang.

added.name: Handboard Half Crimp
added.namePl: Zwis na listwie chwytem half crimp
instructions: Place your fingers on the edge with the knuckles bent at about 90 degrees.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully between hangs.

added.name: Handboard Hang with 90 Degree Elbow
added.namePl: Zwis na listwie z łokciami zgiętymi pod kątem 90 stopni
instructions: Grip the hold and pull yourself up until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

added.name: Handboard Hang with 135 Degree Elbow
added.namePl: Zwis na listwie z łokciami zgiętymi pod kątem 135 stopni
instructions: Grip the hold and pull up slightly so your elbows bend to about 135 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

added.name: Crunch (On Bench)
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha (na ławce)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands by your temples.
Curl your shoulders up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

added.name: Band Side Bend
added.namePl: Skłony boczne z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand.
Keep your chest up and your hips square.
Bend sideways toward the band hand.
Return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Seated Row with Towel
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w siadzie z ręcznikiem
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and loop a towel around your feet.
Hold the ends with arms straight.
Pull the towel toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly.

added.name: Two Legs Reverse Biceps Curl with Towel V. 2
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion nachwytem obiema nogami z ręcznikiem v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Two Legs Hammer Curl with Towel V. 2
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion chwytem młotkowym obiema nogami z ręcznikiem v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Plank Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion bokiem w podporze przodem
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms and avoid twisting.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie biodra stojąc z gumą oporową
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it to one foot.
Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side, keeping your toes forward.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Front Plank Walkout
added.namePl: Przejście w podporze przodem
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out to a front plank.
Hold briefly with your hips level.
Walk your hands back and stand up.

added.name: Resistance Band Smith Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad na maszynie smitha z gumą oporową
instructions: Set the bar on the smith machine and attach the band as required.
Place the bar on your upper back with your feet slightly forward.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up.

added.name: Resistance Band Cable Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z gumą oporową na wyciągu
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the handles at your chest, facing away from the anchor.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand up.
Repeat for the desired reps.

added.name: Resistance Band Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

added.name: Cable Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a handle or bar to a low pulley and grab it.
Step back and hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Start with your arms extended toward the pulley.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

added.name: Weighted Plate Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia z talerzem
instructions: Hold a weight plate firmly with both hands at its edges.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Let the plate hang below your chest with arms extended.
Pull the plate toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
Keep your hips still and your neck neutral.

added.name: Stability Ball Body Saw
added.namePl: Body saw na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Place your forearms on a stability ball and extend your legs into a plank.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body forms a straight line.
Slowly push your elbows forward a few inches by shifting your body weight.
Pull back to the start without letting your hips sag.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
Repeat for time or reps.

added.name: Resistance Band Long Jump
added.namePl: Skok w dal z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your hips.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump forward as far as you can against the band.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

added.name: Bulgarian Jump Squat
added.namePl: Bułgarski przysiad z wyskokiem
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Lower into a split squat until your front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up explosively through your front foot so it leaves the floor.
Land softly and sink straight back into the next rep.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Burpee
added.namePl: Burpee z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor beside it, or on the handle if you prefer.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest, push up, then jump your feet back in.
Grab the kettlebell and stand, then press or swing it overhead if you like.
Return it to the floor and repeat.

added.name: Sprinter Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha sprinter
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and bring one knee toward the opposite elbow.
Extend the other leg out low above the floor.
Switch sides in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set.

added.name: Resistance Band Anti Rotation Dead Bug
added.namePl: Dead bug z gumą oporową przeciw rotacji
instructions: Anchor a band at the side and lie on your back, holding the band above your chest with both hands.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Brace your core so the band does not pull you sideways.
Slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm back.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

added.name: Duck Walk
added.namePl: Kacze chodzenie
instructions: Lower into a deep squat with your chest up.
Place your hands on your hips or in front of you for balance.
Step forward with one foot, keeping the squat low.
Step with the other foot and continue walking.
Keep your heels down and your back straight.
Walk for a set distance or time.

added.name: Cable Fly with Chest Supported
added.namePl: Rozpiętki na wyciągu z podparciem klatki piersiowej
instructions: Set the pulleys at about shoulder height and position an incline bench facing the stack, chest against the pad.
Hold a handle in each hand with arms out to the sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, sweep your arms forward in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as the handles meet.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

added.name: Cable Seated Chest Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki na wyciągu w siadzie
instructions: Sit on a bench between two cable stacks with the pulleys at chest height.
Grab a handle in each hand and hold your arms out with soft elbows.
Press your back firmly into the bench.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze, then open your arms slowly.
Stop when you feel a good stretch.

added.name: Frog Reverse Hyperextension (On a Bench)
added.namePl: Odwrotna hiperekstensja żabka (na ławce)
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and hold the bench for support.
Let your legs hang and bring the soles of your feet together, knees out.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs up behind you.
Pause when your thighs are in line with your torso.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Avoid arching your lower back too far.

added.name: Barbell Front Chest Squat with Resistance Band
added.namePl: Przysiad ze sztangą z przodu z gumą oporową
instructions: Set up a band under your feet or anchored to the floor and attach it to the bar.
Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels against the band tension.
Keep your chest tall throughout.

added.name: Barbell Hip Thrust with Resistance Band
added.namePl: Hip thrust ze sztangą i gumą oporową
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the loaded bar across your hips.
Set a band over your hips or around your thighs as the setup allows.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Smith Kneeling Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust w klęku na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar on the Smith machine at a low height and kneel facing away from it.
Place the bar across your hips with a pad for comfort.
Keep your torso upright and your core braced.
Thrust your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Slowly return to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Resistance Band 45 Degrees Hyperextension
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja 45 stopni z gumą oporową
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree hyperextension bench with your hips just over the pad.
Loop a band across your upper back and under your feet or the base.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them lightly.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch at the top.

added.name: Weighted Squat Jump with Plate
added.namePl: Przysiad z wyskokiem z talerzem
instructions: Hold a weight plate close to your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are near parallel.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.
Keep your chest up throughout.

added.name: Medicine Ball Squat Jump
added.namePl: Przysiad z wyskokiem z piłką lekarską
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sink into a squat with your chest up.
Jump up as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

added.name: Resistance Band Jump Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z wyskokiem z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand on a band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Jump up explosively against the band.
Land softly through your toes and heels.
Sink immediately into the next squat.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

added.name: Dumbbell Poliquin Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli bokiem metodą poliquina
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, standing with a slight forward lean.
Start with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing in.
Raise your arms out and up in a slight arc until about shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your wrists neutral.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Avoid swinging your torso.

added.name: Cable Leaning Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie bokiem z odchyleniem tułowia na wyciągu
instructions: Stand sideways to a low pulley and hold the handle with the far hand.
Hold the upright support with the other hand and lean away from the machine.
Start with your working arm across your body.
Raise it out to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower slowly under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Lever Seated Full Crunch
added.namePl: Pełne spięcia brzucha w siadzie na maszynie
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with the pads in position.
Hold the handles and keep your feet planted.
Exhale and curl your torso forward, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips on the seat.

added.name: Lever Seated Left Side Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w lewo w siadzie na maszynie
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads positioned for a left side crunch.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Exhale and crunch your torso toward the left.
Squeeze your side at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Avoid using momentum.

added.name: Lever Seated Right Side Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w prawo w siadzie na maszynie
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads positioned for a right side crunch.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Exhale and crunch your torso toward the right.
Squeeze your side at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Avoid using momentum.

added.name: Double Under Jump Rope
added.namePl: Podwójne skoki na skakance
instructions: Hold the rope handles at your hips with your elbows close.
Stand tall and start with a few normal jumps.
Jump a little higher and spin the rope faster with your wrists.
Let the rope pass twice under your feet before landing.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your jumps small and your body upright.

added.name: Dumbbell Complex Push Up Row Clean and Press
added.namePl: Kompleks z hantlami pompka wiosłowanie zarzut i wyciskanie
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands on two dumbbells.
Do a push-up, then row one dumbbell to your ribs and switch sides.
Jump or step your feet toward your hands and stand up, cleaning the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Press them overhead.
Lower to the floor and return to the push-up position.
Move smoothly and keep your core tight.

added.name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch
added.namePl: Rwanie hantla jednorącz
instructions: Stań w rozkroku na szerokość barków, trzymając hantlę w jednej ręce chwytem nachwytem.
Ugnij lekko kolana i pochyl tułów w biodrach, utrzymując proste plecy i uniesioną klatkę piersiową.
Opuść hantlę w stronę podłogi, trzymając ją blisko ciała.
Gwałtownie wyprostuj biodra, kolana i kostki, wyrzucając hantlę w górę po prostej linii.
Gdy hantla osiągnie wysokość barku, szybko obróć dłoń i wypchnij ją nad głowę, w pełni prostując rękę.
Złap hantlę nad głową z lekkim ugięciem kolan i bioder.
Opuść hantlę z powrotem do pozycji wyjściowej w kontrolowany sposób.
Powtórz zalecaną liczbę powtórzeń, a następnie zmień na drugą rękę.

added.name: Hanging Knees to Elbows
added.namePl: Unoszenie kolan do łokci w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Brace your core and tuck your knees.
Raise your knees up toward your elbows.
Curl your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the desired reps.

added.name: Hanging Toes to Bar
added.namePl: Unoszenie stóp do drążka w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a bar with a firm grip.
Engage your lats and brace your core.
Raise your straight legs up until your toes touch the bar.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid excessive swinging.

added.name: Jump on Fit Box
added.namePl: Wskok na skrzynię
instructions: Stand facing a plyo box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box with both feet.
Stand fully upright at the top.
Step down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

added.name: Assault Bike Run
added.namePl: Bieg na rowerze assault
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit on the bike.
Grip the handles and push and pull with your arms.
Pedal at a steady, strong pace.
Increase the effort for intervals.
Keep your breathing controlled.
Ride for a set time or distance.

added.name: Dumbbell Stiff Leg Deadlift V. 3
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z hantlami na prostych nogach v. 3
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees almost straight.
Hinge at the hips and slide the weights down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand, keeping your back flat.

added.name: Band Seated Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly extend your arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

added.name: Band Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

added.name: Resistance Band One Leg Kickback (Bent Position)
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie nogi z gumą oporową (w opadzie)
instructions: Loop a resistance band around your ankle and anchor the other end low in front of you.
Hold a support and lean forward slightly.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Kick your leg back and up against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Pike Press (Between Benches)
added.namePl: Pike press (między ławkami)
instructions: Place your hands on two benches shoulder-width apart and your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips into a pike shape.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Keep your hips high throughout.

added.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Push Up Row
added.namePl: Pompka z wiosłowaniem w klęku z masą ciała
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position with your hands on the floor, or on light dumbbells.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push back up.
Pull one elbow toward your ribs.
Return that hand to the floor and alternate sides.
Keep your hips level.

added.name: Weighted Push Up with Vest
added.namePl: Pompka z obciążeniem w kamizelce
instructions: Put on a weighted vest and start in a plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Repeat for the set.

added.name: Dumbbell Low Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki z hantlami nisko
instructions: Lie on a flat bench or stand and hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Move the dumbbells in a wide arc.
Bring them together in front of your lower chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly under control.

added.name: Cable Bent over One Arm Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie bokiem jednorącz w opadzie tułowia na wyciągu
instructions: Stand next to a low pulley and bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Grab the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side with a soft elbow.
Lift to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell One Arm Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla przodem jednorącz
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh.
Keep your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms after your reps.

added.name: Cable Rear Delt Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na tylne aktony na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at chest height with a handle or rope.
Hold it with your arms extended.
Step back and lean slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts.
Return slowly.

added.name: Decline Pike Press (Between Benches)
added.namePl: Pike press na skosie głową w dół (między ławkami)
instructions: Place your hands on two benches and your feet on a higher surface behind you.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Control the descent.

added.name: Handstand Shoulder Press with Wall (Between Benches)
added.namePl: Wyciskanie w staniu na rękach przy ścianie (między ławkami)
instructions: Place your hands on two benches and kick up into a handstand with your heels against the wall.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Lower your head between the benches by bending your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep the movement controlled.
Come down carefully when done.

added.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Floor Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi podchwytem z podłogi
instructions: Lie on the floor with a barbell above your chest, hands in an underhand grip.
Plant your feet and brace your core.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up.
Keep your wrists straight.

added.name: Landmine Single Leg Landmine Rdl
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński jednonóż z landmine
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar with both hands.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the other leg behind you.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand.
Switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Landmine Rear Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z landmine
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

added.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown on Floor
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion na wyciągu leżąc na podłodze
instructions: Set a cable at a low or mid position and sit on the floor facing it.
Hold the handle with elbows tucked at your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.

added.name: Landmine Kneeling Squeeze Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie z ściskaniem w klęku z landmine
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the bar end close to your chest with both hands pressed together.
Brace your core.
Press the bar forward and up.
Squeeze your hands together as you press.
Lower it slowly.
Keep your torso upright.

added.name: Side Push Up with Towel
added.namePl: Boczna pompka z ręcznikiem
instructions: Start in a push-up position with one hand on a towel on the floor.
Slide that hand out to the side.
Lower your chest toward the other hand.
Push back up.
Slide the towel hand back in.
Switch sides.

added.name: Landmine Floor One Arm Chest Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki jednorącz z landmine na podłodze
instructions: Lie on the floor holding the landmine bar end with one hand.
Extend the arm above your chest.
Lower the bar out to the side in an arc.
Stop when your arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the bar back up.
Switch sides.

added.name: Floor Fly with Towels
added.namePl: Rozpiętki na podłodze z ręcznikami
instructions: Kneel or get into a plank with your hands on towels.
Slide your hands out wide to the sides.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Squeeze your chest to slide your hands back together.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

added.name: Cable Seated Floor One Arm Concentration Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia z podparciem łokcia na wyciągu w siadzie na podłodze
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

added.name: Squat Tip Toe
added.namePl: Przysiad na palcach
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rise onto your toes.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down while staying up on your toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Stand back up.
Keep your chest tall.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg jednonóż z masą ciała
instructions: Stand on one foot with a soft knee and your arms hanging in front.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall again.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Standing Side Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nogi bokiem stojąc
instructions: Stand tall, hands on your hips or on a support.
Keep your toes pointing forward and lift one leg out to the side.
Raise it as high as you can without leaning your torso.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.

added.name: Decline Push Up (Kneeling)
added.namePl: Pompka z nogami wyżej (w klęku)
instructions: Kneel with your knees on a bench or step and hands on the floor.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight and your elbows at about 45 degrees.

added.name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band low or stand on it and hold the other end behind your head.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your ears.
Straighten your arms overhead.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your upper arms still and your ribs down.

added.name: Romanian Chair Sit Up V. 2
added.namePl: Brzuszki na rzymskim krześle v. 2
instructions: Sit on the floor and rest your lower legs on a chair or bench, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your knees.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

added.name: Cable Seated Rear Delt Fly with Chest Support
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki na wyciągu w siadzie z podparciem klatki piersiowej
instructions: Sit facing the stack with your chest against the pad and hold the handles.
Start with your arms forward and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back to shoulder height.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

added.name: Seated Alternate Crunch
added.namePl: Naprzemienne spięcia brzucha w siadzie
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and lift your feet.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in while rotating your torso toward it.
Return and repeat on the other side.
Keep your chest open and move with control.

added.name: Smith Single Arm Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w opadzie tułowia na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar at a low height and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Grip the bar with one hand and brace the other on your thigh.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Upright Alternate Squeeze Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie z ściskaniem hantli w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together in front of your chest.
Keep the two dumbbells touching.
Press one dumbbell forward until the arm is straight.
Bring it back and press with the other arm.
Keep squeezing the weights together.

added.name: Hands Release Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z odrywaniem dłoni
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your whole body to the floor.
Lift your hands off the floor briefly.
Place them back and press up.
Keep your body in a straight line.

added.name: Air Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand.

added.name: Crawl to Crab
added.namePl: Przejście z czworaków do kraba
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift your knees slightly into a low crawl.
Rotate your body and sit back into a crab position, face up.
Lift your hips.
Rotate back into the crawl and repeat.

added.name: Cross Twisting Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki ze skrętem na krzyż
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and twist toward one knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

added.name: High Knees Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok z wysokim kolanem
instructions: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Push off and drive the back knee up high.
Step back and repeat on the other side.
Keep your pace steady for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Front to Side Plank
added.namePl: Przejście z deski do deski bocznej
instructions: Start in a front plank on your forearms or hands.
Rotate your body to one side, lifting one arm up.
Hold briefly in a side plank.
Return to the front plank.
Alternate sides.

added.name: Side Step Front Plank
added.namePl: Deska z krokiem w bok
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand and foot out to the side.
Bring the other hand and foot to meet them.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat in one direction, then reverse.

added.name: Forward Step Front Plank
added.namePl: Deska z krokiem w przód
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand forward, then the other.
Follow with your feet.
Keep your hips level.
Walk forward a few steps, then back.

added.name: Forward to Side to Rear Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w przód, w bok i w tył
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward into a lunge, then push back to standing.
Step the same foot out to the side, sit back into the hip, then return to center.
Step the same foot backward into a lunge and push back to standing.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes, then switch legs after your set.

added.name: Seated Flutter Kick
added.namePl: Nożyce poziome w siadzie
instructions: Sit with your hands behind you and lean back slightly.
Lift both legs off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in short alternating moves.
Keep your core tight and your back from rounding.
Continue for time.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Spider Curl with Chest Support
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion pająk z hantlem jednorącz z podparciem klatki piersiowej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with one arm hanging, dumbbell in hand.
Keep your upper arm vertical.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower fully.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Twist Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka ze skrętem
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push up and rotate one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Side Bear Crawl
added.namePl: Boczne chodzenie niedźwiedzia
instructions: Get on hands and toes with knees just off the floor.
Keep your back flat.
Step the hand and foot on one side out, then bring the other pair along.
Move several steps one way, then return.
Stay low and keep your hips steady.

added.name: Static Lunge Kick
added.namePl: Wykrok statyczny z kopnięciem
instructions: Step into a lunge with your front knee over your ankle.
Lower down until both knees are bent.
Drive up through the front foot.
Swing the back leg forward in a kick.
Return to the lunge and repeat, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Around the World
added.namePl: Around the world z hantlami na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench holding dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out to the sides in a wide arc.
Continue down to your hips.
Reverse the arc to return.

added.name: Dumbbell Flat Around the World
added.namePl: Around the world z hantlami na ławce poziomej
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out and back in a wide arc.
Take them down toward your hips.
Reverse the arc with control.

added.name: Tuck Up
added.namePl: Przyciąganie kolan w podporze
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and hold the floor or your sides for support.
Extend your legs out in front, hovering just above the floor.
Pull your knees toward your chest while curling your torso forward.
Pause briefly at the top with your abs tight.
Extend back out under control without letting your feet touch down, and repeat.

added.name: Jack Burpee with Push Up
added.namePl: Burpee jack z pompką
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up and press back up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode up into a jumping jack, landing softly, then flow into the next rep.

added.name: Band Bent over Rear Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w tył w opadzie tułowia z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends with arms hanging.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

added.name: Dumbbell Alternate Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie hantli nad głowę
instructions: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Press with the other arm.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż z hantlem v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the ball of the opposite foot, ideally on a step.
Rest your free hand on a wall or rail for balance.
Lift your heel as high as you can, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the step level, then repeat and switch legs.

added.name: Push Up Toe Touch
added.namePl: Pompka z dotknięciem palców u stóp
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower your chest and push back up.
Lift your hips and reach one hand to the opposite foot.
Return to plank.
Alternate hands each rep.

added.name: Seated Side to Side Leg Raise Crunch on Floor
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z unoszeniem nóg na boki w siadzie na podłodze
instructions: Sit and lean back on your hands, legs lifted.
Swing both knees to one side while crunching in.
Return through the middle.
Swing to the other side.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

added.name: Cross Body Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z przenoszeniem ciężaru na bok
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Push up and cross one hand over toward the other side.
Place it down and repeat.
Alternate the crossing hand.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise with Chest Support
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli przodem na ławce skośnej z podparciem klatki piersiowej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest against the pad.

added.name: Finger Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka na palcach dłoni
instructions: Get into a high plank on your fingertips.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up.
Reduce the range if your fingers tire.

added.name: Leg Lift to Chest Front Plank
added.namePl: Deska z przyciąganiem nogi do klatki piersiowej
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Draw one knee toward your chest.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate legs.
Keep your hips level.

added.name: One Arm Front Plank
added.namePl: Deska na jednej ręce
instructions: Start in a high plank with feet wide.
Lift one hand off the floor.
Hold your hips steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

added.name: Push Up Pike Toe Touch
added.namePl: Pompka z pike i dotknięciem palców u stóp
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Do a push up.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Reach one hand to the opposite toe.
Return to plank and alternate.

added.name: Push Up Hand By Hand
added.namePl: Pompka z przestawianiem dłoni
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Step one hand wider, then the other.
Do another push up.
Step your hands back in.

added.name: Ez Bar Front Twist Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie sztangi łamanej przodem ze skrętem
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar at thigh height.
Raise it forward to chest height.
Rotate your wrists as you lift.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Barbell Incline Wrist Curl with Chest Support
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków ze sztangą na ławce skośnej z podparciem klatki piersiowej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with the barbell in hands, palms up.
Let your wrists extend gently.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Barbell Incline Reverse Grip Spider Curl with Chest Support
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion pająk ze sztangą nachwytem na ławce skośnej z podparciem klatki piersiowej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell overhand.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Curl the bar up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower fully with control.

added.name: Ez Bar Incline Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie sztangi łamanej przodem na ławce skośnej
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with the EZ bar at thighs.
Keep arms straight with a slight bend.
Raise the bar to eye level.
Lower under control.
Keep your back on the pad.

added.name: Ez Bar Seated Close Grip Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi łamanej nad głowę wąskim chwytem w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright holding the EZ bar with a close grip at your chest.
Brace your core.
Press the bar overhead.
Lower it back to chest height.
Keep your ribs down.

added.name: Barbell Bent over Wide Alternate Row Plus
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wiosłowanie szerokim chwytem ze sztangą w opadzie tułowia plus
instructions: Hinge forward holding the barbell with a wide grip.
Keep your back flat.
Pull one side toward your ribs.
Lower and pull the other side.
Keep your hips still.

added.name: Barbell Bent over Wide Row Plus
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie szerokim chwytem ze sztangą w opadzie tułowia plus
instructions: Hinge forward with a wide overhand grip.
Keep a flat back.
Row the bar toward your upper abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Push Up Front Raise
added.namePl: Pompka z unoszeniem hantli przodem
instructions: Start in a high plank gripping two dumbbells.
Do a push up.
Lift one dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate arms.

added.name: Standing Air Bike
added.namePl: Rowerek w powietrzu stojąc
instructions: Stand with hands behind your head.
Lift one knee while rotating your torso.
Touch your elbow to the knee.
Switch sides in a pedaling rhythm.
Stay upright.

added.name: Static Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok statyczny
instructions: Step one foot forward and stay in a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Push through the front heel.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Alternate Leg Raise with Head Up
added.namePl: Naprzemienne unoszenie nóg z uniesioną głową
instructions: Lie on your back with your head slightly lifted.
Raise one leg to vertical.
Lower it without touching the floor.
Raise the other leg.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

added.name: V Up Double Crunch
added.namePl: Podwójne spięcia brzucha v-up
instructions: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Crunch in again.
Lower with control.
Keep your legs straight.

added.name: V Up with Clap
added.namePl: V-up z klaśnięciem
instructions: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Clap above your shins.
Lower with control.
Repeat smoothly.

added.name: Place Jog
added.namePl: Bieg w miejscu
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent.
Jog in place, lifting your knees.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady pace.
Continue for 1-5 minutes.

added.name: 90 Degree Heel Touch
added.namePl: Dotykanie pięt pod kątem 90 stopni
instructions: Lie with your legs up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lift your shoulders.
Reach one hand toward the heel.
Switch sides.
Keep your legs still.

added.name: Straight Leg Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z prostymi nogami
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up to sitting.
Lower with control.
Do not pull on your neck.

added.name: Long Arm Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z wyprostowanymi ramionami
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight overhead.
Bend your knees.
Crunch up reaching forward.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms by your ears.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel in front of a low cable and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your abs.
Press the handles overhead.
Lower under control.
Keep your hips tall.

added.name: Cable Bent over Row with Bar
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia na wyciągu z drążkiem
instructions: Face the low pulley and hinge forward holding the bar.
Keep a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your waist.
Squeeze your back.
Extend your arms slowly.

added.name: Cable Incline Cross Rear Fly
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki na krzyż na wyciągu na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cables, holding opposite handles.
Keep elbows slightly bent.
Pull your arms out and back.
Pause.
Return slowly.

added.name: Cable Lying Cross Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie bokiem na krzyż w leżeniu na wyciągu
instructions: Lie on a bench with a cable running across your body.
Hold the handle with the far hand.
Raise the arm out to the side.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable Standing Front Raise Variation
added.namePl: Unoszenie przodem stojąc na wyciągu (wariant)
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley.
Hold the handle with a slight elbow bend.
Raise the arm to eye level.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Close Grip Press Variation
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli wąskim chwytem na ławce skośnej (wariant)
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells together over your chest.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Lower to your chest.
Press up.
Keep the dumbbells touching.

added.name: Barbell Seated Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy ze sztangą w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright holding the barbell at thigh level.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders to your ears.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Spider Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion pająk z hantlem jednorącz stojąc
instructions: Stand and hinge forward, bracing against a support.
Let one arm hang with a dumbbell.
Curl up.
Squeeze.
Lower and switch arms.

added.name: Lying Leg Hip Raise on Floor V. 2
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg i bioder w leżeniu na podłodze v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

added.name: Reverse Crunch V. 2
added.namePl: Odwrotne spięcia brzucha v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your legs.
Curl hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

added.name: Criss Cross Leg Raises
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg na krzyż
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and raised.
Lower them slightly.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch the cross.
Keep your lower back down.

added.name: Seated 8 Leg Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w siadzie z ósemką nóg
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and support yourself with your hands behind you.
Lift both feet off the floor and brace your core.
Draw a figure eight in the air with your legs, slow and controlled.
Keep your chest lifted and your lower back from collapsing.
Lower your feet and rest, then repeat.

added.name: Band Hip Adduction
added.namePl: Przywodzenie biodra z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle nearest the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Pull the working leg across in front of the other leg.
Pause for a moment and return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Bar Grip Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo z hantlem trzymanym za drążek
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out.
Hold the dumbbell vertically by its bar with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down while keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

added.name: Band Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie biodra z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle farthest from the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the working leg out to the side without leaning.
Pause, then lower slowly against the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Band Standing Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nogi stojąc z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Stand tall facing the anchor and hold a support.
Bend your knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Keep your thighs together and hips still.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Band Standing Hip Extension
added.namePl: Wyprost biodra stojąc z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Stand facing the anchor, holding a support and keeping your torso upright.
Press the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Resistance Band Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg z gumą oporową
instructions: Attach the band to a low anchor and loop the handle around one ankle.
Face the anchor and hold a support for balance.
Curl your heel toward your glute.
Keep your knees close and your hips steady.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Landmine One Arm Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w opadzie tułowia z landmine
instructions: Load the landmine bar and stand over it with a hip hinge, knees soft.
Grip the bar end with one hand and keep your back flat.
Pull the bar toward your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Landmine One Arm Bent over Bench Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w opadzie tułowia z landmine z podparciem na ławce
instructions: Set the landmine bar next to a bench and place one hand and knee on the bench.
Grip the bar end with your free hand and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow up toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Landmine Rear Lunge V. 2
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z landmine v. 2
instructions: Hold the bar end against your chest with both hands.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your front heel down and your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist (On Stability Ball)
added.namePl: Russian twist z hantlem (na piłce gimnastycznej)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it, hips lifted.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Rotate your torso and arms to one side.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your hips high and move with control.

added.name: Cable Seated Cross Arm Twist
added.namePl: Skręty z krzyżowaniem ramion na wyciągu w siadzie
instructions: Sit next to a cable machine set at chest height and grab the handle with both hands.
Start with your arms extended in front of you.
Rotate your torso away from the stack, pulling the handle across your body.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your hips still, finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Inverted Shrug (On Parallel Bars)
added.namePl: Odwrócone szrugsy (na poręczach)
instructions: Grip the parallel bars and hang in an inverted position with arms straight.
Keep your body stable and your elbows locked.
Draw your shoulder blades down and together, pulling your body up a little.
Lower back to a full hang under control.
Repeat for controlled reps.

added.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge with Knee to Chest
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy jednonóż z kolanem do klatki piersiowej
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the foot flat, the other knee pulled toward your chest.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands and stand tall.
Take a big step to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and both feet flat.
Push back to the start and alternate sides.

added.name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes angled out, the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with both hands.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Lower the kettlebell under control.

added.name: Kettlebell Dead Bug
added.namePl: Dead bug z kettlebellem
instructions: Lie on your back and hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your knees to a tabletop position.
Slowly extend one leg while pressing your lower back into the floor.
Bring the leg back and switch.
Keep the kettlebell steady and breathe.

added.name: Dumbbell Ipsilateral Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad wykroczny z hantlem po tej samej stronie
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and step into a split stance, the dumbbell on the same side as your front leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Inverted Shrug
added.namePl: Odwrócone szrugsy
instructions: Set up under a bar or rings and hang with straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back to rise a little.
Hold briefly, then lower to a full hang.
Repeat for controlled reps.

added.name: Battling Ropes Half Kneeling
added.namePl: Liny bojowe w półklęku
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a rope end in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Make fast alternating waves with your arms.
Keep the rhythm steady for a set time.
Switch the front leg for the next set.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Gittleson Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy gittlesona z hantlami w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without rolling your shoulders.

added.name: Dumbbell One Arm Triceps Extension on Stability Ball
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia z hantlem jednorącz na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball and hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arm back up.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise on Stability Ball
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli bokiem w siadzie na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Dead Bug with Stability Ball
added.namePl: Dead bug z piłką gimnastyczną
instructions: Lie on your back and hold the ball above your chest with your knees raised.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend your opposite arm and leg away, holding the ball with the rest.
Return to the center.
Alternate sides slowly.

added.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get Up to Hand
added.namePl: Turecki wstań do podparcia na ręce z kettlebellem
instructions: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same-side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell.
Roll up onto your opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Hold the seated position with your arm vertical.
Reverse the steps to lie back down, then switch sides.

added.name: Leg Raise Dragon Flag
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg dragon flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your hips and legs so your body is straight from shoulders to toes.
Keep your body rigid and lower slowly without sitting.
Raise your legs back up under control.
Stop before your lower back arches.

added.name: Kettlebell Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad wykroczny z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and take a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Bird Dog Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z bird dog
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up with elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg and hold briefly.
Return and alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Barbell Banded Bench Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad ze sztangą na ławkę z gumami
instructions: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back with bands attached.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down until you touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees pushing out.
Drive through your heels to stand.

added.name: Lever Lying Banded T Bar Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie t-bar w leżeniu na maszynie z gumami
instructions: Lie chest down on the support and grip the handles.
Keep your head neutral.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.

added.name: Band Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Barbell Squat with Chains
added.namePl: Przysiad ze sztangą z łańcuchami
instructions: Set chains on the bar and unrack it onto your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through your feet.
Keep your core braced throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Arnold Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie arnolda z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Brace your core.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower while rotating back.
Alternate arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Bent over Alternate Rear Delt Fly
added.namePl: Naprzemienne odwrotne rozpiętki z hantlami w opadzie tułowia w siadzie
instructions: Sit at the edge of a bench and lean forward with dumbbells hanging below your knees.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly bent.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Alternate Arnold Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie arnolda z hantlami
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower it while rotating back.
Alternate arms.
Keep your back against the pad and avoid arching.

added.name: Barbell Bench Press with 3 Board
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi leżąc z 3 deskami
instructions: Lie on a bench with three boards stacked on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

added.name: Barbell Bench Press with 2 Board
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi leżąc z 2 deskami
instructions: Lie on a bench with two boards stacked on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

added.name: Barbell Bench Press with 1 Board
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi leżąc z 1 deską
instructions: Lie on a bench with a single board on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the board.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Front Raise with Chest Support
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla przodem jednorącz na ławce skośnej z podparciem klatki piersiowej
instructions: Set an incline bench and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Wall Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż przy ścianie z masą ciała
instructions: Lean your back on a wall and lift one foot off the floor.
Place your standing foot forward.
Slide down into a squat as far as you can control.
Press through your heel to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Band Low Chest Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki z gumą nisko
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Sweep your hands up and together in front of your chest.
Return slowly.

added.name: Band Low Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie z gumą nisko
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at chest level.
Step forward into a staggered stance.
Press your hands up and forward.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Band Chest Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly under control.

added.name: Band Cross Body One Arm Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz z gumą na krzyż
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and hold the end in one hand.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press your hand forward and across your body.
Return slowly while resisting rotation.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Band Low Alternate Chest Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie z gumą nisko
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold both ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press one hand up and forward.
Return, then press the other hand.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Band Alternate Low Chest Fly
added.namePl: Naprzemienne rozpiętki z gumą nisko
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Sweep one arm up and across in front of your chest.
Return slowly.
Alternate arms.

added.name: Band Standing Alternate Chest Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie z gumą stojąc
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold both ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press one hand straight forward.
Return and press the other hand.
Keep your torso steady.

added.name: Band Kneeling Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w klęku z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Return slowly.

added.name: Band Reverse Crunch
added.namePl: Odwrotne spięcia brzucha z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back with the band anchored overhead and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and lift your feet.
Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Band Overhead Side Bend
added.namePl: Skłony boczne z gumą nad głową
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends overhead.
Keep your core braced.
Bend sideways at your waist.
Return to upright.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Band Upper Crunch
added.namePl: Górne spięcia brzucha z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band anchored overhead, ends in hand.
Hold the band near your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Band Horizontal Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion w poziomie z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and face away from the anchor, holding the ends.
Step out until the band is taut and raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your hands toward your head.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your arms again.
Keep your elbows level with your shoulders the whole time.

added.name: Band Kneeling Preacher Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion na modlitewniku w klęku z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band low and kneel facing it with your upper arms resting on a bench or pad.
Hold the band ends with palms up and arms extended.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms pressed down on the pad.

added.name: Band Standard Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion standardowe z gumą
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart and grip the ends.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists neutral throughout.

added.name: Band 45 Degrees Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z gumą pod kątem 45 stopni
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends, then set your arms about 45 degrees behind your torso.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
Curl your hands up while your upper arms stay in that angled position.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.
Avoid leaning back to finish the rep.

added.name: Band Cross Chest Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z gumą przez klatkę piersiową
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Curl one hand across your chest toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower under control, then repeat on the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.

added.name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

added.name: Landmine Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo z landmine
instructions: Stand facing the landmine anchor with a wide stance and hold the bar end against your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows tucked in.
Sit down between your legs, knees tracking over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand tall.

added.name: Twist Superman
added.namePl: Superman ze skrętem
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Rotate your torso slightly to one side while holding the lift.
Return to the center, then rotate to the other side.
Lower down with control and keep your neck neutral.

added.name: Weighted Seated Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion z obciążeniem w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright on a bench and hold the weight overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to straighten them fully.
Keep your back straight and core tight.

added.name: Wheel Rollout with Wall Support
added.namePl: Rollout z kółkiem z podparciem o ścianę
instructions: Kneel facing a wall with the ab wheel on the floor in front of you.
Grip the handles and tuck your pelvis under.
Roll forward until the wheel touches the wall.
Pull the wheel back by contracting your abs.
Keep your back flat and avoid sagging at the hips.

added.name: Suspender Forward Lunge with Rear Fly
added.namePl: Wykrok w przód z odwrotnymi rozpiętkami na zawieszeniu
instructions: Hold the straps with both hands, leaning back slightly with arms extended.
Step one foot forward into a lunge.
As you lower, pull your arms out wide in a rear fly.
Push through the front foot to return to standing and bring your hands together.
Switch legs on the next rep.

added.name: Crunch with Leg Lift
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z uniesieniem nóg
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs extended.
Crunch your shoulders off the floor.
At the same time lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

added.name: Wall Press Heel Tap
added.namePl: Dotykanie pięt przy ścianie
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees and feet flat on a wall.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one heel to tap the floor while the other foot stays on the wall.
Return and tap with the other heel.
Move slowly without arching your back.

added.name: Reverse Crunch to Dead Bug
added.namePl: Odwrotne spięcia brzucha do dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips.
Curl your pelvis off the floor in a reverse crunch.
Lower your hips and extend one leg and the opposite arm.
Return to the start, then repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back flat.

added.name: Kettlebell Side Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Take a big step to the side.
Sit back into that hip while keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Medicine Ball Half Kneeling Chest Push
added.namePl: Pchnięcie piłki lekarskiej w półklęku
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Push the ball forward explosively or against a wall.
Catch it or bring it back to your chest.
Switch the kneeling leg after your set.

added.name: Sled Wide Hack Squat
added.namePl: Szeroki przysiad hack na suwnicy
instructions: Set your back on the pad and place your feet wide and slightly turned out on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the platform.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking out.
Keep your hips and back against the pad.

added.name: Weighted Straight Leg Toe Touch Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z dotykaniem palców prostymi nogami z obciążeniem
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight up and a weight held in both hands.
Reach the weight toward your toes.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Keep your legs vertical and your neck relaxed.

added.name: Weighted Chin Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem z obciążeniem
instructions: Attach the weight with a belt and grip the bar with palms facing you.
Hang with arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bar.
Lower under control to full extension.

added.name: Trap Bar Standing Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy stojąc ze sztangą trap
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and lift it, holding the handles at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and do not roll your shoulders.

added.name: Trap Bar Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia ze sztangą trap
instructions: Stand in the trap bar and hinge forward with a flat back, gripping the handles.
Brace your core.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.

added.name: Trap Bar Deadlift from Deficit
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą trap z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand on a low platform inside the trap bar.
Squat down and grip the handles with a flat back.
Brace and push the floor away.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower the bar with control to the start.

added.name: Cable Split Stance Horizontal Pallof Press
added.namePl: Poziome wyciskanie pallof na wyciągu w rozkroku
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return the handle to your chest, then switch sides.

added.name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift from Blocks
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo ze sztangą z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes out in front of a bar on blocks.
Grip the bar inside your knees and set a flat back.
Push the floor apart with your feet and stand up.
Lock out by squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Arnold Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie arnolda z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at chest height with palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Fully extend your arms overhead.
Lower while rotating back to palms facing you.
Keep your core tight and avoid arching.

added.name: Resistance Band Adduction Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad wykroczny z przywodzeniem z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band to the side and loop it around the working leg.
Step into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press back up while resisting the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Zottman Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion zottmana z hantlami w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells with palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
At the top rotate your palms to face down.
Lower slowly in that reverse grip.
Rotate your palms back up at the bottom.

added.name: Cable Seated Horizontal Shrug
added.namePl: Poziome szrugsy na wyciągu w siadzie
instructions: Sit facing a low cable with a handle in each hand.
Start with arms straight and shoulders forward.
Pull your shoulders back and up.
Squeeze your traps at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Battling Ropes Seated
added.namePl: Liny bojowe w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a bench holding the ends of the ropes.
Brace your core.
Whip the ropes up and down in alternating waves.
Keep a steady fast rhythm for 20-30 seconds.
Rest, then repeat.

added.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński z landmine
instructions: Stand holding the end of the bar close to your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back.
