added.namePl: Naprzemienny krok w bok
instructions: Stand with feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step one foot out to the side.
Bring it back and step the other foot out.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Alternating Hamstring Curl with Punches
added.namePl: Naprzemienne uginanie nóg z ciosami
instructions: Stand tall with your fists in front of your chin.
Curl one heel up toward your glute.
Punch forward as you curl the leg.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm and stay light on your feet.

added.name: Jack Step
added.namePl: Jack step
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising your arms overhead.
Step it back as you lower your arms.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Dumbbell Power Clean and Jerk
added.namePl: Zarzut i podrzut z hantlami
instructions: Stand over dumbbells with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip them with a flat back.
Pull explosively, extend your hips and shrug.
Catch the dumbbells at your shoulders, then dip and drive them overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then the floor with control.

added.name: Kettlebell Step Up V. 2
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie z kettlebellem v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a bench or box holding a kettlebell.
Place one foot flat on the box.
Press through that heel to stand up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Walking Lunge
added.namePl: Chodzone wykroki z kettlebellami na barkach z przodu
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the front rack, elbows tucked and close to your ribs.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Keep your torso upright and the bells steady against your chest.
Continue alternating legs for the planned distance.

added.name: Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Bułgarski przysiad wykroczny z asystą
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and hold a sturdy post or rack with one hand for balance.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

added.name: Dumbbell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Bułgarski przysiad wykroczny z hantlami i asystą
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

added.name: Kettlebell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Bułgarski przysiad wykroczny z kettlebellem i asystą
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

added.name: Resistance Band Seated Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull z gumą oporową w siadzie
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and sit facing it, holding the ends with both hands.
Sit tall with arms extended and the band under light tension.
Pull the band toward your face, flaring your elbows out and high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly, then return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling One Arm Bottoms Up Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie kettlebella do góry dnem jednorącz w półklęku
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot flat in front, back upright.
Hold a kettlebell by the handle with the bell pointing up, at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and brace your core.
Press straight overhead while keeping the bell balanced.
Lower under control back to the shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Elevated Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy z podwyższeniem i gumą oporową
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet on a bench and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Bend your knees and place your arms by your sides.
Push your knees out against the band and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Hang Clean
added.namePl: Zarzut z zawisu z hantlami
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs, then push your hips back to lower them to the knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward powerfully and shrug.
Pull the dumbbells up close to your body and rotate your elbows under them.
Catch them on your shoulders in a slight quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower them back to your thighs and reset.

added.name: Suspender Wide Grip Inverted Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone szerokim chwytem na zawieszeniu
instructions: Hold the handles of a suspension trainer with a wide overhand grip and lean back, arms straight.
Walk your feet forward to set the difficulty.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.

added.name: Suspension Wide Grip Inverted Row on Floor
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone szerokim chwytem na zawieszeniu przy podłodze
instructions: Hold the handles with a wide, overhand grip and lie back with your body straight.
Keep your heels on the floor and your core tight.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

added.name: Band Bent over Wide Grip Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie szerokim chwytem w opadzie tułowia z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip width apart and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your torso still throughout.

added.name: Band One Arm Standing Wide Grip Low Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie nisko szerokim chwytem jednorącz stojąc z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band low and stand facing it, holding the end in one hand.
Step back until the band is taut, feet hip width apart.
Pull your elbow back and out, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Band Seated Wide Grip Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie szerokim chwytem w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and loop the band around your feet.
Grab the band with a wide grip and sit tall.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control and repeat.

added.name: 45 Degrees Back Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie pleców 45 stopni
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them behind your head.
Lower your torso with a straight spine until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso by squeezing your glutes and lower back.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Avoid over-arching at the top.

added.name: Glute Ham Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Glute ham raise v. 2
instructions: Set your feet on the platform with your thighs against the pad and knees just behind it.
Start with your torso hanging down and your body straight.
Curl your body up by bending your knees and squeezing your hamstrings.
Finish with hips extended and torso upright.
Lower slowly with control, keeping your hips locked.
Repeat for reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Side Bridge with Bent Leg
added.namePl: Mostek boczny z hantlem i zgiętą nogą
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting on your hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from head to knees.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep your hips stacked and do not sink.
Lower and switch sides after your set.

added.name: Side Bridge with Straight Legs
added.namePl: Mostek boczny z prostymi nogami
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your core tight and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds without letting your hips sag.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

added.name: Lying Ab Press
added.namePl: Ab press w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees toward your chest.
Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze.
Return slowly without letting your feet touch down.
Repeat for reps.

added.name: Bodyweight Full Squat with Overhead Press
added.namePl: Pełny przysiad z masą ciała z wyciskaniem nad głowę
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs pass parallel.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Press both arms overhead as you reach the top.
Lower your hands back to your shoulders.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

added.name: Kneeling Shoulder Tap
added.namePl: Dotykanie barków w klęku
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees slightly into a kneeling plank.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place it back down without rocking your hips.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your abs tight throughout.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Thruster
added.namePl: Thruster z kettlebellem jednorącz
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand in the rack position.
Squat down with your chest up and elbow close.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, repeat, then switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Press Up
added.namePl: Pompka z kettlebellem
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Extend your legs into a plank position.
Lower your chest between the handles with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up until your arms are straight and repeat.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg jednonóż z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward at the hips while extending the free leg back.
Lower the kettlebell toward the floor with a flat back.
Keep your hips level and your standing knee slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Side Squat Step
added.namePl: Przysiad z krokiem w bok z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Step out to the side and sit back into a squat.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels and bring your feet together.
Alternate directions or complete all steps on one side before switching.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Swing
added.namePl: Wymach kettlebella jednorącz
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let the arm stay relaxed; the hips do the work.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again. Switch hands after your set.

added.name: Kettlebell Farmers Walk
added.namePl: Spacer farmera z kettlebellami
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and brace your core.
Walk forward in controlled steps.
Keep the kettlebells from swinging.
Walk for a set distance or time, then set them down carefully.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean
added.namePl: Zarzut kettlebella jednorącz
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back slightly between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around so it lands softly in the rack position.
Lower it back down under control, repeat, then switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean and Press
added.namePl: Zarzut i wyciskanie kettlebella jednorącz
instructions: Hinge and swing the kettlebell back, then clean it to your shoulder.
Settle into a stable rack position with your core tight.
Bend your knees slightly, then press the bell straight overhead.
Lock out your elbow with your biceps near your ear.
Lower it to your shoulder, then to the floor. Switch arms after your set.

added.name: Kettlebell Snatch
added.namePl: Rwanie kettlebella
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Punch your hand through to catch it overhead with a straight arm.
Lower it back under control and repeat, then switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Forward Lunge and Press
added.namePl: Wykrok w przód z wyciskaniem kettlebella
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder in the rack position.
Step forward into a lunge.
As you push back up, press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower the bell to your shoulder as you step back.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

added.name: Kettlebell Standing Slingshots
added.namePl: Slingshoty z kettlebellem stojąc
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Pass it behind your back from one hand to the other.
Bring it around to the front and pass it again.
Keep your hips steady and your core tight.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z kettlebellem jednorącz
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a kettlebell held straight up in one hand.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your arm locked.
Curl up and sit all the way to standing or upright.
Control your descent back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Rear Delt Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na tylne aktony z kettlebellem
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Let the weights hang below your chest.
Pull your elbows out wide and up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Kettlebell Bent Arm Pullover with Knees Bent
added.namePl: Pullover z kettlebellem z ugiętymi ramionami i kolanami
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with elbows slightly bent.
Lower it back over your head, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Keep your lower back close to the floor.
Pull it back over your chest and repeat.

added.name: Diamond Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie diamentowe
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.

added.name: Dumbbell One Arm Thruster
added.namePl: Thruster z hantlem jednorącz
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with one hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you sink into the next squat.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell One Arm Thruster
added.namePl: Thruster z kettlebellem jednorącz
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your torso upright and elbow close to your body.
Stand up powerfully through your heels.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you rise, finishing with a straight arm.
Lower it back to the rack and go into the next squat.
Switch arms after your set.

added.name: Kettlebell Clean and Jerk
added.namePl: Zarzut i podrzut z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge to grab it.
Swing it back between your legs, then drive your hips forward.
Pull the bell up and guide it into the rack position at your shoulder.
Dip slightly with your knees, then explode up.
Punch the kettlebell overhead and lock out your arm.
Lower it back to the rack, then to the floor with control. Switch sides.

added.name: Band Incline Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na ławce skośnej z gumą
instructions: Set an incline bench and anchor a band behind it or under the bench.
Sit back with the band handles at chest level.
Brace your core and keep your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles up and slightly forward until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to the start, feeling the band pull.
Keep your wrists straight throughout.

added.name: Cable Bent over Single Arm Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie jednorącz w opadzie tułowia na wyciągu
instructions: Set a low pulley with a single handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Hold the handle with your elbow bent at your side, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow back.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Smith Drag Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z przeciąganiem wzdłuż tułowia na maszynie smitha
instructions: Stand close to the smith bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang at arm length against your thighs.
Pull your elbows back and drag the bar up along your torso.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar along the same line with control.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Good Morning Squat
added.namePl: Good morning z przysiadem
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Come back up to standing.
Bend your knees and sink into a squat with your chest tall.
Stand up and repeat the hinge, then the squat.
Keep your core braced and your weight over your mid-foot.

added.name: Burpee Squat
added.namePl: Burpee z przysiadem
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest down, then press back up.
Jump your feet forward to your hands.
Stand and finish with a bodyweight squat before the next rep.

added.name: Diagonal Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok po skosie
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot out diagonally, about 45 degrees away from you.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, keeping your chest up.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate legs each rep.
Keep your front knee pointing the same way as your toes.

added.name: Body Extension
added.namePl: Wyprost ciała
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your body upright.
Cross your arms or put your hands on your hips.
Squeeze your glutes and lean back from the knees as one straight line.
Go back as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up to the start.
Keep your hips forward.

added.name: Bodyweight Elevated Heel Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z masą ciała z podwyższonymi piętami
instructions: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knees and sink down with your chest tall.
Let your knees travel forward over your toes.
Drive back up through your whole foot.
Keep your core tight throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Cossack Squats
added.namePl: Przysiady kozackie z hantlem
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with a wide stance.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Sit deep with your chest up and the straight leg's toes pointing up.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center.
Move into the other side.
Alternate sides with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Squat Hold Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce w przysiadzie z hantlami
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and sink into a half squat.
Keep your chest tall and weight over your feet.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly without standing up.
Stay in the squat for the full set.

added.name: Dumbbell Squat Lunges Jump Complex
added.namePl: Kompleks z hantlami przysiad wykrok i skok
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Do a squat and stand back up.
Step into a lunge on each leg.
Finish with a jump, landing softly with bent knees.
Continue the chain without putting the weights down.
Rest, then repeat the sequence.

added.name: Dumbbell Step Up with Knee Raise
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie z unoszeniem kolana z hantlami
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand facing a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel and step up.
Lift the other knee toward your chest at the top.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Cable Neutral Grip Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie chwytem neutralnym na wyciągu
instructions: Set a low cable with a neutral grip handle and hinge forward at the hips.
Pin your upper arm against your side.
Hold the handle with your palm facing in.
Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

added.name: Cable Bent over Single Arm Neutral Grip Kickback with Rope Attachment
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie jednorącz chwytem neutralnym w opadzie tułowia na wyciągu z liną
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end with a neutral grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and tucked in.
Straighten your elbow and pull the rope back.
Squeeze at the end of the motion.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Resistance Band Pull Apart
added.namePl: Rozciąganie gumy oporowej na boki
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height, arms straight.
Keep your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.

added.name: Resistance Band One Arm Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w opadzie tułowia z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand on the band with a staggered stance and hinge forward.
Hold the handle in one hand with your arm extended.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Bent over Neutral Grip Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie chwytem neutralnym w opadzie tułowia z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward.
Hold the handles with a neutral grip, arms straight.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Pull both handles toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

added.name: Resistance Band Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z gumą oporową
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your hands.
Get into a plank position with your body straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up against the band until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.
Lower slowly for the next rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Lift and Chop
added.namePl: Unoszenie i rąbanie z hantlem w półklęku
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a dumbbell with both hands.
Start with the weight by your low outside hip.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Chop it back down along the same line.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Band Half Kneeling Chop
added.namePl: Rąbanie z gumą w półklęku
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel on one knee side-on to the anchor.
Hold the band with both hands near your high shoulder.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Biceps Curl to Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z wyciskaniem nad głowę z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl both dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms to face forward at the top of the curl.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders, then down to your sides.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

added.name: Band Standing Single Arm Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz stojąc z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand facing it.
Hold the band in one hand with your arm extended.
Step back until there is tension and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Band Standing Straight Arm Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie prostych ramion stojąc z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the ends with arms extended in front of you.
Stand with a slight forward lean and a braced core.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull the band down in an arc until your hands reach your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Military Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie żołnierskie z hantlami w półklęku
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
Switch your lead leg halfway through or on the next set.

added.name: Cable Bent over Neutral Grip Kickback with Rope Attachment
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie chwytem neutralnym w opadzie tułowia na wyciągu z liną
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold both ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows and spread the rope slightly at the end.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Bodyweight Step Up on Stepbox
added.namePl: Wejście na step z masą ciała
instructions: Stand facing a step box with feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through your heel to step up and stand tall.
Bring the other foot up to meet it.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch the lead leg.

added.name: Single Arm Push Up (Wall Supported)
added.namePl: Pompka jednorącz (z podparciem o ścianę)
instructions: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place one hand on it at chest height.
Keep your other arm behind your back or at your side.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the wall, body in a straight line.
Press back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Band Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and grab it with both hands.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Lower your hands along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep the band close to your body.

added.name: Band Standing Hammer Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion chwytem młotkowym stojąc z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

added.name: Twisting Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha ze skrętem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

added.name: Dumbbell Close Grip Shoulder Press Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z wyciskaniem hantli wąskim chwytem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in.
Sit up using your abs.
Press the dumbbells overhead at the top.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down slowly.
Keep your feet planted, or anchor them if needed.

added.name: Dumbbell Front Plank Arm Raise
added.namePl: Deska z unoszeniem ramienia z hantlem
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and keep hips level.
Lift the dumbbell forward in line with your torso.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms for the set.

added.name: Weighted Seated Tuck Crunch on Floor
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z podkurczeniem w siadzie na podłodze z obciążeniem
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a weight at your chest, leaning back slightly with legs extended.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in while bringing your chest forward.
Extend your legs again without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and breathe steadily.

added.name: Dumbbell Crunch Up
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z hantlem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell held against your chest.
Brace your abs.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist Close Grip Shoulder Press Sit Up
added.namePl: Russian twist z brzuszkiem i wyciskaniem hantli wąskim chwytem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit up and rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate back to center and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Tuck Crunch on Floor
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z podkurczeniem w siadzie na podłodze z hantlem
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs and lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out under control.
Keep your spine long throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Front Plank Arm Leg Raise
added.namePl: Deska z unoszeniem ramienia i nogi z hantlem
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift the dumbbell forward and the opposite leg back at the same time.
Lower both under control.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Tuck Twisting Crunch on Floor
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha ze skrętem i podkurczeniem w siadzie na podłodze z hantlem
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in and rotate your torso to one side.
Extend your legs and rotate back to center.
Repeat on the other side.

added.name: Dumbbell Renegade Row to Squat
added.namePl: Renegade row z hantlami do przysiadu
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Row one dumbbell to your hip, keeping hips level.
Lower it, then hop or step your feet toward your hands.
Stand up with the dumbbells and squat down.
Return to plank and alternate the rowing arm.

added.name: High Knee to Butt Kick
added.namePl: Wysokie kolana do pięt do pośladków
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up to hip height.
Lower it and kick the same heel toward your glutes.
Alternate sides at a steady, light pace.
Keep your core braced and stay on the balls of your feet.

added.name: Russian Twist with Hands on Chest
added.namePl: Russian twist z rękami na klatce piersiowej
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Cross your hands over your chest.
Lift your feet slightly off the floor if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side, then to the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.

added.name: Kneeling Shoulder Tap Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z dotykaniem barku w klęku
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, then switch.
Keep your hips steady and repeat.

added.name: Backhand Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion tyłem
instructions: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms up.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Raise your hands up and back by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Bodyweight Overhead Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową z masą ciała
instructions: Place your hands on a bar or sturdy surface at about waist height, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back and lean forward in a plank.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your body straight.
Press back up by extending your arms and repeat.

added.name: Kneeling Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust w klęku
instructions: Kneel upright with your hips over your knees and your arms by your sides.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes.
Stand tall at the top without leaning back.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Plyo Side Lunge Stretch
added.namePl: Plyometryczne rozciąganie w wykroku bocznym
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Straighten the other leg and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Push off to hop to the other side.
Continue alternating at a controlled pace.

added.name: Band Kneeling Single Leg Kick
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie jednonóż w klęku z gumą
instructions: Get on all fours with a band looped around your foot and hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend one leg back, squeezing your glute.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Return with control and repeat, then switch legs.

added.name: Band Swing
added.namePl: Wymach z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band holding the other end with both hands.
Hinge your hips back with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to swing your arms up to chest height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Control the return and repeat.

added.name: Band Split Squat V. 2
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z gumą v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band with your front foot and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Step your other foot back into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Drive up through the front foot, then switch legs after your set.

added.name: Band Standing Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion stojąc z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and hold the ends with both hands.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Press your hands down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Let your hands rise slowly and repeat.

added.name: Band Lying Alternate Leg Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wypychanie nóg w leżeniu z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back and loop the band around the soles of your feet, holding the ends.
Bend both knees toward your chest.
Press one foot out straight against the band.
Bring it back and press the other leg.
Alternate smoothly with control.

added.name: Band Bent over Rear Delt Fly
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki w opadzie tułowia z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slight elbow bends.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Band Squat V. 2
added.namePl: Przysiad z gumą v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down.
Go to at least parallel without letting your knees cave in.
Drive up through your heels and repeat.

added.name: Band Kneeling Incline Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na skosie w klęku z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and kneel facing away from it.
Hold the ends at chest height.
Press your hands up and forward at an incline.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly with control and repeat.

added.name: Band Standing Side Bend
added.namePl: Skłony boczne stojąc z gumą
instructions: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other end at your side.
Keep your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend sideways at the waist away from the band.
Squeeze your obliques and return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Band Standing Behind Head Military Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie żołnierskie zza głowy stojąc z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head at shoulder level.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press your hands straight overhead.
Lock out your arms without shrugging.
Lower slowly back behind your head and repeat.

added.name: Resistance Band Hammer Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion chwytem młotkowym z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the handles with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly under tension.

added.name: Resistance Band Triceps Pushdown
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band high and hold the handles with elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Resistance Band Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the band under your front foot and handles at your shoulders.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

added.name: Leg over Knee Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder z nogą na kolanie
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and one ankle crossed over the other knee.
Press through the grounded foot.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides.

added.name: Kneeling Side Leg to Kick
added.namePl: Odwodzenie nogi w bok w klęku
instructions: Kneel on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side, bent.
Extend it into a kick out to the side.
Bend it back in and lower.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

added.name: Bent Knee Back to Side Kick
added.namePl: Kopnięcie z nogi ugiętej do boku
instructions: Start on all fours with a flat back.
Lift one bent knee back and up.
Swing the leg out to the side into a kick.
Return the knee under control.
Switch legs after the set.

added.name: Kneeling Leg Half Circle
added.namePl: Półkola nogą w klęku
instructions: Start on all fours, hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out straight behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return the same way.
Keep your hips square and switch sides.

added.name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension V. 4
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową z gumą v. 4
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Band Standing Single Arm Upright Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie gumy wzdłuż tułowia jednorącz stojąc
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the other end in one hand at your thigh.
Keep your elbow leading the movement.
Pull your hand up toward your chest, elbow higher than the wrist.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then repeat and switch arms.

added.name: Band Skier V. 2
added.namePl: Narciarz z gumą v. 2
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and hold the ends with both hands.
Stand with a slight bend in your knees.
Pull your arms down and back past your hips.
Squeeze your lats and keep your core braced.
Return slowly overhead and repeat.

added.name: Band Bent over Row V. 3
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia z gumą v. 3
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends, hinging forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Band Air Bike
added.namePl: Rowerek w powietrzu z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back with the band looped around your feet and hold the ends.
Raise your legs and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Pedal one leg in while extending the other.
Twist your torso to bring the opposite elbow to the knee.
Keep a steady rhythm and keep your core tight.

added.name: Band Side Bend Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie ze skłonem bocznym z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the end in one hand at your shoulder.
Press the band overhead as you bend gently to the opposite side.
Keep your hips steady and your chest open.
Return to upright as you lower your hand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Band Single Leg Reverse Hyperextension
added.namePl: Odwrotna hiperekstensja jednonóż z gumą
instructions: Lie face down with a band looped around one foot and anchored under you.
Rest your arms under your head.
Lift one leg up, keeping it straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, repeat, then switch legs.

added.name: Alternating Superman
added.namePl: Naprzemienny superman
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg together.
Hold for a second.
Lower and switch to the other side.
Keep your neck neutral and move with control.

added.name: Bodyweight Full Squat with Overhead Press (Version 2)
added.namePl: Pełny przysiad z wyciskaniem nad głowę z masą ciała (wersja 2)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat deep, keeping chest up.
Drive up out of the squat.
Press your arms overhead as you stand.
Lower your hands and repeat.

added.name: Jump Step Jump
added.namePl: Skok, krok, skok
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Jump up and land softly with bent knees.
Step to the side or forward.
Jump again and land softly.
Keep a steady rhythm.

added.name: Basketball Shot Jump
added.namePl: Skok z rzutem do kosza
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with hands at chest height.
Dip into a quarter squat.
Jump up and extend one arm like shooting a basketball.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

added.name: Criss Cross Jack
added.namePl: Jumping jack z krzyżowaniem
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart while the arms swing overhead.
Jump and cross one foot in front and the arms across your chest.
Alternate which side crosses.
Keep a quick but controlled pace.

added.name: Air Squat (Version 2)
added.namePl: Przysiad bez obciążenia (wersja 2)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel with chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Alternating Superman V. 2
added.namePl: Naprzemienny superman v. 2
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Raise your right arm and left leg.
Hold briefly and lower.
Raise your left arm and right leg.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly.

added.name: Assisted Chin Up (Low Bar Position)
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem z asystą (niski drążek)
instructions: Set a bar at about chest height and sit or lie beneath it.
Grip the bar with palms facing you.
Pull your chest toward the bar using your arms and back.
Use your legs only as much as needed.
Lower with control.

added.name: Assisted Commando Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie commando z asystą
instructions: Grip a bar with one hand in front of the other.
Use a band or feet for assistance.
Pull until your head passes the bar to one side.
Lower with control.
Switch the head side on the next rep.

added.name: Band Assisted Chin Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem z gumą wspomagającą
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and the band looped under your feet.
Engage your lats and keep your core tight.
Pull your chin over the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

added.name: Band Assisted Dip (Version 2)
added.namePl: Pompki na poręczach z gumą wspomagającą (wersja 2)
instructions: Loop a band across dip bars and place your knees in it.
Support yourself with straight arms.
Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

added.name: Band Kneeling Crunch V. 2
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w klęku z gumą v. 2
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the band beside your head.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your thighs.
Round your spine and tighten your abs.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Bar Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion ze sztangą
instructions: Stand holding a bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Sissy Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sissy w klęku z masą ciała
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and a support nearby.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips forward.
Lean back slowly as far as you can.
Pull back up with your quads.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.

added.name: Bodyweight Standing Sissy Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sissy stojąc z masą ciała
instructions: Stand holding a support, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Bend your knees forward and lean back.
Lower as far as you can control.
Press back up.

added.name: Chin Up (In Squatting Position)
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem (w pozycji przysiadu)
instructions: Set a low bar and grip it with palms facing you.
Sit into a deep squat beneath it.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower back down.
Use your legs as little as possible.

added.name: Chin Up (Isometric and Negative)
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem (izometria i faza negatywna)
instructions: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position for a few seconds.
Lower yourself slowly over several seconds.
Reset on the floor.
Repeat for the reps.

added.name: Commando Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie commando
instructions: Grab the bar with one hand in front of the other, palms facing each other, and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your body up, moving your head to one side of the bar.
Get your chin or shoulder level with the bar.
Lower under control to a full hang.
Switch which side your head passes on each rep, or each set.

added.name: Crunch (Arms on Chest)
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha (ręce na klatce piersiowej)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Bench Dip
added.namePl: Pompki tyłem na ławce z hantlem
instructions: Sit on a bench edge, hands beside your hips, and slide your hips off the front.
Rest a dumbbell on your thighs, holding it steady with your hips and legs.
Bend your elbows to lower until they reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Bench Dip with Legs Elevated
added.namePl: Pompki tyłem na ławce z hantlem z nogami wyżej
instructions: Place two benches facing each other, hands on one and heels on the other.
Set a dumbbell on your lap and keep your legs straight.
Lower your hips by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Keep your chest up and your elbows pointing back.
Press up until your arms are straight again.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Single Arm Row V. 2
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie hantlem jednorącz w opadzie tułowia v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back, knees slightly bent.
Let the weight hang with your arm straight below your shoulder.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Bridge Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli w mostku na ławce
instructions: Lie on the floor or a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Plant your feet and drive your hips up into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them to chest level under control.
Keep your hips high for the whole set.

added.name: Dumbbell Cossack Squat V. 2
added.namePl: Przysiad kozacki z hantlami v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet wide and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Shift your weight to one side and squat down on that leg.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Drive through the bent leg to stand and shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and your heel down.

added.name: Dumbbell Decline Lying Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg z hantlem w leżeniu na ławce skośnej głową w dół
instructions: Lie face down on a decline bench with the dumbbell held between your feet.
Let your legs hang straight with your hips pressed to the bench.
Curl your heels up toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly to full extension.

added.name: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z hantlem nad głową na ławce skośnej głową w dół
instructions: Hook your feet on a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead behind you.
Curl your torso up, keeping the dumbbell over your head.
Reach the top with your arms above your knees.
Lower back slowly with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Decline Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z hantlem na ławce skośnej głową w dół
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lie back until your torso is just above the bench.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid pulling on your head.
Lower slowly to the start.

added.name: Dumbbell Deep Push Up and Renegade Row
added.namePl: Głęboka pompka i wiosłowanie renegade z hantlami
instructions: Start in a plank with hands on two dumbbells, feet wide.
Lower your chest between the dumbbells in a deep push-up.
Press back up to a plank.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs while bracing to stay level.
Lower it, row the other side, and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Floor Wiper
added.namePl: Wycieraczki z hantlami na podłodze
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back to the middle.
Repeat to the other side, keeping your shoulders flat.

added.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat and Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Przysiad kielichowy z uginaniem ramion z hantlem
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell by one end at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up and elbows inside your knees.
At the bottom, lower the dumbbell and curl it back up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Repeat the full sequence for each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Hang Power Clean
added.namePl: Power clean z zawisu z hantlami
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells and hinge until they hang just above your knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward and shrug as you pull the weights up.
Drop under them and catch at your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower to the hang and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Hang Power Clean and Jerk
added.namePl: Power clean z zawisu i podrzut z hantlami
instructions: Hold dumbbells hanging just above your knees with a flat back.
Explode up and pull the weights to your shoulders, catching in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then dip slightly with your knees.
Drive up and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the hang, and reset.

added.name: Dumbbell Head Supported Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie hantlami z podparciem głowy
instructions: Set a bench at a slight incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your forehead on the top and let your arms hang.
Row both dumbbells toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Biceps Curl V. 3
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z hantlami na ławce skośnej v. 3
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight.
Keep your elbows back and your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Head Supported Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie hantlami z podparciem głowy na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your head on the top of the bench and let your arms hang.
Pull your elbows back and the dumbbells toward your ribs.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

added.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Arnold Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie arnolda z hantlami w klęku
instructions: Kneel tall holding dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Finish with your arms straight overhead.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start.

added.name: Dumbbell Low Windmill
added.namePl: Niski wiatrak z hantlem
instructions: Stand with feet wide and a dumbbell in one hand.
Turn your back foot out and push your hips toward the dumbbell side.
Slide the dumbbell down your leg as you bend sideways and hinge.
Keep both legs mostly straight.
Return to standing and finish the set, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Lying Woodchop
added.namePl: Rąbanie drewna z hantlem w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Sweep the dumbbell diagonally up and across to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso with the movement.
Return under control and switch sides after the set.

added.name: Dumbbell Overhead Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z hantlem nad głową
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat or anchored.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Curl up to a seated position, keeping the dumbbell above you.
Keep your arms by your ears.
Lower back down slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Rdl and Bent over Row
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński i wiosłowanie z hantlami
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees soft.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back, until the dumbbells are below your knees.
Keep your back flat and row both dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower them, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat the full sequence for each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist with Legs Floor Off
added.namePl: Russian twist z hantlem z nogami uniesionymi nad podłogą
instructions: Sit down and lean back slightly with a dumbbell held in both hands.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Rotate your torso to bring the dumbbell beside one hip.
Twist to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your chest up and your back long.

added.name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge V. 2
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder z hantlem v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips and hold it in place.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Side Bench Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad boczny z hantlem na ławce
instructions: Stand sideways to a bench holding a dumbbell at your chest, feet wide.
Shift your weight to the leg nearest the bench.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the other leg straight.
Drive up through your heel and repeat, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Side Lunge with Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny z wyciskaniem hantli nad głowę
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back into a side lunge.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push back to the middle and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower to your shoulders and lunge to the other side.

added.name: Dumbbell Side Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad boczny z hantlami
instructions: Stand with feet wide holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat.
Lower until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż z hantlem
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to raise your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z hantlem
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat or anchored.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest with both hands.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower back down slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Staggered Stance Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński z hantlami w rozkroku krokowym
instructions: Stand with one foot a half step ahead and hold dumbbells in front of you.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstring, back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch feet.

added.name: Dumbbell Step Back Lunge and Row
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z wiosłowaniem hantli
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Hinge your torso slightly forward with a flat back.
Row both dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower them, push through the front foot to stand, and switch legs.

added.name: Elevated Standing Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce stojąc na podwyższeniu
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or block, heels hanging off.
Hold something for balance.
Lower your heels below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise up as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

added.name: Elevated Standing Single Leg Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż stojąc na podwyższeniu
instructions: Stand on one foot with the ball of that foot on a step, other foot lifted.
Hold a wall or rail for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Glute Ham Developer Hip Extension
added.namePl: Wyprost biodra na maszynie glute ham
instructions: Set up on the GHD with your feet planted and hips just past the pad.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to raise back to a straight line.
Do not arch past neutral at the top.

added.name: Glute Ham Developer Sit Up and Russian Twist
added.namePl: Brzuszki i russian twist na maszynie glute ham
instructions: Lock your feet in the GHD and lie back with arms crossed or hands clasped.
Sit up in a controlled way.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the middle and lower back down.
Alternate the twist side each rep.

added.name: Glute Ham Hyperextension Twist
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja ze skrętem na maszynie glute ham
instructions: Position yourself on the bench with hips on the pad and feet locked in.
Cross your arms on your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise up to a straight line and rotate your torso to one side.
Untwist, lower, and alternate sides.

added.name: Glute Ham Single Leg Hyperextension
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja jednonóż na maszynie glute ham
instructions: Set up on the bench with one foot planted and the other lifted behind you.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise to a straight line, squeezing your glute.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Hanging Flutter Kick
added.namePl: Nożyce poziome w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Tighten your core and lift your legs slightly in front of you.
Kick your legs up and down in alternating small movements.
Keep your swing minimal.
Continue for the set time or reps.

added.name: Hanging Knee Circle Raise
added.namePl: Krążenie kolan w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight and legs together.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Move them in a circle to one side and back down.
Keep your body from swinging.
Alternate the circle direction each rep.

added.name: Incline Alternate Flutter Kicks
added.namePl: Naprzemienne nożyce poziome na skosie
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench and hold the edges behind your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down alternately in small motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set time or reps.

added.name: Inverted Row Slide
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone ze ślizgiem
instructions: Lie under a bar or rings and grab with an overhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on a slick surface.
Pull your chest toward the bar while your feet slide forward.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly with control.

added.name: Inverted Wide Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone szerokim chwytem
instructions: Lie under a bar and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your body in a straight line, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control to straight arms.

added.name: Jump Split with Hands on Hip
added.namePl: Wykrok naskokowy z rękami na biodrach
instructions: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Step into a lunge position.
Jump and switch legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge on the other leg.
Keep your chest up and repeat.

added.name: Kneeling Straight Leg Kickback V. 2
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie prostą nogą w klęku v. 2
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg straight behind you with the toes on the floor.
Squeeze the glute and lift the straight leg to hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg without letting the back arch.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Narrow Seated Chin Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem wąskim chwytem w siadzie
instructions: Sit under a low bar with your hands close together, palms facing you.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and arms at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Push Up and Triceps Dip on Parallel Bars
added.namePl: Pompka i pompka na poręczach równoległych
instructions: Place hands on parallel bars and support yourself in a plank.
Lower into a push-up with your elbows out.
Press back up to a plank.
Shift your hands to the edge of the bars, body upright.
Dip down and press up, then repeat the cycle.

added.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Woodchop
added.namePl: Rąbanie drewna w klęku z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso as you chop.
Return slowly, then switch sides.

added.name: Reverse Back Extension on Floor
added.namePl: Odwrotne prostowanie pleców na podłodze
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front or under your head.
Keep your legs straight.
Raise both legs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Reverse Crunch V. 3
added.namePl: Odwrotne spięcia brzucha v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your knees to a tabletop position.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Reverse Flutter Kick on Floor (Hand Under Head)
added.namePl: Odwrotne nożyce poziome na podłodze (dłoń pod głową)
instructions: Lie on your back and place your hands under your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick up and down alternately in small, quick motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set time.

added.name: Seated Chin Up (Low Bar Position)
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem w siadzie (niski drążek)
instructions: Set a bar at a low height and sit under it.
Grab it with an underhand grip, arms extended.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

added.name: Seated Chin Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem w siadzie
instructions: Sit under a bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chin toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Seated Commando Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie commando w siadzie
instructions: Sit under a bar and grab it with one hand in front of the other.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your body up and bring your head to one side.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep or each set.

added.name: Seated Pull Up (Legs Elevated)
added.namePl: Podciąganie nachwytem w siadzie (nogi uniesione)
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and sit under a bar.
Grab it with an overhand grip, arms extended.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

added.name: Seated Pull Up (Low Bar Position)
added.namePl: Podciąganie nachwytem w siadzie (niski drążek)
instructions: Set a bar low and sit beneath it.
Grab it with an overhand grip, a little wider than your shoulders.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

added.name: Seated Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie nachwytem w siadzie
instructions: Sit under a bar and grab it with an overhand grip.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Side Bench Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad boczny na ławce
instructions: Stand sideways to a bench with feet wide.
Shift your weight to the leg nearest the bench.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the other leg straight.
Drive up through your heel and repeat, then switch sides.

added.name: Side Crunch with Hands on Chest
added.namePl: Boczne spięcia brzucha z rękami na klatce piersiowej
instructions: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent and arms crossed over your chest.
Brace your core and lift your shoulders and legs toward each other.
Crunch sideways, squeezing the side of your waist.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled, without pulling on your neck.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Side Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad wykroczny boczny
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Lower until your thigh is parallel.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.

added.name: Side Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad boczny
instructions: Stand with feet wide and your arms in front for balance.
Shift your weight to one leg and sit back and down.
Keep the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the middle and switch sides.

added.name: Single Leg Bench Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż na ławce
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your back to it and lift one foot off the floor.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the working knee in line with your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge (Arms on Chest)
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder jednonóż (ręce na klatce piersiowej)
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly without touching the floor fully.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Leg Hip Thrust V. 2
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż v. 2
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat on the floor.
Lift the other leg off the floor, knee bent or straight.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top until your torso is level.
Lower your hips under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Leg Hip Thrust Jump
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż ze skokiem
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and one foot planted.
Lift the other leg.
Drive up through your heel and thrust your hips explosively.
Let your hips leave the floor briefly.
Land softly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Leg Jumping Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder jednonóż ze skokiem
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg lifted.
Drive through the planted heel and thrust your hips up.
Push hard enough that your hips leave the floor.
Land softly back in the bridge.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Leg Step Up on Bench
added.namePl: Wejście na ławkę jednonóż
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy bench and place one foot fully on top.
Lean slightly forward and press through that heel.
Step up until the leg is straight and you stand tall.
Lower yourself slowly back down with control.
Avoid pushing off the trailing foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Standing Single Leg Calf Raise Balance
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż stojąc na równowagę
instructions: Stand tall on one foot with the other lifted.
Keep your hands on your hips or lightly on a wall.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, steady.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Supported Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z podparciem
instructions: Stand holding a stable support at about chest height, feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can with your heels down.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Use the support for balance, not to pull yourself up.

added.name: Suspender Alternate Superman
added.namePl: Naprzemienny superman na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Place your feet in the suspension straps and get into a plank face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm forward while keeping your body steady.
Return it, then lift the other arm.
Move slowly and avoid sagging your lower back.
Alternate sides for the full set.

added.name: Suspender Rollout V. 2
added.namePl: Rollout na pasach zawieszenia v. 2
instructions: Kneel facing the anchor and hold the suspension handles under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Roll your arms forward as your body leans out in a straight line.
Go only as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Keep your ribs down throughout.

added.name: Table Top Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek stołowy
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Raise until your torso and thighs are level like a tabletop.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your head in line with your spine.
Hold briefly, then lower your hips back to the floor under control.

added.name: Table Top Bridge Rotation
added.namePl: Mostek stołowy z rotacją
instructions: Set up in a table top bridge with hips lifted and hands under your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and both feet.
Lift the free arm and reach it up and over your body as you rotate your chest.
Keep your hips high and level throughout.
Return the arm to the floor and repeat, then switch sides.

added.name: Toe Walk
added.namePl: Chodzenie na palcach
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels lifted as high as you comfortably can.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your core tight and your gaze forward.
Walk for 20-30 steps, rest, and repeat.

added.name: Triceps Press (High Bar Position)
added.namePl: Wyciskanie francuskie (wysoki drążek)
instructions: Set up with a barbell held at arm's length above your head, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Keep your elbows from flaring out.
Extend your arms to press the bar back to the start.

added.name: Triceps Press (Low Bar Position)
added.namePl: Wyciskanie francuskie (niski drążek)
instructions: Hold a barbell at arm's length over your chest, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your elbows tucked.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Pause briefly when the bar is low.
Extend your arms to return the bar to the start.

added.name: Wide Air Squat
added.namePl: Szeroki przysiad bez obciążenia
instructions: Stand with feet well wider than your shoulders and toes angled out.
Raise your arms in front for balance.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

added.name: Wide Seated Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie nachwytem szerokim chwytem w siadzie
instructions: Sit under a pull-up bar and take a wide overhand grip.
Hang with arms extended and your chest lifted.
Pull your elbows down and toward your ribs to bring your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower yourself slowly to full arm extension.

added.name: Wide to Narrow Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z szerokiego do wąskiego chwytu
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the top.
Walk your hands in to a narrow, close position.
Repeat a push-up, then step your hands back out wide.

added.name: Lying Leg Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg w leżeniu v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe steadily through each rep.

added.name: Standing Side Bend V. 2
added.namePl: Skłony boczne stojąc v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and one arm overhead.
Brace your core lightly.
Bend sideways at the waist, reaching over with the raised arm.
Pause when you feel the side muscles work.
Return to upright with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Side Plank V. 3
added.namePl: Deska boczna v. 3
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm under your shoulder.
Stack or stagger your feet.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your neck neutral and your core tight.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

added.name: Side Crunch V. 3
added.namePl: Boczne spięcia brzucha v. 3
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and one hand behind your head.
Rest the other hand on the floor for balance.
Lift your shoulders and knees toward each other.
Squeeze the side of your waist at the top.
Lower slowly without relaxing fully.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Goblet 2 Sec Hold Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad kielichowy z hantlem z zatrzymaniem 2 s
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Squat down with your chest tall until your thighs are at least parallel.
Hold the bottom position for two seconds.
Drive through your heels to stand.

added.name: Kettlebell Good Morning
added.namePl: Good morning z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall again.

added.name: Ring Elevated Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na kółkach z uniesionymi stopami
instructions: Set the rings at about chest height and rest your heels on a bench.
Grab the rings and hang with arms extended and body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control without letting your hips sag.

added.name: Ring Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg na kółkach
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the ring straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Bend your knees to pull your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high the whole time.
Extend your legs slowly to return.

added.name: Ring Reverse Ab Rollout
added.namePl: Odwrotny rollout brzucha na kółkach
instructions: Set up in a push-up position with your feet in the ring straps.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders over your hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis.
Pause with your hips lifted and abs tight.
Extend your legs back to a straight plank slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Step Up on Bench
added.namePl: Wejście na ławkę jednonóż z hantlem
instructions: Stand facing a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Press through that heel to stand up on the bench.
Lower your other foot back down slowly.
