Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Rdl to Jump Shrug
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński z hantlami ze skokiem i szrugsem
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and jump as you shrug your shoulders.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset into the hinge and repeat.

added.name: Diagonal Punch
added.namePl: Uderzenie po przekątnej
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with your fists up.
Rotate your hips and torso as you throw a punch across your body.
Extend your arm fully and pivot your back foot.
Pull the arm back quickly.
Alternate sides at a brisk, controlled pace.

added.name: Alternate Leg Raise
added.namePl: Naprzemienne unoszenie nóg
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg up toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly while lifting the other leg.
Keep alternating without arching your back.

added.name: Push Up in Child Pose
added.namePl: Pompka w pozycji dziecka
instructions: Kneel and sit back on your heels with your arms stretched forward.
Place your hands on the floor at chest height.
Shift forward and lower your chest between your hands.
Push the floor away to rise.
Sit back to the starting pose and repeat.

added.name: Sliding Floor Pulldown on Towel V. 2
added.namePl: Ściąganie ze ślizgiem po podłodze na ręczniku v. 2
instructions: Kneel with your hands on a towel placed on a smooth floor, arms stretched forward.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbows down and back as your hands slide toward you.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Slide back out slowly to the start.

added.name: Lying Rear Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w bok w tył w leżeniu
instructions: Lie face down on a bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang down with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Arnold Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie arnolda jednorącz stojąc z hantlem
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at shoulder height, palm facing you.
Brace your core and keep your other arm at your side.
Press the dumbbell up while rotating your palm to face forward.
Fully extend your arm overhead.
Lower while rotating back, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Alternate Chest Press on Stability Ball
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie hantli na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Sit on a stability ball holding dumbbells and walk out until your upper back rests on it.
Lift your hips so your body forms a bridge.
Press one dumbbell up over your chest.
Lower it slowly while keeping your hips steady.
Alternate arms for each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Rotational Grip Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli z rotacją chwytu na ławce
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at chest level with palms facing each other.
Press the weights up while turning your palms to face forward.
Reach full arm extension over your chest.
Lower the weights while rotating back to a neutral grip.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades tight.

added.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Squeeze Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli podchwytem ze ściśnięciem na ławce
instructions: Lie on a bench holding two dumbbells together over your chest with a reverse (palms toward you) grip.
Squeeze the dumbbells together firmly.
Lower them to your chest with elbows close to your body.
Press back up, keeping the squeeze.
Keep your wrists straight throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie hantlem jednorącz w opadzie tułowia
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Cable Unilateral Bicep Curl
added.namePl: Jednostronne uginanie ramienia na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the machine.
Hold the handle with one hand, elbow at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

added.name: Banded Lower Body Dead Bug
added.namePl: Dead bug z gumą na dolne partie ciała
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your feet and legs bent over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg away against the band.
Return it and switch legs.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.

added.name: Straight Leg Dead Bug
added.namePl: Dead bug z prostymi nogami
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat the whole time.

added.name: Barbell Band Assisted Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą z gumą wspomagającą
instructions: Attach a band to the barbell and anchor it overhead or to a rack.
Stand with the bar over midfoot and grip just outside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away to lift.
Stand tall and lock out your hips.
Lower with control.

added.name: Trap Bar Banded Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą heksagonalną z gumą
instructions: Attach bands to the trap bar and stand inside the bar.
Grip the handles with a flat back and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
Lock your hips out at the top against the band.
Lower slowly back to the floor.

added.name: Depth Jump to Broad Jump
added.namePl: Skok z podwyższenia i skok w dal
instructions: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Immediately explode forward into a broad jump.
Swing your arms for momentum.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

added.name: Depth Jump
added.namePl: Skok z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Rebound immediately into a maximum vertical jump.
Spend as little time on the ground as you can.
Land softly and reset for the next rep.

added.name: Kettlebell Lying on Floor Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie kettlebelli w leżeniu na podłodze
instructions: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in each hand at chest level.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the kettlebells up until your arms are straight.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press again.

added.name: Kettlebell Lying on Floor Single Arm Bottoms Up Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie kettlebella jednorącz dnem do góry w leżeniu na podłodze
instructions: Lie on the floor and hold a kettlebell upside down in one hand.
Keep your wrist straight and the bell steady.
Press it up to full extension.
Lower slowly until your upper arm touches the floor.
Switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Weighted Plate Standing High Front Raise
added.namePl: Wysokie unoszenie talerza przodem stojąc
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the plate up and overhead.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Barbell Pin Front Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad przedni ze sztangą z zatrzymaniem na ogranicznikach
instructions: Set pins at the bottom depth and place the bar on them.
Get under the bar in a front rack position.
Brace and drive up to stand.
Lower back to the pins under control.
Pause and reset between reps.

added.name: Banded Glute Ham Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Glute ham raise z gumą v. 2
instructions: Set up on a glute-ham bench or anchor your feet with a band assisting you.
Start with your torso down and hips locked.
Curl up using your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

added.name: Barbell Single Leg Good Morning
added.namePl: Good morning jednonóż ze sztangą
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg.
Keep your standing knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower until your torso is near parallel.
Return and switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Barbell Pin Good Morning
added.namePl: Good morning ze sztangą z ogranicznikami
instructions: Set the pins to a hip-hinge height and set the bar on them.
Get under the bar, brace and unrack.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Return the bar to the pins.
Stand tall and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Alternate Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Naprzemienne unoszenie hantli bokiem
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.
Switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny z hantlami
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or sides.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return and switch sides.

added.name: Barbell Sitting on Floor Oblique Twist
added.namePl: Skręty tułowia ze sztangą w siadzie na podłodze
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs bent and a bar across your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and brace.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center.
Rotate to the other side.

added.name: Barbell Pin Close Grip Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi wąskim chwytem z ogranicznikami
instructions: Set the bar on pins at chest height.
Lie on the bench and grip the bar shoulder-width.
Press the bar up.
Lock out your elbows.
Lower back to the pins.

added.name: Barbell Behind the Back Push Press
added.namePl: Push press ze sztangą zza pleców
instructions: Hold a barbell on your upper back with a wide grip.
Dip your knees slightly.
Drive up explosively and press overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders.

added.name: Lateral Walk Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z chodzeniem w bok
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Do one push-up.
Step your hands and feet to the side.
Do another push-up.
Alternate direction after a set.

added.name: Push Up to Side Plank V. 2
added.namePl: Pompka do deski bocznej v. 2
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
Push up and rotate into a side plank, raising one arm.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Push Up with Knee Drive
added.namePl: Pompka z przyciąganiem kolana
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
Push back up.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return and alternate legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bell along your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

added.name: Barbell Standing Snatch Grip Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy ze sztangą chwytem do rwania stojąc
instructions: Hold a barbell with a wide snatch grip at your thighs.
Stand tall with your chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Side Plank Leg Lift
added.namePl: Deska boczna z unoszeniem nogi
instructions: Lie on your side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg.
Lower it slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift from Deficit
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo ze sztangą z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand on a low platform with a wide stance and toes out.
Grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away.
Lock your hips out.
Lower the bar under control.

added.name: Dumbbell Overhead Walking Lunge
added.namePl: Wykroki chodzone z hantlami nad głową
instructions: Hold dumbbells overhead with locked arms.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Push through your front foot.
Step through into the next lunge.

added.name: Barbell Z Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi z press
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight and the bar at your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Press the bar overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to the shoulders.

added.name: Hip Clam Shell
added.namePl: Clam shell dla bioder
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Keep your feet touching.
Lift your top knee.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell 6 Ways Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli w 6 kierunkach
instructions: Hold light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them to the side and lower.
Raise them to the front and lower.
Then bend forward and raise them out to the rear.
Complete all six variations as one rep.

added.name: Prayer Push
added.namePl: Modlitewne wypychanie
instructions: Stand or sit tall and press your palms together at chest height.
Point your fingers up and keep your elbows out.
Push your palms firmly into each other.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and shake out your arms.
Repeat for several rounds.

added.name: Lying Criss Cross Legs
added.namePl: Nożyce krzyżowe w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised slightly off the floor.
Press your lower back down.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch and cross the other way.
Continue smoothly.

added.name: Bridge Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie bioder w mostku
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping the hips high, open both knees out to the sides.
Bring the knees back together without dropping the hips.
Lower slowly to the floor and repeat.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.

added.name: Side Lying Scissors
added.namePl: Nożyce w leżeniu na boku
instructions: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and head supported.
Stack your legs and lift the top leg slightly.
Raise the top leg up while the bottom leg lifts toward it.
Bring them back together in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your hips stacked and still.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Lying Air Cycles
added.namePl: Rowerek w powietrzu w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head or at your sides.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pedal your legs as if riding a bicycle.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Breathe steadily and keep a smooth rhythm.
Lower your legs and rest when your form slips.

added.name: Side Lying Outward Knee Kick
added.namePl: Kopnięcie kolanem na zewnątrz w leżeniu na boku
instructions: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and bottom leg bent.
Bend the top knee and bring it toward your chest.
Kick the top leg straight out to the side.
Pull the knee back in under control.
Keep your torso still the whole time.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Lying Incline Hip Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder w leżeniu na skosie
instructions: Lie back on an incline surface and hold the top with your hands.
Bring your legs up with knees slightly bent.
Curl your pelvis and lift your hips off the surface.
Pause with your feet pointing toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Avoid swinging your legs.

added.name: Lying Flat Hip Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder w leżeniu na płask
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or under your hips.
Raise your legs so they point to the ceiling.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips a few centimetres.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep the motion small and controlled.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing High Windmill
added.namePl: Wysoki wiatrak z hantlem stojąc
instructions: Stand with feet wide and press a dumbbell overhead with one arm.
Turn your feet slightly away from the weighted side.
Push your hips toward the weighted side and hinge forward.
Slide your free hand down your leg while your eyes stay on the dumbbell.
Reverse the movement to stand tall again.
Keep the arm locked and stacked over your shoulder, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Power Clean
added.namePl: Power clean z hantlami
instructions: Stand over the dumbbells with feet hip width and grab them with a flat back.
Push through the floor and extend your hips and knees fast.
Shrug and pull the dumbbells up close to your body.
Drop under them and catch them on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower with control to the floor.
Keep your back flat and the weights close throughout.

added.name: Glute Ham Raise with Extended Arms
added.namePl: Glute ham raise z wyprostowanymi ramionami
instructions: Set up on the glute ham bench with your ankles locked in and thighs supported.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a straight body.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Move slowly and avoid arching your lower back.

added.name: Hanging Half Windmill
added.namePl: Półwiatrak w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm overhand grip.
Raise both legs together toward one side of the bar.
Sweep them across the front in a half circle.
Lower the legs on the other side under control.
Keep the swing small and your shoulders active.
Repeat, alternating the direction.

added.name: Elevated Single Leg Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż na podwyższeniu
instructions: Stand on a bench or box on one leg with the other leg hanging off the edge.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and bend the standing knee to lower.
Go as deep as you can while the knee tracks over your toes.
Push through the foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Kneeling Half Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Półprostowanie ramion w klęku
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and hold the attachment with elbows bent.
Tuck your elbows close to your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps at the bottom.
Let the hands rise only halfway, keeping tension.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.

added.name: Staggered Leg Side Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek boczny z rozstawionymi nogami
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
Stagger your feet, top foot in front of the bottom one.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep the hips high and avoid rolling forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

added.name: Standing Calf Raise Circle
added.namePl: Krążenie na palcach stojąc
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and hold a support if needed.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Trace a small circle with your heels while staying high.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Reverse the circle direction on the next rep.
Keep your knees straight and your balance steady.

added.name: Kneeling Straight Leg Side Kick
added.namePl: Kopnięcie prostą nogą w bok w klęku
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Lift the leg to about hip height.
Keep your hips and back steady.
Lower with control without touching down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Reverse Sliding Leg Curl on Floor with Towel
added.namePl: Odwrotne uginanie nóg ze ślizgiem na ręczniku na podłodze
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your feet away from you by extending the knees.
Pull the heels back toward your hips with your hamstrings.
Keep your hips high the whole set.
Lower to the floor when you finish.

added.name: Kick Side Jump
added.namePl: Skok z kopnięciem w bok
instructions: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Jump up off both feet.
Kick one leg out to the side at the top.
Land softly on both feet with soft knees.
Repeat, alternating the kicking leg.
Keep a controlled, bouncy rhythm.

added.name: Lever Bent over Wide Row (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia szerokim chwytem na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Load the machine and set your chest against the support.
Grab the wide handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your lower chest, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad throughout.

added.name: Elevated Seated Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce w siadzie na podwyższeniu
instructions: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a raised step.
Rest weight or your hands on your thighs.
Lower your heels as far as you comfortably can.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Windmill
added.namePl: Wiatrak z hantlem stojąc
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one hand and stand with feet wide.
Turn your toes slightly away from the weight.
Push your hips out and hinge sideways.
Slide your free hand down your leg toward the floor.
Reverse the motion and stand tall.
Keep your eyes on the weight, then switch sides.

added.name: Elevated Single Leg Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż na podwyższeniu
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench and put one foot on the floor or a raised step.
Lift the other leg off the ground.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Resistance Band Seated Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg w siadzie z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band at foot height and sit facing it.
Loop the band around your heels.
Extend your legs straight in front of you.
Curl your heels back under the seat against the tension.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the end.
Return slowly without letting the band snap.

added.name: Toe Jump
added.namePl: Skok na palcach
instructions: Stand tall with feet close together and knees slightly bent.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hop up quickly using mainly your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hops small and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

added.name: Banded Glute Ham Raise V. 3
added.namePl: Glute ham raise z gumą v. 3
instructions: Set up on a glute ham bench with your ankles locked and a band for support.
Cross your arms or hold the band in front of you.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a straight body.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Move slowly and avoid jerking.

added.name: Long Lever Decline Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki na ławce skośnej głową w dół z długą dźwignią
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, raising your arms with it.
Sit up until your chest is over your thighs.
Lower slowly back down.
Keep your arms reaching forward the whole time.

added.name: Side Plank with Raised Leg V. 2
added.namePl: Deska boczna z uniesioną nogą v. 2
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm with your body in a line.
Lift your top leg to hip height.
Keep your hips high and your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without dropping.
Lower down gently.
Repeat on the other side.

added.name: Dumbbell over Bench Reverse Wrist Curl with Mat
added.namePl: Odwrotne uginanie nadgarstków z hantlami nad ławką z matą
instructions: Kneel by a bench with forearms on it, palms down, wrists over the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your wrists lower gently.
Curl the weights up by extending your wrists.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your forearms still on the bench.

added.name: Side to Wide Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z zejściem w bok do szerokiego rozkroku
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms in front.
Step one foot out to the side into a wide stance.
Sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand up and bring your feet back together.
Alternate the stepping side.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent Arm Iso Hold
added.namePl: Izometryczne zatrzymanie z hantlami z ugiętymi ramionami
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand.
Curl the weights until your elbows are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Hold the position without letting the weights drop.
Breathe steadily during the hold.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower under control.

added.name: Inverted Wide to Narrow Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone z szerokiego do wąskiego chwytu
instructions: Set a bar or straps at waist height and lie underneath.
Grab it with a wide grip and straighten your body.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Bring your hands closer on the way up or between reps.
Lower yourself with control.
Keep your body in a straight line.

added.name: Ring Leg Curl V. 2
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg na kółkach v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the rings.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Pull the rings toward your glutes by bending the knees.
Pause and squeeze the hamstrings.
Extend your legs slowly back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.

added.name: Narrow Top Half Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie wąskim chwytem do połowy z góry
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with a narrow grip and pull up to the top position.
Lower yourself to about halfway.
Pull back up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your chest up and your elbows close.
Avoid swinging.
Repeat for your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Deadlift (Neutral Grip)
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z hantlami (chwyt neutralny)
instructions: Stand with feet hip width and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and lower the weights.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.
Push through your heels to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Do not round your lower back.

added.name: Reverse Leg Extension
added.namePl: Odwrotne prostowanie nóg
instructions: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend one leg back and up.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower the leg without touching the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: High Bar Inverted Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone na wysokim drążku
instructions: Set a bar at about chest height and grab it overhand.
Walk your feet forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.

added.name: Alternate High Hop
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wysokie podskoki
instructions: Stand tall with your arms ready to swing.
Hop off one foot and drive the opposite knee up.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Switch legs on the next hop.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Keep a quick, bouncy pace.

added.name: Kneeling Assisted Sliding Chin Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem w klęku z asystą na ślizgu
instructions: Kneel below a bar and grab it with an underhand grip.
Place a towel or slider under your knees.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Use your legs lightly to help.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

added.name: Leg Assisted Ring Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie na kółkach z pomocą nóg
instructions: Hold the rings with a firm grip and stand with a bend in the knees.
Place your feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your elbows down and your chest between the rings.
Use your legs only as much as you need.
Lower with control.
Keep your core tight.

added.name: Ring High Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie do góry na kółkach
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back with a straight body.
Pull the rings toward your forehead.
Flare your elbows out and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

added.name: Ring Chest Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki na kółkach
instructions: Set the rings low and hold them in a plank position.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a small bend in the elbows.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest.
Pull the rings back together with your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Go only as wide as you can control.

added.name: Ring Reverse Fly
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki na kółkach
instructions: Hold the rings with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your elbows only slightly bent.

added.name: Long Lever Lying Back Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie pleców w leżeniu z długą dźwignią
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Squeeze your glutes to stabilize.
Lift your chest and arms off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral by looking down.

added.name: Reverse Plank V. 2
added.namePl: Odwrócona deska v. 2
instructions: Sit with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Press into your hands and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your chin neutral.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

added.name: Around the World Superman
added.namePl: Superman dookoła świata
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides toward your hips.
Return them overhead in a wide arc.
Keep your legs lifted.
Lower to the floor to rest.

added.name: Sumo Air Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo bez obciążenia
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down between your legs.
Keep your chest up and knees over the toes.
Push through your heels to stand.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

added.name: 45 Degree Hip Extension Glute Focused
added.namePl: Wyprost biodra pod kątem 45 stopni z naciskiem na pośladki
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench with your ankles locked.
Cross your arms over your chest and round your upper back slightly.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips.
Squeeze the glutes to raise back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Avoid overarching your lower back.

added.name: Superman Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie superman
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull your elbows back toward your ribs as if rowing.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms forward again.
Keep your neck neutral.

added.name: Cable Kneeling One Arm Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka jednorącz w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle down toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Let the arm rise back up slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Bodyweight Forward Lunge (Hinge at Hips)
added.namePl: Wykrok w przód z masą ciała (zgięcie w biodrach)
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Hinge your torso forward at the hips.
Lower until both knees are bent.
Push off the front foot to return.
Alternate legs.

added.name: Bodyweight Forward Lunge (Smaller Stance Upright Torso)
added.namePl: Wykrok w przód z masą ciała (mniejszy rozkrok, tułów pionowo)
instructions: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a short step forward.
Lower straight down, keeping your torso upright.
Keep the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

added.name: Lever Pendulum Squat (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Przysiad wahadłowy na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Load the machine and step onto the platform.
Place your shoulders under the pads.
Unlock the machine and lower in a controlled squat.
Go as deep as comfortable.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up and heels down.

added.name: Lying Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on a bench under a high pulley.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull the bar down toward your chest.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly with straight arms.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Cable Overhead Single Arm Triceps Extension (Rope Attachment)
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia nad głową jednorącz na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Hold a rope with one hand overhead and face away from the stack.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend your elbow until the arm is straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lunge Thighs (Form Check)
added.namePl: Wykrok na uda (kontrola formy)
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up to the start.
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

added.name: Cable High Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Wysokie prostowanie ramion na wyciągu
instructions: Set the cable high and face it.
Hold the attachment with elbows bent.
Press down by extending your elbows.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Prone Triceps Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie z hantlem w leżeniu przodem
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees and keep your upper arms close.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
Lower slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.

added.name: Barbell Box Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad ze sztangą na skrzynię
instructions: Place a box behind you and a barbell on your upper back.
Push your hips back and sit onto the box.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Kettlebell Box Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z kettlebellem na skrzynię
instructions: Stand in front of a box holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Push your hips back and sit onto the box.
Pause briefly.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up.
Keep your elbows close.

added.name: Jump Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy ze skokiem
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at hip height.
Dip slightly with your knees.
Jump explosively and extend fully.
Shrug your shoulders at the top.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep the bar close to your body.

added.name: Jump Box V. 2
added.namePl: Wskok na skrzynię v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a box with feet shoulder width.
Dip and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box with both feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on the box.
Step down carefully.

added.name: Press Under
added.namePl: Przysiad pod sztangą
instructions: Hold a barbell overhead with a wide grip.
Press up so your arms lock out.
Drop into a squat while keeping the bar overhead.
Keep your arms locked.
Stand up tall.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Lateral Raise Arms (Form Check)
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion bokiem (kontrola formy)
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

added.name: Quadruped Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nogi w podporze klęcznym
instructions: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Curl one heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstring.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Assisted Chin Up (Squat Position)
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem z asystą (pozycja przysiadu)
instructions: Grab a bar with an underhand grip.
Bend your knees into a squat position.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Use your legs only as much as you need.
Lower slowly.
Keep your shoulders down.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Rdl
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński jednonóż z masą ciała
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge forward as the other leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Decline Sit Up and Russian Twist
added.namePl: Brzuszki i russian twist na ławce skośnej głową w dół
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Sit up toward your knees.
Twist your torso to one side at the top.
Twist to the other side.
Lower slowly to the bench.
Keep your movements controlled.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Biceps Curl (70 Degrees)
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z hantlami na ławce skośnej (70 stopni)
instructions: Set a bench to 70 degrees and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up without moving your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back against the bench.

added.name: Inverted Row Slide on Floor
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone ze ślizgiem na podłodze
instructions: Lie under a bar or lower support with sliders under your heels.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Keep your body straight.
Lower slowly.
Keep your hips up.

added.name: Lying Leg Raise V. 3
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg w leżeniu v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe steadily through each rep.

added.name: Mountain Climber Jump
added.namePl: Mountain climber ze skokiem
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs with a small jump.
Keep your hips low.
Maintain a fast, steady pace.
Rest when your form slips.

added.name: Ring Alternate Superman
added.namePl: Naprzemienny superman na kółkach
instructions: Put your feet in the rings and get into a face-down plank.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm forward while holding steady.
Return it and switch to the other arm.
Avoid letting your lower back sag.
Alternate sides for the full set.

added.name: Ring Kneeling Ab Rollout
added.namePl: Rollout brzucha w klęku na kółkach
instructions: Kneel and hold the rings at about knee height with a firm grip.
Brace your abs and keep a straight line from head to knees.
Roll the rings forward by extending your arms until you are long but still in control.
Pull the rings back toward your knees by contracting your abs.
Do not let your lower back sag at any point.

added.name: Ring Rollout
added.namePl: Rollout na kółkach
instructions: Kneel holding rings under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Roll your arms forward, extending your body.
Go as far as you can with a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Keep your ribs down.

added.name: Reverse Flutter Kick on Floor (Hand Under Head) V. 2
added.namePl: Odwrotne nożyce poziome na podłodze (dłoń pod głową) v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your head and legs extended.
Lift both heels a few inches off the floor and press your lower back down.
Kick one leg up higher while the other goes down, then switch in a steady rhythm.
Keep your legs fairly straight and your core tight.
Stop the set when your lower back starts to arch.

added.name: Barbell Close Grip Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion ze sztangą wąskim chwytem
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands closer than shoulder width.
Keep your elbows tucked against your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze your biceps at the top for a moment.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Negative Dragon Flag
added.namePl: Negatywny dragon flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the edge behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight vertical line on your upper back.
Lower your body slowly as one stiff plank, keeping hips from bending.
Stop just above the bench with your core tight.
Bend your knees to return to the start, then repeat.

added.name: Top Pull Up Hold
added.namePl: Zatrzymanie na górze podciągania
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar and pull yourself up.
Bring your chin above the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower yourself slowly.
Keep your body still.

added.name: Kneeling Modified Hindu Push Up
added.namePl: Zmodyfikowana pompka hinduska w klęku
instructions: Start on your knees and hands with hips high, like a pike.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward close to the floor.
Push through your arms to glide your chest up and forward, arching slightly.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up to the start.
Move smoothly and keep your core engaged.

added.name: Band Assisted Floor Glute Ham Raise
added.namePl: Glute ham raise na podłodze z gumą wspomagającą
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and loop it around your chest or hold it to your chest.
Kneel with your feet held firmly under a stable object.
Lower your torso forward slowly with a straight line from knees to head.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and glutes, using the band to help.
Keep your hips extended throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Step Up V. 2
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie z hantlami v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy bench.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall on the bench.
Lower your trailing foot back down under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Lying Leg Figure Eight
added.namePl: Ósemka nogami w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips and legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Trace a figure eight in the air with your feet, slowly and in control.
Keep your legs close together.
Change direction halfway through the set.

added.name: Inverse Leg Curl with Bench Pads
added.namePl: Odwrotne uginanie nóg z podkładkami ławki
instructions: Anchor your ankles under the bench pads and kneel upright.
Cross your arms or hold them in front of you.
Lean forward slowly from the knees, keeping hips and torso in a straight line.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.

added.name: V Sit Cross Punch
added.namePl: V-sit z uderzeniem krzyżowym
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back, lifting your feet off the floor.
Raise your fists in front of your chest.
Punch one arm across your body while twisting your torso.
Return to center and punch with the other arm.
Keep your chest tall and your balance steady.

added.name: Knee Tuck Oblique Crunch
added.namePl: Skośne spięcia brzucha z przyciąganiem kolan
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Tuck one knee in while rotating your opposite elbow toward it.
Return and repeat to the other side.
Move with control instead of pulling on your neck.

added.name: Side Plank Rotation
added.namePl: Deska boczna z rotacją
instructions: Set up in a side plank on one forearm or hand with your top arm raised.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Thread your top arm under your torso, rotating your chest toward the floor.
Rotate back and reach the arm up to the ceiling.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Opposite Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha naprzeciwległe
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head.
Lift one leg bent while curling your torso up.
Bring the opposite elbow toward the raised knee.
Lower slowly with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

added.name: Lying Leg Cross
added.namePl: Krzyżowanie nóg w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor with your lower back pressed down.
Open them wide, then cross one leg over the other.
Open again and cross with the other leg on top.
Keep your core tight throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated External Shoulder Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja zewnętrzna barku z hantlem w siadzie
instructions: Sit holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rest your arm on your thigh or a pad for support.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward, keeping the elbow in place.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell One Arm Y Elevation
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla w układzie y jednorącz
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell in one hand and hinge slightly or lie chest down on an incline bench.
Start with your arm hanging down.
Raise your arm diagonally overhead to form a Y with your thumb up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, and switch sides.

added.name: Standing Single Leg Calf Raise (On a Staircase)
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż stojąc (na schodach)
instructions: Stand on the edge of a stair on one foot, holding the rail for balance.
Let your heel drop below the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

added.name: Suspension Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Stand facing the anchor holding the handles with a wide stance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Sit your hips down, keeping knees over toes.
Use the straps lightly for balance.
Push through your heels to stand.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

added.name: Band Seated Underhand Grip Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie podchwytem w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and the band looped around your feet.
Hold the band ends with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Suspension Underhand Grip Inverted Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone podchwytem na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Hold the handles palms up and lean back with a straight body.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

added.name: Suspension Hammer Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion chwytem młotkowym na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Hold the handles with palms facing each other and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows high and still.
Lower slowly until arms are straight.
Keep your core tight.

added.name: Suspension Chin Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Hold the handles palms facing you and lean back.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your elbows close to your sides.
Lower under control.
Adjust your foot position to change difficulty.

added.name: Elevated Standing Calf Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce stojąc na podwyższeniu v. 2
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step and your heels hanging off.
Hold something for balance.
Rise high onto your toes.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels below the step slowly.

added.name: Barbell Pause Decline Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi na ławce skośnej głową w dół z pauzą
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest.
Hold the bar still on your chest for a full second.
Press the bar up powerfully until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet secured and shoulder blades tight.

added.name: Barbell Pause Incline Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi na ławce skośnej z pauzą
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest.
Hold the bar still on your chest for a full second.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled back.

added.name: Barbell Pause Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi na ławce płaskiej z pauzą
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Pause for a second with the bar resting lightly.
Press up explosively until your arms lock.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched throughout.

added.name: Barbell Pause Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą z pauzą
instructions: Stand with the bar over midfoot and grip just outside your legs.
Brace your core and flatten your back.
Lift the bar a few inches and hold the pause for a second.
Keep your back flat, then drive through your legs to stand tall.
Lower the bar under control.

added.name: Pause Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z pauzą
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and squat down to depth.
Pause in the bottom for about two seconds, staying tight.
Drive up through your whole foot.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Weighted Seated Leg Raise on Floor
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg w siadzie na podłodze z obciążeniem
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you and weight secured to your legs or between your feet.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Raise your legs up while keeping them as straight as you can.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor.
Keep your back from rounding too far.

added.name: Resistance Band Serratus Wall Slide
added.namePl: Serratus wall slide z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a band around your forearms just below the elbows.
Place your forearms on the wall and push slightly outward against the band.
Slide your arms up the wall, reaching overhead.
Keep your ribs down and shoulder blades moving freely.
Slide back down slowly.

added.name: Resistance Band Serratus Wall Slide with Foam Roll
added.namePl: Serratus wall slide z gumą oporową i wałkiem
instructions: Put a band around your forearms and place a foam roller on the wall under them.
Press your forearms into the roller and push slightly out against the band.
Roll the roller up the wall as you reach overhead.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders away from your ears.
Roll back down slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Goblet Split Squat V. 2
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski kielichowy z hantlem v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest and step into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Push Up Jack
added.namePl: Jumping jack w pozycji pompki
instructions: Start in a high plank with your feet together.
Lower into a push up with control.
Push back up and jump your feet wide.
Jump your feet back together.
Keep your body straight and move rhythmically.

added.name: Medicine Ball Lying Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg z piłką lekarską w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with a medicine ball squeezed between your feet.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your grip on the ball firm.

added.name: Leg Raise Oblique Crunch
added.namePl: Skośne spięcia brzucha z unoszeniem nóg
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs together toward the ceiling.
Crunch your shoulders up and toward one side as the legs tilt the other way.
Lower and repeat to the other side.
Keep movements slow and controlled.

added.name: Cable Single Arm Triceps Pushdown (Rope Attachment)
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia jednorącz na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip it with one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Press the rope down until your arm is straight, turning the end out slightly.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Landmine One Arm Bent over Row V. 2
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w opadzie tułowia na landmine v. 2
instructions: Stand over the end of a landmine bar and hinge your hips back with a flat back.
Grab the bar end or attachment with one hand.
Pull the bar up toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

added.name: Weighted Hyperextension
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja z obciążeniem
instructions: Set the pad at hip level on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise it until your body forms a straight line.
Do not overarch at the top.

added.name: Exercise Ball Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Curl the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Extend your legs again slowly.
Keep your hips high the whole time.

added.name: Double Jump Rope
added.namePl: Podwójna skakanka
instructions: Hold a jump rope with the handles at your hips.
Jump slightly higher than normal.
Spin the rope fast with your wrists so it passes twice under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Rest between short rounds as needed.

added.name: Silent Burpee
added.namePl: Burpee po cichu
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Step your feet back into a plank.
Step your feet forward to your hands.
Stand up tall.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Lying Prone a
added.namePl: Leżenie przodem w układzie a
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out at about 45 degrees, palms down.
Rest your forehead lightly or look at the floor.
Lift your arms and chest slightly while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Lying Prone T
added.namePl: Leżenie przodem w układzie t
instructions: Lie face down with arms straight out to the sides, thumbs up.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Lying Prone W
added.namePl: Leżenie przodem w układzie w
instructions: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lift your elbows and hands off the floor, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Lower with control.

added.name: Lying Prone W to T
added.namePl: Leżenie przodem z w do t
instructions: Lie face down in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Straighten your arms out to the sides into a T.
Pull back to the W while keeping your shoulder blades squeezed.
Repeat smoothly.

added.name: Lying Prone W to Y
added.namePl: Leżenie przodem z w do y
instructions: Lie face down in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Reach your arms forward and wide into a Y.
Pull back into the W with your shoulder blades squeezed.
Keep your neck relaxed and repeat.

added.name: Reverse Plank on Elbows
added.namePl: Odwrócona deska na łokciach
instructions: Sit with legs extended and elbows under your shoulders.
Press into your elbows and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

added.name: V Sit Toe Tap
added.namePl: V-sit z dotykaniem stóp
instructions: Sit on the floor and lean back, lifting your legs into a V.
Reach both arms forward.
Crunch up and tap your toes with your fingers.
Lower slightly back while keeping your feet up.
Keep your chest open and repeat.

added.name: Side Bridge with Bent Leg
added.namePl: Mostek boczny z ugiętą nogą
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from shoulder to knee.
Keep your hips stacked and core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

added.name: Superman W to Y
added.namePl: Superman z w do y
instructions: Lie face down, arms in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Reach your arms forward into a Y.
Return to the W while keeping the lift.
Lower fully after your reps.

added.name: Superman W
added.namePl: Superman w układzie w
instructions: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your shoulder blades together and hold for a second.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Lying Alternate Toe Touch Floor
added.namePl: Naprzemienny dotyk palców stóp w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs raised toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms up.
Crunch up and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Lower and reach with the other hand.
Keep your legs steady.

added.name: Glute Ham Twist
added.namePl: Skręt na maszynie glute ham
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms out wide.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Rotate your knees and hips to one side.
Return to center and rotate to the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your shoulders on the floor.

added.name: Single Leg Calf Raise Off Step
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż ze stopnia
instructions: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a rail for balance.
Let your heel lower below the step.
Rise as high as possible on your toes.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

added.name: Prone Cervical Extension Isometric Hold
added.namePl: Izometryczny wyprost szyjny w leżeniu przodem
instructions: Lie face down with your arms by your sides.
Tuck your chin slightly.
Lift your head a few inches off the floor.
Hold steady while breathing normally.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Hold to Stand Clean Grip
added.namePl: Zatrzymanie w klęku i wstanie z hantlami, chwyt do zarzutu
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front and hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control to half kneeling.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Squat to Overhead Press
added.namePl: Przysiad z wyciskaniem hantli nad głowę
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Squeeze Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli ze ściśnięciem na ławce skośnej
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back with dumbbells pressed together over your chest.
Keep squeezing them against each other the whole set.
Lower them slowly to your upper chest.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched back and feet planted.

added.name: Weighted Incline Svend Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie svend na ławce skośnej z obciążeniem
instructions: Set a bench to an incline and sit back with a weight plate held between your palms at chest height.
Squeeze the plate hard with both hands.
Push it straight out until your arms are extended.
Pull it back to your chest while still squeezing.
Keep your back against the pad and shoulders down.

added.name: Kettlebell Lunge with Twist
added.namePl: Wykrok z kettlebellem i skrętem
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell at chest height with both hands.
Step forward into a lunge, front knee over your ankle.
Rotate your torso toward the front leg, keeping hips square.
Turn back to center and push off the front foot to return.
Alternate legs for each rep.

added.name: Kettlebell Rear Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Overhead Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok z kettlebellem nad głową jednorącz
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and keep that arm straight.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and the weight stacked over your shoulder.
Push back to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch the kettlebell to the other arm.

added.name: Kettlebell Sit Up Press
added.namePl: Brzuszki z wyciskaniem kettlebella
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Curl and sit up using your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you reach the top.
Lower it back to your chest.
Roll back down slowly and repeat.

added.name: Kettlebell Sumo Squat V. 2
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo z kettlebellem v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Keep your chest tall and back flat.
Sit down between your legs until your thighs are about parallel.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

added.name: Barbell Muscle Clean
added.namePl: Muscle clean ze sztangą
instructions: Set up over the bar with hands just outside your knees and your back flat.
Pull the bar off the floor, extending your hips and knees.
Shrug and pull the elbows high, keeping the bar close.
Rotate your elbows under and catch the bar on your shoulders without dropping into a squat.
Lower the bar back down under control.

added.name: Dumbbell Overhead Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok z hantlami nad głową
instructions: Press two dumbbells overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your core tight and the dumbbells over your shoulders.
Push off the front foot to come back.
Alternate legs each rep.

added.name: Bodyweight Svend Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie svend z masą ciała
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your palms together at chest height.
Squeeze your palms hard against each other.
Push your hands straight out in front of you.
Bring them back to your chest while still squeezing.
Keep your shoulders down and repeat.

added.name: Lying Floor Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki w leżeniu na podłodze
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out until your upper arms touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back together.
Keep your wrists straight and the motion slow.

added.name: Cable Shoulder 90 Degrees External Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja zewnętrzna barku przy 90 stopniach na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and back without moving your upper arm.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable Shoulder Internal Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja wewnętrzna barku na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with your elbow tucked against your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across your stomach.
Return slowly, keeping your elbow pinned.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Shoulder 90 Degrees Internal Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja wewnętrzna barku przy 90 stopniach na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at shoulder height and face away from it.
Hold the handle with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm forward and down, keeping your upper arm still.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable Standing Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle, stepping back until there is tension.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle toward your ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi podchwytem
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bar with palms facing you, about shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower it to your lower chest with elbows tucked.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet down and shoulder blades pinched.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Underhand Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla przodem podchwytem jednorącz
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing forward.
Keep your core braced.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly to your thigh.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Floor Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantla jednorącz z podłogi
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a dumbbell at chest level.
Rest your other arm on the floor.
Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight.
Lower it until your upper arm touches the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Landmine Single Arm Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz na landmine
instructions: Anchor a barbell and hold the free end at your shoulder with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and core tight.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok z hantlem nad głową jednorącz
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and lock it out.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Single Arm Overhead Dumbbell Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z hantlem nad głową jednorącz
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and keep it locked out.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your ribs down and the weight over your shoulder.
Drive up to standing, then switch arms after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Alternate Decline Bench Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie hantla jednorącz na ławce skośnej głową w dół
instructions: Lie on a decline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up until your arm is straight.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your core tight and the bench-side arm steady.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Alternate Fly
added.namePl: Naprzemienne rozpiętki jednorącz z hantlem
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower one arm out to the side in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest to bring it back up.
Alternate with the other arm.

added.name: Kettlebell Unilateral Farmers Walk
added.namePl: Jednostronny spacer farmera z kettlebellem
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders level.
Walk with steady steps without leaning to the loaded side.
Walk for a set distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Power Clean
added.namePl: Power clean z jednym hantlem
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip it with a flat back.
Explode up through your hips and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and catch it at your shoulder.
Lower it back down under control, then switch arms.

added.name: Cross Jump Jack
added.namePl: Jumping jack z krzyżowaniem skoku
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump again, crossing your legs and your arms in front of you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm and continue for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Alternate Toe Tap Leg Lift
added.namePl: Naprzemienny dotyk palców stóp z unoszeniem nogi
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs raised straight up.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Reach one leg up so your toes tap toward the ceiling.
Alternate legs with control.
Keep your core tight and breathe steadily.

added.name: Captains Chair Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg na krzesełku kapitańskim
instructions: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the support.
Let your legs hang straight down.
Raise your knees or straight legs to hip height or higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

added.name: Dumbbell Wood Chop Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z rąbaniem drewna z hantlem
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands by one hip.
Sit into a squat.
Stand up and swing the dumbbell diagonally across to overhead on the other side.
Rotate your torso and pivot your back foot as you go.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Twist V. 2
added.namePl: Skręt na wyciągu v. 2
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso away from the cable, arms extended.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Deadlift V. 2
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z hantlami v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at your sides or in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

added.name: Cable Kickback V. 2
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie na wyciągu v. 2
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and hold the machine for support.
Stand tall with a slight bend in the standing knee.
Kick your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly and switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Barbell Clean and Jerk
added.namePl: Zarzut i podrzut ze sztangą
instructions: Set up over the bar with a flat back and hands outside your knees.
Pull the bar off the floor and catch it at your shoulders in a squat.
Stand up with the bar racked.
Dip slightly and drive the bar overhead, splitting your feet.
Recover your feet, stand tall and lower the bar under control.

added.name: Cable Reverse Grip Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka podchwytem na wyciągu
instructions: Sit at a pulldown station with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and together.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Side Jump Twist
added.namePl: Skok boczny ze skrętem
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms bent.
Jump and twist your hips and legs to one side while your shoulders face forward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-45 seconds.

added.name: Seated Back Squeeze
added.namePl: Ściskanie łopatek w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall with arms at your sides or elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for your reps.

added.name: Triceps Dip Floor V. 2
added.namePl: Pompki tyłem na podłodze v. 2
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

added.name: Seated Pulse Back Squeeze
added.namePl: Pulsujące ściskanie łopatek w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall with elbows bent.
Draw your shoulder blades together.
Pulse your elbows back in small movements.
Keep your shoulders down.
Maintain the squeeze throughout.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

added.name: Seated Behind Back Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie rąk za plecami w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall with hands clasped behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest lifted.

added.name: Smith Hang Clean
added.namePl: Zarzut z zawisu na maszynie smitha
instructions: Stand at the bar with it hanging at your knees, hands just outside your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Pull your elbows high and catch the bar on your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to your knees and repeat.

added.name: Power Sled Drag
added.namePl: Ciągnięcie sań
instructions: Load a sled and attach a harness or straps.
Lean slightly forward and brace your core.
Walk with powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep your back straight.
Cover a set distance, then rest and repeat.

added.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass Against Wall
added.namePl: Podanie piłki lekarskiej od klatki piersiowej o ścianę
instructions: Stand facing a wall with the ball held at your chest.
Take a small step back and set your feet.
Push the ball forcefully at the wall.
Catch it with soft elbows as it returns.
Bring it back to your chest and repeat.

added.name: Posterior Neck Isometric
added.namePl: Izometria tylnej części szyi
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your hands clasped behind your head.
Keep your chin level.
Press your head back into your hands without letting it move.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and repeat a few times.

added.name: Jumping Single Leg Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok naskokowy jednonóż
instructions: Stand in a lunge position.
Lower down, then jump explosively off your front leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control the next repetition, keeping your torso upright.
Switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Kipping Handstand Push Up
added.namePl: Kipping pompka w staniu na rękach
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head toward the floor under control.
Bend your hips and knees slightly, then drive them back out as you press.
Press up to lockout.
Keep your core tight and move carefully.

added.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Hold to Stand
added.namePl: Zatrzymanie w klęku i wstanie z masą ciała
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front.
Hold your arms in front of you for balance.
Drive through the front foot to stand tall.
Lower back down under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Side to Side Hop
added.namePl: Podskoki z boku na bok
instructions: Stand on one foot with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to the other foot.
Land softly and balance for a second.
Hop back to the first foot.
Keep your hips level and repeat for 20-30 hops.

added.name: Lateral Step Up
added.namePl: Wejście boczne na podwyższenie
instructions: Stand sideways next to a box.
Place your near foot on the box.
Press through that foot to step up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Lateral Step Up with Knee Drive
added.namePl: Wejście boczne na podwyższenie z przyciąganiem kolana
instructions: Stand sideways next to a box with one foot on top.
Press through that foot to step up.
Drive your other knee up toward your chest.
Lower back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Mountain Climber Slide with Towel
added.namePl: Mountain climber ze ślizgiem na ręczniku
instructions: Place your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a plank.
Keep your core tight and shoulders over your wrists.
Slide one knee toward your chest.
Slide it back and switch legs.
Keep a steady pace and a flat back.

added.name: Plank Jack on Elbows
added.namePl: Plank jack na łokciach
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet wide apart.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and continue for 20-40 seconds.

added.name: Plank Jack Slide with Towel
added.namePl: Plank jack ze ślizgiem na ręczniku
instructions: Put your feet on towels on a smooth floor and get into a high plank.
Brace your core.
Slide your feet wide apart.
Slide them back together.
Keep your hips level and repeat.

added.name: Plank on Hands
added.namePl: Deska na dłoniach
instructions: Place your hands under your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips so the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower your knees.

added.name: Medicine Ball Throw Squat with Wall
added.namePl: Przysiad z rzutem piłki lekarskiej o ścianę
instructions: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up explosively and throw the ball at the wall.
Catch the ball on the rebound with soft hands.
Reset your stance and repeat for controlled reps.

added.name: Plank Pike Slide with Towel
added.namePl: Deska z unoszeniem bioder ze ślizgiem na ręczniku
instructions: Put your toes on towels on a smooth floor and get into a straight-arm plank.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Slide your feet toward your hands as your hips rise into a pike.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slide your feet back to the plank without letting your hips drop.

added.name: Single Leg Box Jump
added.namePl: Wskok na skrzynię jednonóż
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box on one foot.
Swing your arms and dip into a short quarter squat.
Jump up and land softly on the box on the same foot.
Stand tall, then step down carefully.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge with External Rotation
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder jednonóż z rotacją zewnętrzną
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg lifted.
Press through your planted heel and raise your hips.
Turn the raised knee gently outward as you hold the top.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glutes.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Standing Hip Adduction V. 2
added.namePl: Przywodzenie biodra stojąc v. 2
instructions: Stand tall next to a wall or chair and hold on for balance.
Lift the outer leg slightly off the floor.
Swing it across the front of your standing leg.
Return slowly to the start without leaning.
Finish your reps, then turn around and switch legs.

added.name: Kneeling Pulse
added.namePl: Pulsowanie w klęku
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg back with the knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Pulse the foot upward in small, controlled movements.
Keep your hips square and your back flat.
Finish the set, then switch legs.

added.name: Bodyweight Standing Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki stojąc z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms out wide with slightly bent elbows.
Brace your core and keep your chest proud.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs hard for a second.
Open your arms back out with control.

added.name: Wall Pulse
added.namePl: Pulsowanie przy ścianie
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, close together at chest height.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows slightly to bring your chest toward the wall.
Pulse in short, controlled movements.
Keep your elbows tucked and your core tight.

added.name: Lever Single Leg Extension (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Prostowanie nogi jednonóż na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad to rest on your lower shin.
Place one foot under the pad and keep the other planted.
Extend your knee until your leg is almost straight.
Pause briefly and squeeze your quads.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
