added.name: Cable Standing Close Grip Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie wąskim chwytem stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a close grip handle to a cable at chest height and step back.
Stand with a slight knee bend and a braced core.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Burpee Long Jump with Push Up
added.namePl: Burpee ze skokiem w dal i pompką
instructions: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back and do one push-up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode into a long jump forward.
Land softly with bent knees and go into the next rep.

added.name: Power Clean Thruster
added.namePl: Power clean z thrusterem
instructions: Set up with the barbell over mid-foot and grip it just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand, then sink into a full front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and then to the floor with control.

added.name: Barbell Clean and Jerk V. 2
added.namePl: Zarzut i podrzut ze sztangą v. 2
instructions: Grip the bar just outside your knees with a flat back.
Pull explosively and drop under the bar, catching it on your shoulders.
Stand up fully and reset your feet.
Dip, drive, and split your legs as you punch the bar overhead.
Recover your feet and lower the bar with control.

added.name: Cluster
added.namePl: Cluster
instructions: Start with the barbell on the floor and pull it to your shoulders in a clean.
Stand up with the bar racked on your shoulders.
Squat down into a deep front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and repeat.

added.name: Power Sled Rear Drag V. 2
added.namePl: Ciągnięcie sań tyłem v. 2
instructions: Load the sled and grip the handles or strap in front of you.
Lean slightly back with your chest up.
Walk backward in small, powerful steps.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Cover your distance, then rest and repeat.

added.name: Bodyweight Muscle Up V. 2
added.namePl: Muscle up z masą ciała v. 2
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false or standard grip.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar toward your lower chest.
Lean forward and rotate your wrists over the bar.
Press up until your arms are fully straight.
Lower yourself back down with control.

added.name: Single Straight Leg Glute Bridge Hold
added.namePl: Zatrzymanie w unoszeniu bioder na prostej nodze
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Straighten one leg.
Lift your hips with the planted foot.
Hold with hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Waiter Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z hantlami kelnerskie
instructions: Stań prosto z hantlami w obu dłoniach, dłonie skierowane do przodu.
Trzymaj ramiona blisko ciała, a łokcie przyciśnięte do boków.
Powoli unieś hantle w stronę barków, trzymając nadgarstki proste.
Zatrzymaj się na chwilę na górze, a następnie powoli opuść hantle do pozycji wyjściowej.
Powtórz zalecaną liczbę powtórzeń.

added.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Ab Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w klęku z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the handles beside your head.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips, rounding your spine.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without sitting back on your heels.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Ab Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha stojąc z gumą oporową
instructions: Anchor the band high and stand facing it with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the handles at your head.
Bend forward by crunching your ribs toward your pelvis.
Squeeze your abs hard.
Return slowly to standing.

added.name: Resistance Band Single Arm Overhead Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę jednorącz z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand on the band with the handle in one hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the handle straight overhead.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Resistance Band Overhead Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę z gumą oporową
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Brace your abs and stand tall.
Press both handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

added.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Ab Crunch V. 2
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w klęku z gumą oporową v. 2
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the band at your forehead or beside your head.
Pull your elbows toward your knees as you curl down.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly while keeping the tension.

added.name: Mountain Climber V. 2
added.namePl: Mountain climber v. 2
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

added.name: Riding Outdoor Bicycle
added.namePl: Jazda na rowerze na zewnątrz
instructions: Adjust your saddle so your leg is almost straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Wear a helmet and check your brakes.
Start at an easy pace to warm up.
Pedal smoothly at a steady, comfortable rhythm for 20-60 minutes.
Cool down with a few minutes of easy pedalling.

added.name: Sprint
added.namePl: Sprint
instructions: Warm up well with jogging and dynamic stretches.
Start in a staggered stance and lean slightly forward.
Drive your arms and knees as you accelerate.
Run at maximum effort for 10-30 seconds.
Slow down gradually and rest fully before the next sprint.

added.name: Smith Wide Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy szerokim chwytem na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar at thigh height and grip it wider than shoulder width.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

added.name: Barbell Wide Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy szerokim chwytem ze sztangą
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulders straight toward your ears.
Hold the top for a second.
Lower slowly under control.

added.name: Smith Back Wide Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy szerokim chwytem zza pleców na maszynie smitha
instructions: Stand with your back to the bar, set at thigh height, and grip it wide behind you.
Lift the bar off the hooks and stand tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your arms straight.

added.name: Barbell Back Wide Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy szerokim chwytem zza pleców ze sztangą
instructions: Hold a barbell behind your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Stand tall with your chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower slowly without leaning forward.

added.name: Myotatic Crunch on Bosu Ball
added.namePl: Myotatic crunch na piłce bosu
instructions: Lie back over a Bosu ball with your lower back supported.
Place your hands beside your head and your feet flat.
Let your torso extend gently over the ball.
Crunch up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Lower slowly through the full range.

added.name: Dumbbell Deadlift Bent over Row
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z wiosłowaniem w opadzie tułowia z hantlami
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly and stand back up.

added.name: Wall Walks
added.namePl: Chodzenie po ścianie
instructions: Lie face down with your feet against a wall.
Place your hands beside your chest and push up into a plank.
Walk your feet up the wall as your hands walk toward it.
Stop where you can keep your body straight and braced.
Walk back down slowly with control.

added.name: Bent Arms Chin Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem z ugiętymi ramionami
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your elbows bent and your body still.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until just short of straight arms.

added.name: Single Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z hantlem nad głową na ławce skośnej głową w dół
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Curl up and sit forward, keeping the weight overhead.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

added.name: Medicine Ball Lunge with Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Wykrok z piłką lekarską i uginaniem ramion
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball at your thighs.
Step forward into a lunge.
Curl the ball up toward your chest as you lower.
Push back to standing while lowering the ball.
Alternate legs on each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl with Overhead Extension on Stability Ball
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z hantlami z prostowaniem nad głową na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball holding a dumbbell.
Curl the dumbbell up with your elbow at your side.
Raise it overhead, lifting it with both hands.
Lower it behind your head for a triceps extension.
Extend, return to the front, and repeat.

added.name: Ez Barbell Deadlift with Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą łamaną z uginaniem ramion
instructions: Stand with an EZ bar in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar along your legs.
Stand tall by driving your hips forward.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it and repeat.

added.name: Old School Reverse Extensions
added.namePl: Odwrotne prostowanie pleców w starym stylu
instructions: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold the bench and keep your legs hanging down.
Lift your legs behind you until your body is straight.
Pause and squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Kneeling Abdominal Draw in
added.namePl: Wciąganie brzucha w klęku
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Relax your belly toward the floor.
Draw your navel up toward your spine.
Hold for 10-15 seconds while breathing normally.
Release slowly and repeat.

added.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension (Low)
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion na wyciągu w leżeniu (dolny)
instructions: Lie on a bench with a low pulley behind your head.
Hold the bar or rope with your arms up over your face.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back up.

added.name: Lying Bicycle Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha rowerek w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Extend one leg while turning your opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Shoulders Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli nad głowę na ławce skośnej
instructions: Set a bench to about 60 to 75 degrees and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the weights at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder level.
Keep your back against the pad.

added.name: 45 Degree Bicycle Twisting Crunch
added.namePl: Skośne spięcia rowerek pod kątem 45 stopni
instructions: Sit and lean back to about 45 degrees with your feet raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in as you twist the opposite elbow toward it.
Alternate sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your chest lifted and your core tight.

added.name: Air Twisting Crunch
added.namePl: Skośne spięcia brzucha w powietrzu
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and twist toward one knee.
Return and twist toward the other side.
Keep a slow rhythm and press your lower back down.

added.name: Lying Tuck Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z przyciąganiem kolan w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended just off the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Pull your knees in and crunch your chest toward them.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend and lower slowly.

added.name: Lying Toe Touch
added.namePl: Dotyk palców stóp w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight up.
Reach your arms up toward your toes.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and touch your toes.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your legs steady.

added.name: Bodyweight Glute Dominant Step Up
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie z naciskiem na pośladki z masą ciała
instructions: Stand in front of a bench and place one foot on it.
Lean your torso slightly forward.
Press through your heel and step up until standing.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Kneeling Staggered Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka w klęku w rozkroku krokowym
instructions: Kneel and place your hands on the floor, one slightly forward of the other.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Switch hand positions on the next set.

added.name: Landmine Kneeling Thruster Press
added.namePl: Thruster w klęku na landmine
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive through your hips and press the bar up.
Straighten your arms fully at the top.
Lower back to your chest with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Sprinter Thrust Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli z ruchem sprintera
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at your chest.
Drive one knee up toward your chest.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower the dumbbells and switch legs.
Keep a steady rhythm.

added.name: Barbell Full Clean
added.namePl: Pełny zarzut ze sztangą
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively with a flat back.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a front squat.
Stand up fully.
Lower the bar with control to the floor.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Preacher Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion na modlitewniku w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench with a low cable beside you.
Rest your upper arms on the pad.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl (Turned Torso)
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z hantlem na modlitewniku (skręcony tułów)
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Rotate your torso slightly toward the working arm.
Curl the dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lever Preacher Curl (Turned Torso)
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion na modlitewniku na maszynie (skręcony tułów)
instructions: Sit at the machine and adjust the seat so your arms rest on the pad.
Turn your torso slightly toward the working arm.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Full Squat from Deficit
added.namePl: Pełny przysiad z kettlebellem z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand on a low platform holding a kettlebell at chest height.
Brace your core.
Sit your hips down as deep as you can.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep the kettlebell close to your body.

added.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly (45 Degrees)
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki z hantlami (45 stopni)
instructions: Set a bench to 45 degrees and lie chest down on it, a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang below you with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights out to the sides until your arms are level with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid swinging.

added.name: Trap Bar Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad ze sztangą heksagonalną
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand up.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Landmine One Leg Stiff Leg Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg na prostych nogach jednonóż na landmine
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar in front of you with both hands.
Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar while your free leg reaches back.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Ez Bar Russian Twist Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z russian twist ze sztangą łamaną
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold the EZ bar over your chest.
Curl up into a sit-up position.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side, moving the bar with you.
Rotate back to center and lower yourself with control.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep the weight light enough to move smoothly.

added.name: Ez Bar Shoulder Press Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki z wyciskaniem sztangi łamanej nad głowę
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding the EZ bar at your chest.
Sit up while keeping the bar close to your body.
Once upright, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar back to your chest.
Roll back down slowly to the floor.
Brace your core and avoid yanking with your neck.

added.name: Elevated Side Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny na podwyższeniu
instructions: Stand tall next to a low step or platform.
Step one foot sideways onto the platform.
Push your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and the planted foot flat.
Push back to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Exercise Ball Serratus Wall Slide
added.namePl: Serratus wall slide na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall and rest your forearms on it.
Step back slightly so your body leans in.
Slide your forearms up the ball as you reach overhead.
Push into the ball and spread your shoulder blades at the top.
Slide back down slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.

added.name: Rear Lunge from Deficit
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand on a low step with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and down off the step.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Keep your torso tall and front knee stable.
Push through the front heel to return to the step.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Good Morning Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z good morning z hantlami
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Stand back up and then sit down into a squat.
Drive up through your heels.
Repeat the hinge and squat as one rep.
Keep your chest up throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Glute Dominant Step Up
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie z naciskiem na pośladki z hantlami
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and face a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box and lean your torso slightly forward.
Push through the heel of that foot to stand up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Cable Glute Dominant Step Up
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie z naciskiem na pośladki z wyciągiem
instructions: Hold the cable handle and stand facing a step.
Place one foot on the step.
Lean slightly forward from the hips.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Smith Bent over Narrow Pronated Grip Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie wąskim nachwytem w opadzie tułowia na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together, palms down.
Hinge forward with a flat back and unlock the bar.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly.
Keep your hips back and torso still.

added.name: Resistance Band Pull Apart (45 Degrees)
added.namePl: Rozciąganie gumy na boki (45 stopni)
instructions: Hold a resistance band in both hands in front of you.
Raise your arms to about 45 degrees above horizontal.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

added.name: Lever Multy Mode Rope Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie liny na maszynie wielochwytowej
instructions: Sit at the machine and grab the rope handles.
Set your thighs under the pads and sit tall.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid leaning back too far.

added.name: Lever T Bar Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński na maszynie t-bar
instructions: Stand at the T-bar lever and grip the handles.
Lift to stand with a slight bend in your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your thighs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your back flat all the way.

added.name: Barbell Standing Shoulders Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi nad głowę stojąc
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder height with hands just outside shoulder-width.
Stand tall with glutes and core braced.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly.
Lock out with the bar over mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders.
Avoid leaning back.

added.name: Dumbbell Pullover V. 2
added.namePl: Pullover z hantlem v. 2
instructions: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell back behind your head in an arc.
Feel the stretch through your chest and lats.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your hips low and ribs down.

added.name: Svend Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie svend na ławce
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a plate between your palms at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together hard.
Press the plate straight up until your arms extend.
Keep squeezing the plate throughout.
Lower it back to your chest slowly.
Keep your feet planted.

added.name: Lever Trunk Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja tułowia na maszynie
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pads so your hips are fixed.
Hold the handles or brace your arms on the pads.
Rotate your torso to one side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return to center slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cross Twisting Sit Up V. 2
added.namePl: Skrzyżowane brzuszki ze skrętem v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

added.name: Kettlebell Swing Clean Grip Front Squat Overhead Press
added.namePl: Wymach kettlebella, zarzut, przysiad przedni i wyciskanie nad głowę
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell and swing it back between your legs.
Swing it up, then clean it to the rack position at your shoulder.
Squat down with the bell held in front of you.
Stand up and press the bell overhead.
Lower it back with control for the next rep.
Switch arms after your set.

added.name: Kettlebell Forward Lunge V. 2
added.namePl: Wykrok w przód z kettlebellem v. 2
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at chest height or by your side.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs.

added.name: Burpee Push Up Mountain Climber Complex
added.namePl: Zestaw burpee, pompka i mountain climber
instructions: Stand tall, then drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back.
Do one push-up.
Run your knees in and out for several mountain climbers.
Jump your feet in toward your hands.
Jump up with arms overhead.
Keep a steady pace and a tight core.

added.name: V Up Hold
added.namePl: Zatrzymanie v-up
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Lift your legs and straighten them to form a V.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Keep your chest open and back from rounding.
Lower with control.

added.name: Lever Abduction Leg Raise
added.namePl: Odwodzenie nogi na maszynie
instructions: Set up in the machine with the pad on the outside of your leg.
Hold the supports for stability.
Raise your leg out to the side in a controlled motion.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Cable Kneeling One Arm Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Standing One Arm Hammer Curl (With Rope)
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia chwytem młotkowym jednorącz stojąc na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Attach the rope to a low pulley and hold it with one hand, thumb up.
Stand tall with your elbow tucked in.
Curl the rope toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the top for a second.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Stick Assisted Isometric Core
added.namePl: Izometryczne ćwiczenie brzucha z kijem
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a stick in both hands.
Raise the stick to the position you are cued for and keep your arms steady.
Brace your abs as if preparing for a light punch and tuck the ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the stick slowly and shake out your arms.

added.name: Standing Abdominal Vacuum
added.namePl: Próżnia brzucha stojąc
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips and feet hip-width apart.
Exhale fully until your lungs feel empty.
Pull your belly button toward your spine and hold it there.
Hold for 10-20 seconds without breathing in deeply.
Relax and breathe normally, then repeat.

added.name: Lever Pronated Grip Seated Row (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie nachwytem w siadzie na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grab the handles with palms facing down.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly until your arms extend.
Keep your torso steady.

added.name: Lever Pronated Grip Seated Scapular Retraction Shrug (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Szrugsy z ściąganiem łopatek nachwytem w siadzie na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles overhand with arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows much.
Hold for a second.
Let your shoulder blades spread slowly.
Avoid shrugging toward your ears.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Drag Curl V. 2
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z przeciąganiem wzdłuż tułowia z hantlami stojąc v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl the weights up, keeping them close to your torso.
Let your elbows travel slightly back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still.

added.name: Ez Bar 21s
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion 21 powtórzeń ze sztangą łamaną
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Do 7 full-range curls.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.

added.name: Barbell Kas Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder kas ze sztangą
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
Lower under control and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Cross Raise
added.namePl: Krzyżowe unoszenie hantla jednorącz stojąc
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell by your opposite hip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally up and across to head height.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Explosive Push Up
added.namePl: Wybuchowa pompka
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands lift off.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.
Keep your body in a straight line.

added.name: Front Plank with Arm and Leg Lift (Form Check)
added.namePl: Deska z unoszeniem ręki i nogi (kontrola formy)
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.

added.name: Dumbbell 21s
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion 21 powtórzeń z hantlami
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Do 7 full-range curls.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.

added.name: Cable Medius Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie na mięsień pośladkowy średni na wyciągu
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and clip it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the stack, hold the frame and keep your torso tall.
Sweep the working leg out and slightly back, leading with the heel.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Rounded Back Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie pleców z zaokrąglonymi plecami
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper back round slightly.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and lift until your body is nearly in line.
Stop before overarching and repeat with control.

added.name: Lying Bent Legs Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ugiętych nóg w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips or by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor.
Curl your hips up slightly as you bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly without letting your lower back arch.
Repeat for the target reps.

added.name: Shoulder Width Neutral Grip Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie chwytem neutralnym na szerokość barków
instructions: Grab neutral-grip handles about shoulder width apart and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull your chest toward your hands until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
Avoid swinging or kicking.

added.name: Supinated Narrow Grip Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem wąskim chwytem
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders pulled down.
Pull your elbows down and in until your chin is above the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
Keep your legs still and avoid swinging.

added.name: Barbell Staggered Stance Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust ze sztangą w rozkroku krokowym
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a barbell over your hips.
Place one foot slightly ahead of the other.
Drive through your feet to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, keeping your chin tucked.
Lower under control, and swap the foot position on the next set.

added.name: Vertical Leg Raise (On Parallel Bars) V. 2
added.namePl: Pionowe unoszenie nóg (na poręczach) v. 2
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pushed down.
Keep your legs together and slightly bent or straight.
Raise your legs until they reach hip height or higher, curling your pelvis.
Lower them slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the target reps.

added.name: High Knee Lunge on Bosu Ball
added.namePl: Wykrok z wysokim kolanem na piłce bosu
instructions: Stand with one foot on the bosu dome and the other behind you.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back knee up high.
Land softly and balanced, then repeat.
Switch legs after your set.

added.name: Close Grip Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie wąskim chwytem
instructions: Grip the bar with hands a few centimetres apart, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and engage your shoulders.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.

added.name: Single Leg Hopping
added.namePl: Podskoki na jednej nodze
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms ready.
Hop up and forward or in place using your ankle and knee.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Stay balanced and keep your hips level.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Weighted Seated Calf Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce w siadzie z obciążeniem v. 2
instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on a raised edge and weight resting on your knees.
Lower your heels until you feel a calf stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

added.name: Weighted Seated Single Calf Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce jednonóż w siadzie z obciążeniem v. 2
instructions: Sit with one forefoot on a raised edge and weight on that knee.
Lower the heel for a full stretch.
Press up onto the ball of your foot as high as possible.
Pause, then lower under control.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Elevated Goblet Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad kielichowy z kettlebellem na podwyższeniu
instructions: Stand with heels on a low plate, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your chest tall and elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your knees as deep as comfortable.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Plank Pass Through
added.namePl: Deska z przekładaniem hantla
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell beside one hand and feet wide.
Brace your core and keep hips level.
Reach the free hand under your body and grab the dumbbell.
Pass it across to the other side and place it down.
Repeat, alternating sides.

added.name: Weighted Plate Overhead March
added.namePl: Marsz z talerzem nad głową
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with ribs down and core braced.
Lift one knee toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee in a controlled march.
Keep the plate steady and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Bench Dip on Stability Ball
added.namePl: Pompki tyłem na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips and heels on a stability ball.
Slide your hips off the bench with arms straight.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, keeping them close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and the ball steady.

added.name: Twist Crunch (Legs Up)
added.namePl: Skręty z spięciem brzucha (nogi w górze)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and legs raised.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat to the other side.
Do not pull on your neck.

added.name: Decline Sit Up V. 3
added.namePl: Brzuszki na ławce skośnej głową w dół v. 3
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads on a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Lower back slowly without dropping.
Keep your neck relaxed.

added.name: Supinated Grip Inverted Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie odwrócone podchwytem
instructions: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with palms facing you.
Hang with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Leaning Forward One Arm Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w klęku z pochyleniem do przodu na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Lean your torso forward and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish reps and switch sides.

added.name: Ring Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie na kółkach
instructions: Grab the rings and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulders down.
Pull until the rings reach your chest or chin passes them.
Turn your palms slightly in as you rise if comfortable.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

added.name: Cable Standing One Arm Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull jednorącz stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at upper chest height with a single handle.
Stand tall and grab the handle with one hand.
Pull toward your face, elbow high and out.
Rotate your hand back slightly at the end.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.

added.name: Hip Circle with Hula Hoop
added.namePl: Krążenia bioder z hula hoop
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding the hoop against your lower back.
Give it a push and start swinging your hips in circles.
Keep the motion smooth and steady.
Stay tall with a braced core.
Continue for a set time, then switch direction.

added.name: Lever Seated Bent over Rear Delt Fly
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki w opadzie tułowia w siadzie na maszynie
instructions: Sit on the machine with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause, then return slowly.
Do not shrug.

added.name: Cable Standing Crossover Overhead Tricep Extension
added.namePl: Krzyżowe prostowanie ramion nad głową stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Set two high pulleys with handles and face away from the stack.
Hold the handles overhead with elbows bent.
Cross your hands as you straighten your arms.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.

added.name: Weighted Full Squat with Overhead Press
added.namePl: Pełny przysiad z wyciskaniem nad głowę z obciążeniem
instructions: Hold the weight at your shoulders and stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down deeply with chest up.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the weight overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulders and repeat.

added.name: High Knee Tap
added.namePl: Dotykanie wysokich kolan
instructions: Stand tall with hands out in front at waist height.
Drive one knee up to tap your hand.
Lower it and switch quickly to the other knee.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a fast, steady pace for time.

added.name: Cable Seated Lats Focused Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na najszersze w siadzie na wyciągu
instructions: Sit at the cable row with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats, then extend slowly.
Keep your chest up.

added.name: Dumbbell Kas Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder kas z hantlem
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
Lower under control and repeat.

added.name: Negative Push Up
added.namePl: Negatywna pompka
instructions: Start at the top of a push-up with straight arms.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor over 3-5 seconds.
Drop to your knees or reset at the bottom.
Return to the top and repeat.

added.name: Barbell Paused Sumo Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo ze sztangą z pauzą
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and pull the slack out of the bar.
Lift the bar a few centimetres and pause for 1-2 seconds.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall.
Lower the bar under control.

added.name: Ez Bar Seated Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków ze sztangą łamaną w siadzie
instructions: Sit on a bench with forearms on your thighs and wrists past your knees.
Hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Lower the bar by opening your fingers slightly.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Keep your forearms still.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Single Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka jednorącz w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel facing a high cable with a single handle in one hand.
Reach up to a full stretch.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly and switch sides.

added.name: Rear Shift Lunge from Deficit
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z przesunięciem z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand on a low step with feet together.
Step one leg back and down to the floor.
Lower into a lunge with the front knee over the foot.
Push through the front heel to step back up.
Complete reps and switch legs.

added.name: Lever Ab Coaster Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha na maszynie ab coaster
instructions: Sit on the machine, set the seat and grab the handles.
Place your legs on the pads and keep your back against the support.
Exhale and crunch your torso and knees toward each other.
Pause when your abs are fully squeezed.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.

added.name: Inchworm and Mountain Climbers
added.namePl: Inchworm i mountain climbers
instructions: Stand tall, then hinge forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Drive your knees to your chest alternately for several reps.
Walk your hands back to your feet.
Stand up and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Prone Rear Delt Swing
added.namePl: Wymach hantlami na tylne aktony w leżeniu przodem
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Swing the weights out and up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your torso still.

added.name: Band Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

added.name: Band Standing Chest Press V. 2
added.namePl: Wyciskanie stojąc z gumą v. 2
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and hold the ends at chest height.
Stand in a split stance for balance.
Press your hands forward until arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Cable Standing Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at upper chest height with a handle.
Stand tall and pull toward your face.
Spread your hands apart at the end.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

added.name: Biceps Curl Front Step
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z krokiem do przodu
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and palms up.
Step one foot forward while curling your hands up to your shoulders.
Step back as you lower your arms.
Alternate legs at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your elbows pinned and your core tight.

added.name: Landmine Hack Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad hack na landmine
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep the bar close.

added.name: Bodyweight Narrow Stance Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad w wąskim rozstawie z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with feet close together.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Sit down and back, keeping your heels down.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Press up to stand.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Bent Arm Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli bokiem z ugiętymi ramionami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with elbows bent about 90 degrees.
Raise your elbows out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Avoid swinging.

added.name: Barbell Shoulder Grip Upright Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie sztangi wzdłuż tułowia chwytem na szerokość barków
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with hands shoulder width.
Pull the bar up along your body.
Lead with your elbows up to chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bar close.

added.name: Barbell Narrow Stance Squat V. 2
added.namePl: Przysiad ze sztangą w wąskim rozstawie v. 2
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back with feet close together.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand back up through your feet.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Dumbbell Narrow Stance Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z hantlami w wąskim rozstawie
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with feet close together.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to stand.
Keep your heels down.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent Arm Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli bokiem z ugiętymi ramionami
instructions: Stand with dumbbells and elbows bent.
Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your torso still.

added.name: Landmine Kneeling One Arm Shoulder Press V. 2
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz w klęku na landmine v. 2
instructions: Kneel holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your set.

added.name: Incline Push Up (On Bench)
added.namePl: Pompka na skosie (na ławce)
instructions: Place hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight.

added.name: Hollow Rock
added.namePl: Hollow rock
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Rock back and forth like a boat.
Keep your body rigid.
Continue for reps or time.

added.name: Cable Standing Face Pull (With Rope)
added.namePl: Face pull stojąc na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Grab it with both hands.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

added.name: Cable Side Bend V. 2
added.namePl: Skłony boczne na wyciągu v. 2
instructions: Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle.
Keep your hips still.
Bend sideways away from the cable.
Return to upright.
Switch sides.

added.name: Cable Seated Face Pull (With Rope)
added.namePl: Face pull w siadzie na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Sit facing a cable with a rope attachment.
Sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your face.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

added.name: Barbell Anderson Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad andersona ze sztangą
instructions: Set the bar in safety pins at the bottom of a squat.
Get under it and brace.
Drive up from a dead stop.
Lower back to the pins.
Reset on every rep.

added.name: Barbell Pin Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi z ogranicznikami
instructions: Set the pins just above your chest.
Lie under the bar with a firm grip.
Press the bar up.
Lower to the pins and pause.
Repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Row with Chest Support
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie hantlami w opadzie tułowia z podparciem klatki piersiowej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Let your arms hang.
Row the weights up toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Barbell Power Shrug
added.namePl: Power shrug ze sztangą
instructions: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh.
Dip your knees slightly.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Lower the bar under control.
Keep your arms straight.

added.name: Barbell Behind the Back Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą zza pleców
instructions: Stand in front of the bar behind your legs.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
Lower the bar under control.
Keep your back flat.

added.name: Cable Seated Leg Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie nóg w siadzie na wyciągu
instructions: Sit on a bench with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Hold the bench.
Extend your leg until straight.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull z hantlami w opadzie tułowia
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells toward your face, flaring your elbows out and up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control and repeat without swinging.

added.name: Dumbbell High Pull
added.namePl: High pull z hantlami
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells hanging in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees and hips slightly, keeping your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and pull the weights up with elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height, elbows above your wrists.
Lower the dumbbells under control and reset.

added.name: Dumbbell Z Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli z press
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and sit tall without leaning back.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.

added.name: Barbell Standing Shoulder Pin Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi nad głowę stojąc z ogranicznikami
instructions: Set the bar on safety pins at about shoulder height in a rack.
Step under it and grip just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lower the bar to rest on the pins, pause, and repeat.

added.name: Barbell Strict Curl
added.namePl: Ścisłe uginanie ramion ze sztangą
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and your torso still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.

added.name: Barbell Zercher Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg zerchera ze sztangą
instructions: Place the bar on a low rack or the floor and stand over it.
Squat down and hook the bar in the crooks of your elbows.
Lift your chest and brace your core.
Stand up by driving through your legs and extending your hips.
Lower the bar back down under control, keeping your back flat.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Kas Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder kas jednonóż z masą ciała
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your standing shin close to vertical.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips until in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Bodyweight B Stance Good Morning
added.namePl: Good morning w rozkroku krokowym z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with one foot flat and the other slightly behind, toe resting on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the front leg.
Return to standing and switch legs after your set.

added.name: Side Mountain Climber
added.namePl: Boczny mountain climber
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow.
Return that foot and switch quickly to the other leg.
Keep your hips low and your core tight.
Continue at a brisk pace for the set time.

added.name: Crossed Arms Front Leg Kick
added.namePl: Kopnięcie przodem ze skrzyżowanymi ramionami
instructions: Stand tall with your arms crossed over your chest.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Kick the other leg forward to about hip height with control.
Lower it and repeat for your reps.
Switch legs and keep your torso upright.

added.name: Cheat Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z zamachem
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Lean back slightly and swing your hips to start the lift.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower the bar slowly, resisting its weight.
Reset your posture before the next rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Lying Row on Rack
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie hantlami w leżeniu na stojaku
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights up toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

added.name: Dumbbell Walking Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce z hantlami w marszu
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Step forward and stay up on your toes.
Alternate steps, keeping your heels lifted.
Walk for the set distance, then lower your heels.

added.name: 45 Degrees Side Bend
added.namePl: Skłony boczne pod kątem 45 stopni
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench, lying on your side with your feet anchored.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor.
Bend up sideways by contracting your oblique.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Bodyweight Walking Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce w marszu z masą ciała
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Take a step forward, staying on your toes.
Keep alternating steps without dropping your heels.
Lower your heels when you reach the end of the set.

added.name: Barbell Pin Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad ze sztangą z ogranicznikami
instructions: Set the safety pins at the depth you want and place the bar on them.
Duck under the bar and lift it onto your upper back.
Squat down until the bar rests on the pins.
Pause briefly while staying tight.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

added.name: Barbell Deadlift from Deficit
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand on a low plate or platform with the bar over mid-foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back and brace your core.
Push the floor away and stand tall.
Lower the bar back under control.

added.name: Cable Incline Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion na ławce skośnej na wyciągu
instructions: Set a low cable and lie back on an incline bench facing away from the stack.
Hold the handles with your arms hanging behind you.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows back and still.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Barbell Hang Power Clean
added.namePl: Power clean ze sztangą z zawisu
instructions: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with an overhand grip and a flat back.
Hinge slightly so the bar sits just above your knees.
Jump and shrug explosively, extending hips and knees.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower the bar back to the hang.

added.name: Barbell Clean High Pull
added.namePl: Clean high pull ze sztangą
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and a flat back.
Lift the bar to your knees with your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height with elbows high and outside.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

added.name: Barbell Jefferson Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg jeffersona ze sztangą
instructions: Stand straddling the bar with one foot forward and one back.
Squat down and grip the bar with one hand in front and one behind.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Stand up by driving through both legs.
Lower the bar with control and switch your stance on the next set.

added.name: Suspension Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with your body in a straight line.
Start with your arms out in front of you, slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest between the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your chest to bring your arms back together.

added.name: Suspension Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your hands by your chest and elbows bent.
Press yourself away until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips in line.
Lower back slowly with control.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Crunch V. 2
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w klęku na wyciągu v. 2
instructions: Kneel below a high cable with the rope held beside your head.
Keep your hips still and your back slightly rounded.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without sitting back on your heels.

added.name: Plyo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad plyometryczny
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit into a squat with your chest up.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on bent knees and go straight into the next squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust V. 2
added.namePl: Hip thrust z hantlem v. 2
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top with your chin tucked.
Lower under control and repeat.

added.name: Single Leg Thrusts
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your arms out for balance.
Drive through your heel to lift your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Lever Reverse Vertical Hack Squat
added.namePl: Odwrotny pionowy przysiad hack na maszynie
instructions: Set the machine and stand with your chest against the pad, feet on the platform.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knees and lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Bodyweight Lying Prone Ys
added.namePl: Litery y w leżeniu przodem z masą ciała
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs toward the ceiling.
Lift your arms off the floor, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Band Assisted Muscle Up
added.namePl: Muscle up z gumą wspomagającą
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang from the bar with a false or overhand grip.
Pull explosively, bringing your chest to the bar.
Lean over the bar and press yourself up to straight arms.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.

added.name: Reverse Hyperextension on Bench
added.namePl: Odwrotna hiperekstensja na ławce
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hold the bench for support.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until level with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

added.name: Wide Glute Pulse Bridge
added.namePl: Szerokie pulsowanie w mostku na pośladki
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet wide apart.
Lift your hips to the top of a bridge.
Pulse your hips up and down in small, controlled movements.
Keep your glutes squeezed throughout.
Lower fully after your set.

added.name: Kicks Leg Bent
added.namePl: Kopnięcia z ugiętą nogą
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent, pressing your foot toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.

added.name: 45 Degree Hyperextension (Arms in Front of Chest)
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja 45 stopni (ręce przed klatką piersiową)
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise yourself until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.

added.name: Cable Low Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie dolne na wyciągu
instructions: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with elbows bent.
Press the handles up and forward in an arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands meet.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Lever One Arm Side Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie jednorącz bokiem na maszynie
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip one handle at chest level.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your set.

added.name: Dumbbell One Arm Side Lying Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantla jednorącz w leżeniu na boku na ławce
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with a dumbbell in the top hand.
Bring the weight to your chest.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to the chest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Weighted Full Can Exercise
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie full can z obciążeniem
instructions: Hold a light weight in each hand with thumbs pointing up.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Empty Can Exercise
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie empty can z hantlami
instructions: Hold light dumbbells with your thumbs pointing down.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to shoulder height.
Hold briefly without shrugging.
Lower slowly with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Prone Full Can Exercise
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie full can z hantlami w leżeniu przodem
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or floor with light dumbbells hanging.
Turn your thumbs to the ceiling.
Raise your arms out diagonally into a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly under control.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Shoulder 90 Degrees External Rotation Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie z rotacją zewnętrzną barku przy 90 stopniach w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel next to a cable with your elbow at shoulder height and bent 90 degrees.
Hold the handle and brace your core.
Rotate your forearm upward until it points to the ceiling.
Press the handle overhead.
Reverse the movement slowly and switch sides.

added.name: Prone Y Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w układzie y w leżeniu przodem
instructions: Lie face down with arms stretched overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs up.
Lift your arms, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

added.name: Smith Rear Lunge V. 2
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył na maszynie smitha v. 2
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand tall.
Step one foot back behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Resistance Band Pull Through
added.namePl: Przeciąganie gumy oporowej między nogami
instructions: Anchor the band low and face away from it, holding the band between your legs.
Step forward until you feel tension, feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your arms relaxed and straight.

added.name: Lever Incline Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki na skosie na maszynie
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your upper chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.

added.name: Single Arm Side Straight Arm Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie prostych ramion jednorącz w bok
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with one handle in your hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and slightly angled.
Pull the handle down toward your thigh by squeezing your lat.
Hold briefly.
Let it rise slowly and switch sides after your set.

added.name: Cross Standing Crunch
added.namePl: Krzyżowe spięcia brzucha stojąc
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee and rotate your torso.
Bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides for the set.

added.name: Barbell Incline Rear Delt Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie sztangą na tylne aktony na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a barbell with a wide grip.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the bar up with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Kettlebell Standing Calf Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce stojąc z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the balls of your feet on a step if you like.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Rise as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.

added.name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
added.namePl: Zarzut i wyciskanie kettlebella
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and hinge to grip it.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up to your shoulder.
Brace your core and press the bell overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bicep near your ear.
Lower to the shoulder, then back to the floor, and switch sides.

added.name: Kettlebell Concentration Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z podparciem łokcia z kettlebellem
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and a kettlebell in one hand.
Rest your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands or one.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the kettlebell toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower with control.

added.name: Kettlebell Floor Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki z kettlebellami na podłodze
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides until the elbows touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
Repeat with control.

added.name: Kettlebell Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie kettlebella przodem
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands by the sides of the handle.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the kettlebell to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Kettlebell Lying Triceps Extension Skull Crusher
added.namePl: Wyciskanie francuskie z kettlebellem w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Repeat with control.

added.name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków z kettlebellem
instructions: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a kettlebell.
Let your wrist extend downward.
Curl your hand up toward you.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Standing One Arm Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia z kettlebellem jednorącz stojąc
instructions: Stand tall with a kettlebell held overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending the elbow.
Straighten your arm back to the top.
Switch sides after your set.

added.name: Bodyweight Swing
added.namePl: Wymach z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging.
Hinge back at your hips and swing your arms between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall.
Let your arms float up to chest height.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

added.name: Wide Stance Jump Squat to Narrow Stance Jump Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad ze skokiem z szerokiego do wąskiego rozstawu
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and squat down.
Jump up, bringing your feet together mid-air.
Land softly in a narrow stance and squat.
Jump again, landing back in the wide stance.
Keep your chest up and move at a steady pace.

added.name: Decline Diamond Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka diamentowa z nogami wyżej
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands close together under your chest.
Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Push back up to straight arms.

added.name: Kettlebell Bent over Alternate Twist Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie ze skrętem naprzemiennie w opadzie tułowia z kettlebellem
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Row one kettlebell toward your hip.
Rotate your torso slightly as you pull.
Lower the weight and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides for the set.

added.name: Ez Barbell Lying Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion w leżeniu ze sztangą łamaną
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows from flaring.

added.name: Cable High Pulley Straight Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową prostym drążkiem na wysokim wyciągu
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms forward and up.
Return slowly.

added.name: Suspension Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your arms overhead and elbows bent.
Extend your arms, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause when your arms are straight.
Lower back slowly.

added.name: Kettlebell Side Plank
added.namePl: Deska boczna z kettlebellem
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold a kettlebell in your top hand pointing up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

added.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise and Front Squat
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce i przysiad przedni z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.
At the top, rise onto your toes for a calf raise.
Lower your heels and repeat with control.

added.name: Crab Walk
added.namePl: Chodzenie kraba
instructions: Sit on the floor, place your hands behind you and lift your hips off the ground.
Keep your hips high and your core braced.
Step with opposite hand and foot to move forward.
Walk for several steps, then go backward.
Keep your head neutral and your arms steady.

added.name: Bodyweight Wood Chop Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z rąbaniem drewna z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped above one shoulder.
Squat down while chopping your hands diagonally toward the opposite knee.
Rotate through your trunk and let your back foot pivot.
Stand up as you swing your arms back up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Barbell Curl Press Extension
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion, wyciskanie i prostowanie ze sztangą
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at thigh level.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders without swinging.
Press it overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Extend, bring the bar back to the front and lower it under control.
Use a light weight to keep your form tidy.

added.name: Dumbbell Curl Press Extension
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion, wyciskanie i prostowanie z hantlami
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights behind your head.
Extend your arms, then bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders and down to your sides.
Keep your torso still and choose a manageable weight.

added.name: Kettlebell Rotational Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z rotacją z kettlebellem
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in both hands.
Push your hips back and lower the bell toward the outside of one foot.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand and unwind.
Repeat to the same side, then switch.

added.name: Weighted Chain Sumo Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo z łańcuchami
instructions: Hang chains on a barbell and stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out.
Grip the bar inside your knees with a flat back.
Push the floor away and drive your knees out.
Stand tall as the chains lift and the load increases.
Lock out with your glutes, then lower the bar under control.

added.name: Safety Bar Good Morning
added.namePl: Good morning ze sztangą bezpieczną
instructions: Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

added.name: Barbell Weighted Chains Sumo Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo ze sztangą i łańcuchami
instructions: Loop chains over the ends of a barbell and take a wide stance, toes angled out.
Bend down and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push through your feet and stand, with the chains adding load as you rise.
Lock out your hips, then lower the bar with control.

added.name: Cable Seated High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową na wyciągu górnym w siadzie
instructions: Sit facing away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to extend the handle up.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep your torso upright and your upper arms still.

added.name: Russian Twist Chop
added.namePl: Russian twist z rąbnięciem
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands together in front of you.
Twist and chop your arms diagonally across your body.
Return to center and chop the other way.
Keep your chest tall and your core tight.

added.name: Cable Single Arm Neutral Grip Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie przodem chwytem neutralnym jednorącz na wyciągu
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold the handle with a neutral grip.
Keep your arm nearly straight and your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Neutral Grip Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla przodem chwytem neutralnym jednorącz
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side with palm facing in.
Brace your core and keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Avoid swinging, finish all reps and switch arms.

added.name: Vertical Sit Up
added.namePl: Pionowe brzuszki
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
Pause at the top.
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.

added.name: 1 2 Stick Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie 1 2 z kijem
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Take quick steps in the set pattern, one then two.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms bent and swinging naturally.
Repeat for 20-30 seconds with sharp, light steps.

added.name: Jump Twist
added.namePl: Skok ze skrętem
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
Land softly with bent knees.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.

added.name: Agility Ball Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie zwinnościowe z piłką
instructions: Set up with a ball in front of you in an athletic stance.
Move quickly around or over the ball with short, light steps.
Keep your hips low and eyes up.
Change direction without crossing your feet.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

added.name: Burpee Twist
added.namePl: Burpee ze skrętem
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
Alternate twist directions each rep.

added.name: Dot Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie na kropkach
instructions: Mark five dots on the floor like the five on a die.
Stand on the balls of your feet next to the pattern.
Hop quickly from dot to dot in your chosen order.
Keep your hops small and your knees soft.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

added.name: L Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie w kształcie litery l
instructions: Place three cones in an L shape, about 5 yards apart.
Sprint from the start cone to the second and touch it.
Backpedal to the start.
Sprint to the second again, turn around the cone and weave around the third.
Return to the start along the same line.
Stay low through turns.

added.name: Ladder Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie na drabince
instructions: Lay an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at the start in an athletic stance.
Step quickly with both feet into each square, one after another.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep your eyes up.
Jog back and repeat for several rounds.

added.name: Lateral Ladder Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie na drabince bokiem
instructions: Stand sideways at the start of an agility ladder.
Step both feet into the first square, one at a time.
Move sideways to the next square with quick steps.
Keep your hips low and your feet light.
Finish the ladder, then repeat facing the other way.

added.name: Plyometric Agility Drill
added.namePl: Plyometryczne ćwiczenie zwinnościowe
instructions: Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
Land softly with bent knees.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.

added.name: T Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie w kształcie litery t
