instructions: Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Backpedal to the start.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.

added.name: X Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie w kształcie litery x
instructions: Set four cones in a square, with a center point.
Sprint diagonally from one corner through the center to the opposite corner.
Shuffle sideways along one edge to the next corner.
Backpedal or sprint diagonally again.
Stay low through turns and repeat.

added.name: 123 Back Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie 123 w tył
instructions: Set a cone line a few yards apart.
Sprint to the first cone and touch it, then back to the start.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Go to the third cone and back.
Stay low when turning.
Rest, then repeat.

added.name: Balloon Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie z balonem
instructions: Toss a balloon into the air in an open space.
Stay on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Move under the balloon and tap it up.
Use small hops to reach it.
Keep it up for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Cone Drill
added.namePl: Ćwiczenie ze stożkami
instructions: Place several cones in a pattern a few yards apart.
Start in an athletic stance.
Sprint or shuffle around the cones in order.
Plant and cut with your hips low.
Finish the course, rest, then go again.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z butelką
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Lower the bottles along your legs to mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

added.name: Figure Run
added.namePl: Bieg po ósemce
instructions: Set two cones about 5 yards apart.
Start next to one cone in an athletic stance.
Run a figure-eight around both cones.
Lean into the turns and keep your hips low.
Run for 20-30 seconds, then change direction.

added.name: High Hurdle Jump to Sprint and Cut
added.namePl: Skok przez wysoką płotkę do sprintu i zwrotu
instructions: Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sprint forward right away.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.

added.name: Partner Shuffle
added.namePl: Doskoki z partnerem
instructions: Face a partner about 2 yards away in an athletic stance.
Have your partner move left or right.
Shuffle sideways to mirror them without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and chest up.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then swap roles.

added.name: Lay Down Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z leżenia
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.

added.name: Side Lying Hip Adduction (Left)
added.namePl: Przywodzenie biodra w leżeniu na boku (lewa)
instructions: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

added.name: Single Leg Bridge with Outstretched Leg (Left)
added.namePl: Mostek na jednej nodze z wyprostowaną nogą (lewa)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.

added.name: Single Straight Leg Glute Bridge Hold (Left)
added.namePl: Utrzymanie mostka biodrowego na jednej prostej nodze (lewa)
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Lying Toe Tap
added.namePl: Dotykanie stopą w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
Bring it back to tabletop.
Alternate legs with control.

added.name: Lying Crunch (Straight Legs)
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha w leżeniu (proste nogi)
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

added.name: Half Squat Side Reach
added.namePl: Półprzysiad z sięgnięciem w bok
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Sit into a half squat.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
Return to center.
Reach to the other side.
Keep your chest up.

added.name: Celebratory Knee Drives
added.namePl: Świętujące unoszenie kolan
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Lower and switch.
Keep a quick, bouncy rhythm.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.

added.name: Side Step Rear Delt Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na tylne aktony z krokiem w bok
instructions: Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Step to the side.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

added.name: Front Leg Kick
added.namePl: Kopnięcie nogą w przód
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Lower it under control.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your torso upright.

added.name: Arm Raise Step in Place
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion z krokiem w miejscu
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Lower them as you continue.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Twisting Crunch V. 2
added.namePl: Skośne spięcia brzucha v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides for your reps.

added.name: Stepback Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie z krokiem w tył
instructions: Stand tall with your arms overhead.
Step one foot back.
Pull your elbows down and in as if doing a pulldown.
Return your arms and foot to start.
Alternate legs at a steady pace.

added.name: Lying Hyperextension Hold
added.namePl: Utrzymanie hiperekstensji w leżeniu
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Keep your neck neutral.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Lying Alternate Frog Kick
added.namePl: Naprzemienne kopnięcia żabki w leżeniu
instructions: Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips on the floor.

added.name: Lying Frog Kick
added.namePl: Kopnięcia żabki w leżeniu
instructions: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Side Plank Pull
added.namePl: Przyciąganie w podporze bokiem
instructions: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Reach your top arm overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Low Seated Row with V Bar
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na wyciągu dolnym w siadzie z uchwytem v
instructions: Sit at the low pulley, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and hold the V bar.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, keeping your torso still.
Extend your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.

added.name: Ab Tuck
added.namePl: Podkulanie nóg do brzucha
instructions: Rest your forearms on the pads and press your back against the backrest, legs hanging.
Brace your core and keep your upper body still.
Raise your knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis slightly at the top.
Pause briefly, then lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Barbell Deadlift from Blocks
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą z podwyższenia
instructions: Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

added.name: Cable Rear Delt Row (Parallel Bar)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na tylne aktony na wyciągu (drążek równoległy)
instructions: Sit facing a low cable with a parallel bar attachment.
Hold the handles with your elbows flared.
Lean back slightly with a straight spine.
Pull the handles toward your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

added.name: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown V. 2
added.namePl: Ściąganie prostych ramion na wyciągu v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a high cable and grab the bar with straight arms.
Hinge slightly at the hips.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Smith Donkey Kick
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie osła na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar of the Smith machine at a low height.
Get on all fours with one foot under the bar.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching legs.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński z butelką
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bottles along your legs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your shoulders back and your core braced.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński jednonóż z butelką
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a bottle in each hand, with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bottles toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Swing
added.namePl: Wymach z butelką
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding a bottle with both hands.
Hinge back and let the bottle swing between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bottle swing to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed, the hips do the work.
Let it fall back and hinge into the next rep.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Front Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad przedni z butelką
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo z butelką
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a bottle with both hands in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower your hips straight down.
Keep your knees pushing out over your toes.
Stop when your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z butelką
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Forward Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w przód z butelką
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs each rep.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Rear Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z butelką
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to come back.
Alternate legs, or finish one side then switch.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Straight Legs Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg na prostych nogach z butelką
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight, with a tiny knee bend.
Hinge forward, sliding the bottles down your legs.
Stop when you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy z butelką
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a bottle across your hips with both hands.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Kneeling Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad w klęku z butelką
instructions: Kneel on a mat with hips over knees, holding a bottle at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Pause lightly, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Overhead Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha nad głową z butelką
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them over your face.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without dropping your head.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Frog Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha żabka z butelką
instructions: Lie on your back with soles together, knees open, holding a bottle on your chest.
Curl your upper body up as you pull your knees in.
Bring your chest toward your knees.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Side Bend
added.namePl: Skłony boczne z butelką
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a bottle in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the bottle without leaning forward.
Return to upright by squeezing your side.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Russian Twist
added.namePl: Russian twist z butelką
instructions: Sit on the floor, knees bent, and lean back a little with a straight spine.
Hold a bottle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the bottle near the floor.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your feet down or lifted for more challenge.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Squatting Alternate Waves
added.namePl: Przysiady z naprzemiennymi falami z butelką
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a bottle in each hand.
Squat down with your hips back.
As you stand, raise one arm up and the other down in a wave motion.
Switch arms on the next squat.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Lying Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie w leżeniu z butelką
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle in each hand at chest level.
Press the bottles straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep your wrists straight.
Lower slowly until your elbows touch the floor or reach chest level.
Repeat for your reps.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Svend Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie svend z butelką
instructions: Stand tall and press your palms together around a bottle at your chest.
Squeeze inward the whole time.
Push the bottle straight out in front of you.
Pause with your arms extended.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia z butelką
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bottles toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Pullover
added.namePl: Pullover z butelką
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the bottle in an arc behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your sides.
Pull it back over your chest.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Bent over Reverse Fly
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki w opadzie tułowia z butelką
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand hanging below you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Concentration Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia z podparciem łokcia z butelką
instructions: Sit with feet wide, a bottle in one hand, and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang fully.
Curl the bottle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Reverse Grip Concentration Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia z podparciem łokcia nachwytem z butelką
instructions: Sit with feet wide, holding a bottle with an overhand grip, elbow resting on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang straight.
Curl the bottle up without bending your wrist.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Kickback
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia w opadzie z butelką
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor, bottle in hand.
Keep your elbow tight at your side.
Straighten your arm behind you.
Squeeze your triceps.
Bend slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Two Arms Kickback
added.namePl: Prostowanie obu ramion w opadzie z butelką
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend both arms straight behind you.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Overhead Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową z butelką
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding a bottle overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.
Keep your upper arms still.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Alternate Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Naprzemienne uginanie ramion z butelkami
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms forward.
Curl one bottle toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly as you curl the other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Avoid swinging your torso.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Alternate Hammer Curl
added.namePl: Naprzemienne uginanie ramion chwytem młotkowym z butelkami
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one bottle up without rotating your wrist.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your elbows pinned.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion nachwytem z butelką
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bottles up with straight wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Upright Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie butelki wzdłuż tułowia
instructions: Stand tall holding bottles in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up along your body, elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bottles close to your torso.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Armpit Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie pod pachę z butelką
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge slightly forward.
Pull your elbows out and up, bottles moving toward your armpits.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie butelki przodem
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie butelek bokiem
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Alternate Front Raise
added.namePl: Naprzemienne unoszenie butelek przodem
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other.
Keep your torso still.
Breathe steadily.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie butelek nad głowę
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Press both bottles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height.
Do not arch your lower back.

added.name: Spider Plank
added.namePl: Deska pająka
instructions: Start in a high or forearm plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.

added.name: Front Leg Lift Under Knee Tap
added.namePl: Uniesienie nogi z dotknięciem kolana
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.

added.name: Back Kick Overhead Press
added.namePl: Kopnięcie w tył z wyciskaniem nad głowę
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
Keep your core tight throughout.

added.name: Bodyweight Skipping
added.namePl: Skipy z masą ciała
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step and hop on one foot while driving the opposite knee up.
Swing the opposite arm forward as you hop.
Switch sides in a rhythmic skip.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Bodyweight Lying Legs Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg w leżeniu z masą ciała
instructions: Lie on your front with your legs straight.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Bend your knees and bring your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower your feet slowly back to the floor.
Keep your hips pressed down throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Unilateral Scapula Raise
added.namePl: Jednostronne unoszenie łopatki z hantlem
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulder blade straight up toward your ear.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Scapula Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie łopatką w opadzie z hantlem
instructions: Hold dumbbells and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending the elbows.
Hold for a moment.
Release the blades and let the weights drop slightly.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

added.name: Bodyweight Standing Scapula Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie łopatką stojąc z masą ciała
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out in front or at your sides.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Release slowly.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders to your ears.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated External Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja zewnętrzna z hantlem w siadzie
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a light dumbbell.
Rest your elbow on your thigh or bent at your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Driver
added.namePl: Driver z hantlem stojąc
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower the weight to your shoulder.
Switch arms after your set.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Arnold Press
added.namePl: Odwrotne wyciskanie arnolda z hantlami w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells overhead with your palms forward.
Lower the weights while rotating your palms toward you.
Stop with the dumbbells in front of your chest.
Rotate your palms back outward as you press up.
Lock out the arms overhead.
Keep your back against the pad.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Front Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla przodem jednorącz w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall holding a dumbbell at your side.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid leaning back.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Straight Arm Crunch V. 2
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha z prostymi ramionami i hantlem v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with straight arms over your chest.
Curl your upper back off the floor, reaching up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

added.name: Dumbbell Reverse Hyperextension on Bench
added.namePl: Odwrotna hiperekstensja z hantlem na ławce
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hold the bench for support.
Raise your legs until they align with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Row Against Wall
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie hantlem w opadzie przy ścianie
instructions: Stand a step from a wall and hinge forward.
Support your forehead or free hand on the wall.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging.
Row the weights toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Alternate Hammer Strict Curl
added.namePl: Naprzemienne ścisłe uginanie ramion chwytem młotkowym z hantlami
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with your palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up without swinging.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your torso still.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Overhead Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Naprzemienne prostowanie ramion nad głową z hantlami w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand overhead.
Lower one dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend the arm back up.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your core braced.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Drag Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z przeciąganiem wzdłuż tułowia z hantlami w siadzie
instructions: Sit holding dumbbells with your palms forward.
Keep the weights close to your body.
Pull your elbows back as you curl.
Drag the dumbbells up along your torso.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Double Concentration Curl
added.namePl: Podwójne uginanie ramion z podparciem łokcia z hantlami w siadzie
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet wide.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward.
Rest the backs of your upper arms on your inner thighs.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

added.name: Dumbbell Reverse Push Up
added.namePl: Odwrotna pompka z hantlami
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor and grip them.
Set up in a plank position.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Stop just above the floor.
Press back up to the start.
Keep your body in a straight line.

added.name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch (Left)
added.namePl: Rwanie hantla jednorącz (lewa)
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip it with your left hand and hinge at the hips.
Drive up with your legs and hips.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body and punch it overhead.
Lock out the arm.
Lower the weight back to the floor with control.

added.name: Kettlebell Bent over Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie z kettlebellem w opadzie tułowia
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the kettlebell toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Overhead Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia nad głową z hantlem jednorącz w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in one hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Overhead Triceps Extension (Left)
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia nad głową z hantlem jednorącz w siadzie (lewa)
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in your left hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch to the right arm.

added.name: Dumbbell Frog Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust żabki z hantlem
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips.
Drive your hips up by pressing through your feet.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your ribs down.

added.name: Dumbbell Lying Leg Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg z hantlem w leżeniu
instructions: Lie face down on a bench.
Grip a dumbbell between your feet.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips on the bench.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Low Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki z hantlami na ławce skośnej nisko
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back.
Hold dumbbells above your chest with a soft elbow bend.
Open your arms out and down in an arc.
Stop at a comfortable chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together.
Keep the elbow bend constant.

added.name: Kettlebell Cossack Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad kozacki z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and stand wide.
Shift your weight to one side.
Squat down with the other leg straight.
Keep the bent knee over your toes.
Push back to the center.
Alternate sides.

added.name: Kettlebell Shrug
added.namePl: Szrugsy z kettlebellami
instructions: Stand holding kettlebells at your sides.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest tall and neck relaxed.

added.name: Band Standing Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion nachwytem stojąc z gumą
instructions: Stand on a band holding the ends with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.

added.name: Side Plank Leg Lift (Left)
added.namePl: Unoszenie nogi w podporze bokiem (lewa)
instructions: Lie on your left side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg slowly.
Lower the leg without dropping your hips.
Repeat for your set.
Switch sides for the right-side version.

added.name: Side Plank with Raised Leg V. 2 (Left)
added.namePl: Podpór bokiem z uniesioną nogą v. 2 (lewa)
instructions: Lie on your left side and prop up on your left forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise your top leg to hip height.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides if you like.

added.name: Kneeling Straight Leg Kickback V. 2 (Left)
added.namePl: Wymach prostej nogi w tył w klęku podpartym v. 2 (lewa)
instructions: Start on all fours.
Extend your left leg straight behind you.
Lift it to hip height.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips level.

added.name: Elbow to Knee Side Plank Crunch (Left)
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha łokieć do kolana w podporze bokiem (lewa)
instructions: Set up in a left side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your top leg slightly.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in front of you.
Extend back out to the straight position.
Repeat for reps, then do the other side.

added.name: Bicycle Crunch
added.namePl: Rowerek
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

added.name: Lying Scissors Cross
added.namePl: Nożyce krzyżowe w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Open your legs wide.
Cross one leg over the other.
Open and cross the other leg on top.
Keep a steady rhythm.

added.name: Dumbbell Rollout
added.namePl: Rollout z hantlami
instructions: Kneel holding a dumbbell in each hand on the floor.
Brace your core.
Roll the dumbbells forward.
Go as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Avoid sagging at the hips.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Twist Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli ze skrętem na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Palms face you.
Press up, rotating your palms forward.
Lock out at the top.
Lower, rotating back.
Keep your shoulders down.

added.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki jednorącz stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable with the handle at chest height.
Step forward for balance.
Pull the handle across your body.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Suspender Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing French Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie francuskie z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core braced.
Avoid arching your back.

added.name: Knee Push Up Chest Pullback
added.namePl: Pompka na kolanach z odciągnięciem klatki
instructions: Start in a knee push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press back up.
Push your hips back toward your heels.
Return to the start.
Keep your core tight.

added.name: Suspender Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion na pasach zawieszenia
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your forehead.
Keep your elbows high.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body straight.

added.name: Ring Arm Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion na kółkach
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows up.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a straight line.

added.name: Ring One Arm Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia jednorącz na kółkach
instructions: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Curl your hand toward your head.
Keep your elbow up.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Ring Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull na kółkach
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Pull the rings toward your face.
Flare your elbows out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Ring Single Arm Rear Delt Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz na tylne aktony na kółkach
instructions: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Pull your elbow out and back.
Squeeze the rear delt.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Barbell Standing Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków ze sztangą stojąc
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Curl your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms still.

added.name: Barbell Standing Wrist Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków nachwytem ze sztangą stojąc
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Extend your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms still.

added.name: Dumbbell Prone Alternate Hammer Curl
added.namePl: Naprzemienne uginanie ramion chwytem młotkowym z hantlami leżąc przodem
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms.
Keep your elbows still.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Naprzemienne uginanie ramion nachwytem z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.
Keep your wrists straight.

added.name: Cable Seated Overhead Curl (Sz Bar)
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion nad głową na wyciągu w siadzie (sztanga łamana)
instructions: Sit facing the cable machine.
Grip the SZ bar and extend your arms.
Curl the bar toward your head.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows high.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Arms Rotate
added.namePl: Rotacje ramion z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees.
Rotate your palms up.
Rotate your palms down.
Repeat smoothly.
Keep your elbows pinned.

added.name: Ez Barbell Standing Single Arm Neutral Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstka chwytem neutralnym ze sztangą łamaną jednorącz stojąc
instructions: Stand holding one end of an EZ bar.
Keep your arm at your side.
Curl your wrist up.
Squeeze the forearm.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable Standing Wrist Roll
added.namePl: Zwijanie liny nadgarstkami na wyciągu stojąc
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine.
Hold the handle with straight arms.
Roll your wrists up.
Roll them back down.
Repeat smoothly.
Keep your arms still.

added.name: Barbell Larsen Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie larsena ze sztangą
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bar.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Unrack the bar.
Lower it to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your back flat.

added.name: Barbell Close Grip Larsen Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie larsena ze sztangą wąskim chwytem
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold the bar with a close, shoulder-width grip.
Lift your feet off the floor and stretch your legs out in front of you.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat on the bench and your core tight throughout.

added.name: Dumbbell Larsen Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie larsena z hantlami
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lie back.
Press the dumbbells up and lift your feet off the floor, legs extended.
Lower the weights to the sides of your chest with control.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core braced so your lower back does not arch.

added.name: Basic to Cross Donkey Kick
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie osła podstawowe do krzyżowego
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one leg back with a bent knee, sole toward the ceiling.
Lower it, then kick it across behind your other leg.
Alternate basic and cross kicks.
Keep your hips level, then switch legs.

added.name: Single Curtsy Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok skrzyżny pojedynczy
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower your hips.
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
Push up and return, then switch sides.

added.name: Bodyweight Low Split Squat
added.namePl: Niski przysiad wykroczny z masą ciała
instructions: Step one foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright and your hands on your hips.
Lower your back knee toward the floor as far as you can control.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Low Split Squat
added.namePl: Niski przysiad wykroczny z hantlami
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
Lower your back knee toward the floor in a controlled way.
Push through your front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Barbell Low Split Squat
added.namePl: Niski przysiad wykroczny ze sztangą
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step into a long split stance.
Brace your core and keep your torso tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor under control.
Press through your front foot to stand up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Side Kick Through
added.namePl: Kopnięcie bokiem z przeprowadzeniem
instructions: Start in a high plank, then rotate onto one hand with your chest turned to the side.
Lift your hips and keep your core tight.
Sweep your top leg under your body and through the gap.
Return the leg to the start with control.
Repeat, then switch sides.

added.name: Bodyweight Slow to Explosive Squats
added.namePl: Przysiady od wolnych do dynamicznych z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat over about three seconds.
Pause briefly at the bottom with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

added.name: Holding Squat
added.namePl: Utrzymanie przysiadu
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then stand up.

added.name: Lying Prone Y Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w y w leżeniu przodem
instructions: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your forehead near the floor and your neck long.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.

added.name: Lever Outdoor Seated Leg Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie nóg w siadzie na maszynie plenerowej
instructions: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Place your feet on the footplates, shoulder-width apart.
Push the plates away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Bend your knees to return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Lever Outdoor Seated Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie klatki w siadzie na maszynie plenerowej
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles at chest height.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Let the handles come back slowly and repeat.

added.name: Lever Outdoor Seated Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka w siadzie na maszynie plenerowej
instructions: Sit down and grab the handles overhead.
Lean back very slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let your arms rise slowly until fully stretched, then repeat.

added.name: Ez Barbell Standing Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków ze sztangą łamaną stojąc
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still and close to your body.
Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar a short distance.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms still at your sides.
Curl your wrists up, bringing the dumbbells toward your forearms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Cable Standing Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków na wyciągu stojąc
instructions: Face a low cable pulley and grab the handle with an underhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows tucked.
Curl your wrists upward against the cable.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Ez Barbell Standing Wrist Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków nachwytem ze sztangą łamaną stojąc
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar upward.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Wrist Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków nachwytem z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms still.
Lift the backs of your hands up by extending your wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Cable Standing Wrist Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków nachwytem na wyciągu stojąc
instructions: Face a low cable and grab the handle with an overhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows close to your sides.
Extend your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Hold for a second.
Lower under control and repeat.

added.name: Ez Barbell Seated Wrist Reverse Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków nachwytem ze sztangą łamaną w siadzie
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding an EZ bar overhand.
Let your wrists hang past your knees.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Ez Barbell Standing Back Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków z tyłu ze sztangą łamaną stojąc
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar behind your back with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows still and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to raise the bar slightly.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Back Wrist Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków z tyłu z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand behind your back, palms facing back.
Keep your arms still and your chest tall.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Cable Standing Back Wrist Curl V. 2
added.namePl: Uginanie nadgarstków z tyłu na wyciągu stojąc v. 2
instructions: Stand with your back to a low cable and hold the handle behind you.
Keep your elbows tucked and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Cable Lateral Pulldown with Mag Grip
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka do boku na wyciągu z uchwytem mag
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and grab the grip overhead.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the grip down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly to a full stretch and repeat.

added.name: Ez Barbell Preacher Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion ze sztangą łamaną na modlitewniku
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat.

added.name: Resistance Band Reverse Crunch
added.namePl: Odwrotne spięcia brzucha z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back with a band anchored and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and bring them over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.

added.name: Resistance Band Reverse Crunch V. 2
added.namePl: Odwrotne spięcia brzucha z gumą v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back and hold the band firmly with both hands.
Lift your bent knees over your hips.
Curl your pelvis upward, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension from Plank Position
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion z masą ciała z podporu przodem
instructions: Start in a forearm-height plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your head toward your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

added.name: Dumbbell Good Morning
added.namePl: Good morning z hantlami
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell against your chest.
Soften your knees slightly.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

added.name: Kettlebell Good Morning V. 2
added.namePl: Good morning z kettlebellem v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and tip your torso forward, back flat.
Lower until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return upright.

added.name: 90 Degree Heel Touch V. 2
added.namePl: Dotykanie pięt pod kątem 90 stopni v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Switch and reach your left hand to your left heel.
Keep your core tight and continue alternating.

added.name: Heel Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy na piętach
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, toes lifted.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Adduction
added.namePl: Przywodzenie barku z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handle with your arm raised.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your arm down toward your side.
Keep your elbow straight or slightly bent.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Single Arm Shoulder Flexion
added.namePl: Zgięcie barku jednorącz stojąc z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band with one foot and hold the handle at your thigh, palm down.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Raise the arm forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Single Arm Lateral Shoulder Extension
added.namePl: Boczny wyprost barku jednorącz stojąc z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band at about waist height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm across your body.
Keep your chest tall and core braced.
Sweep the arm out and slightly back to the side with a soft elbow.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap.
Complete all reps, then turn around and switch arms.

added.name: Bear Plank Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie w podporze niedźwiedzia
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and core braced.
Extend one leg back and up, squeezing your glute.
Bring the knee back in without touching down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

added.name: Bodyweight Frog Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust żabki z masą ciała
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your feet close to your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Smith Frog Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust żabki na maszynie smitha
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Put the soles of your feet together, knees open.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

added.name: Side Plank Bent Leg Lift
added.namePl: Unoszenie ugiętej nogi w podporze bokiem
instructions: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Bend your top knee and lift it upward.
Lower it without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Weighted Plate Standing Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie talerza bokiem stojąc
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Band Bent over Rear Lateral Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion bokiem w tył w opadzie z gumą v. 2
instructions: Stand on a band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Cable Single Arm High Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie do góry jednorącz na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Brace your core and stand or kneel tall.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable Single Arm High Scapular Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie łopatką do góry jednorącz na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable high and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your shoulder blade back and down, bending the elbow slightly.
Squeeze at the end.
Release slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Cable Single Arm Low Scapular Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie łopatką dolne jednorącz na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable low and hold the handle with one hand.
Hinge slightly forward with a flat back.
Pull your shoulder blade back toward your spine.
Squeeze for a second.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

added.name: Lever Bent over Row (With Chest Support)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie w opadzie tułowia na maszynie (z podparciem klatki)
instructions: Lean your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handles toward your body, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Lever Bent over Neutral Grip Row (With Chest Support)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie chwytem neutralnym w opadzie tułowia na maszynie (z podparciem klatki)
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and take a neutral grip on the handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Lever Bent over Single Arm Neutral Grip Row (With Chest Support)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz chwytem neutralnym w opadzie tułowia na maszynie (z podparciem klatki)
instructions: Lean your chest against the pad and grip one handle, palm in.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lever Bent over Wide Grip Row (With Chest Support)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie szerokim chwytem w opadzie tułowia na maszynie (z podparciem klatki)
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and take the wide handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles back with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Lever Bent over Single Arm Wide Grip Row (With Chest Support)
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz szerokim chwytem w opadzie tułowia na maszynie (z podparciem klatki)
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and grip one wide handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back with your elbow flaring out.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Lever Linear Hack Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad hack liniowy na maszynie
instructions: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your feet to stand.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.

added.name: Push Up Pull
added.namePl: Pompka z przyciąganiem
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up.
Press back up to the top.
Drag one hand across the floor as if pulling yourself forward.
Alternate sides and keep your core tight.

added.name: Bodyweight Bench Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad do ławki z masą ciała
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lightly touch the bench with your glutes without dropping onto it.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

added.name: Cable Kneeling High to Low Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki z góry do dołu w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Set the cables high and kneel between them, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms down and together in front of your hips.
Squeeze your chest at the bottom.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Cable Front Raise (Rope Attachment)
added.namePl: Unoszenie przodem na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope ends and let your arms hang with the cable between your legs.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height with soft elbows.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the stack rest.
Keep your torso still, no swinging.

added.name: Cable Goblet Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad goblet na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a handle or rope to a low pulley and hold it against your chest.
Step back until there is tension and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your feet to stand up.
Keep your elbows pointing down throughout.

added.name: Handstand Hold on Wall
added.namePl: Stanie na rękach przy ścianie
instructions: Place your hands on the floor a short distance from a wall.
Kick up carefully until your heels rest on the wall.
Push the floor away and keep your arms straight.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come down with control.

added.name: Landmine Single Leg Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż z landmine
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with a padded landmine bar across your hips.
Plant one foot on the floor and extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Hanging Hollow Hold
added.namePl: Utrzymanie pozycji hollow w zwisie
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Lift your legs forward a little so your body forms a gentle hollow shape.
Keep your shoulders active and avoid swinging.
Hold the position for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down under control.

added.name: Decline Knee Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie kolan na ławce skośnej głową w dół
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grip the top behind your head.
Extend your legs with a slight knee bend.
Pull your knees up toward your chest, curling the pelvis off the bench.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without letting the hips drop hard.
Keep the movement smooth, not jerky.

added.name: Weighted Plate Standing Around the World
added.namePl: Obrót talerza dookoła świata stojąc
instructions: Stand tall and hold a weight plate with both hands at your waist.
Brace your core and keep your feet planted.
Raise the plate up and over to one side in a wide circle, then around your head.
Bring it back down on the other side.
Keep your hips still as the plate travels.
Do half the reps in each direction.

added.name: Incline Push Up on a Smith Bar
added.namePl: Pompka na skośnej sztandze smitha
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about waist height and rack it securely.
Place your hands on the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up to straight arms.

added.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge with Overhead Reach
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z sięgnięciem nad głowę z masą ciała
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Reach both arms overhead as you lower.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

added.name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and face the machine.
Hold the bar, step back and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs.
Keep your back flat and shoulders pulled back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.

added.name: Landmine Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński jednonóż z landmine
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest and stand on one leg.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip and send the free leg back for balance.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute and return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Glute Ham Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki na maszynie glute ham
instructions: Set your feet under the pads of a glute ham bench, hips on the support.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back to a comfortable depth.
Brace your abs and curl up until your torso is upright.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Keep your lower back from over-arching at the bottom.

added.name: Ab Mat Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki na macie ab
instructions: Lie back on an ab mat with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

added.name: Dumbbell Banded Wall Sit
added.namePl: Przysiad przy ścianie z hantlem i gumą
instructions: Put a band around your thighs and stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands in front of you.
Push your knees out against the band.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

added.name: Weighted Plate Tibialis Anterior Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie stopy z talerzem (piszczelowy przedni)
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest a plate on your forefoot.
Keep your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Lever Ab Swing
added.namePl: Wymachy brzuszne na maszynie
instructions: Sit in the machine and secure yourself with the pads.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Swing your legs to one side using your abs.
Return to the centre with control.
Repeat on the other side.

added.name: Glute Bridge Walk
added.namePl: Chodzenie w mostku biodrowym
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a glute bridge.
Keep the hips high and walk your feet out a few small steps.
Then walk them back in toward your body.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Lower with control when finished.

added.name: Barbell Feet Flat Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi na ławce ze stopami płasko
instructions: Lie on a bench and place your feet flat on it, knees bent.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat and your core tight.

added.name: Bear Crawl Low Hip
added.namePl: Chód niedźwiedzia z niskimi biodrami
instructions: Start on hands and feet with your knees slightly off the floor.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.
Crawl forward with opposite hand and foot.
Stay controlled and quiet.
Crawl for 20-30 seconds.

added.name: Bodyweight Supported Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z podparciem z masą ciała
instructions: Hold on to a sturdy support at chest height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your chest up and your heels down.
Stand back up by pushing through your feet.

added.name: Lever Glute Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie pośladkami na maszynie
instructions: Position yourself on the machine and set your feet on the platform.
Brace your core.
Press the platform away by driving through your heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Smith Curtsey Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok skrzyżny na maszynie smitha
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and diagonally behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel, chest tall.
Press through the front heel to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Band Lateral Walk
added.namePl: Chód boczny z gumą
instructions: Put a loop band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Walk several steps one way, then return the other way.

added.name: Cable High Pull with Rope Attachment
added.namePl: Wyciąganie do góry na wyciągu z liną
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip an end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is taut, with a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let the rope return slowly to the start.

added.name: Barbell Deadlift (Side Pov)
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą (widok z boku)
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace your core, flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out the hips without leaning back.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar under control.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Side Crunch
added.namePl: Boczne spięcia brzucha w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel beside the stack.
Hold the rope at the side of your head.
Crunch sideways, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your side.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

added.name: Weight Plate Standing Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z talerzem stojąc
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate at its sides with both hands, arms down.
Keep your elbows tucked against your ribs.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the plate slowly to full arm extension.

added.name: Supine Windshield Wipers
added.namePl: Wycieraczki w leżeniu na plecach
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.

added.name: Lever Good Morning on the Hack Squat Machine
added.namePl: Good morning na maszynie hack
instructions: Set up under the shoulder pads with feet shoulder-width apart.
Unlock the machine and stand tall.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your knees slightly bent throughout.

added.name: Sled Angled Single Leg Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie jednonóż pod kątem na suwnicy
instructions: Sit in the angled sled and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled by bending the knee.
Go as deep as you can with your back against the pad.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking out.
Keep your hips flat on the seat.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Banded Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust z hantlem i gumą
instructions: Put a band around your thighs and rest your upper back on a bench.
Place a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Plant your feet and push your knees out against the band.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Resistance Band Side Plank Glute Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie bioder w podporze bokiem z gumą
instructions: Put a band around your thighs or ankles and get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise the top leg up against the band.
Pause briefly.
Lower the leg with control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Reverse Hyper with Stability Ball on Flat Bench
added.namePl: Odwrotna hiperekstensja z gumą i piłką na płaskiej ławce
instructions: Lie face down with your hips over a stability ball on a flat bench.
Loop a band around your feet and anchor it low in front.
Hold the bench for stability.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie biodra w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Kneel on all fours with the cuffed leg on the outside.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Lift the knee out to the side against the cable.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Leg Half Circle on Bench
added.namePl: Półkola nogą w klęku na ławce z gumą
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and kneel on a bench with hands on its edge.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Lift one leg out behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return along the same path under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Cable Donkey Diagonal Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie osła po przekątnej na wyciągu
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Get on all fours facing the machine.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
Kick the leg back and slightly out on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Resistance Band Side Walk Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z krokiem w bok z gumą
instructions: Put a band around your thighs or just above the knees.
Drop into a quarter squat with chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take several steps one way, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.

added.name: Cable Seated Foot Eversion
added.namePl: Ewersja stopy w siadzie na wyciągu
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot inward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.

added.name: Cable Seated Foot Inversion
added.namePl: Inwersja stopy w siadzie na wyciągu
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot outward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.

added.name: Kneeling Glute Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie pośladkami w klęku
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Kneeling Single Hamstring Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie jednej nogi w klęku
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Bend one knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Lower the foot slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Side Lying Diagonal Backward Leg Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie nogi po przekątnej w tył w leżeniu na boku
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your bottom arm supporting your head.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Lying Rectus Abdominis Activation Crunch
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha aktywujące mięsień prosty brzucha w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly on your abs or behind your head.
Exhale and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Feel the abs tighten at the top.
Lower back slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Shoulder External Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja zewnętrzna barku w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Shoulder Internal Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja wewnętrzna barku w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the near hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm inward across your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Biceps Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia z hantlem jednorącz stojąc
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell over the Bench Supination
added.namePl: Supinacja z hantlem nad ławką
instructions: Sit by a bench and rest your forearm on it with your hand past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with a hammer grip.
Keep your forearm still.
Rotate your palm up as far as you can.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Seated Tibialis Anterior Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie mięśnia piszczelowego przedniego w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall with your heels on the floor.
Lift the toes of one foot as high as you can.
Press them up against light resistance such as the other foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Twist
added.namePl: Skręty tułowia w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and kneel sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and keep your hips square.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Standing Single Delt Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie na aktony jednorącz stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and grab the handle with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and your torso slightly braced.
Pull the handle toward you with your elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear shoulder at the end.
Extend slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

added.name: Band Seated Hip Abduction V. 2
added.namePl: Odwodzenie bioder w siadzie z gumą v. 2
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with a band around your thighs above the knees.
Keep your feet flat and planted.
Press your knees apart against the band.
Hold for a second at the widest point.
Bring the knees back together slowly.

added.name: Smith Sumo Chair Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo do krzesła na maszynie smitha
instructions: Place a chair behind you and set the bar on your upper back.
Take a wide stance with toes turned out.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the chair.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up.

added.name: Barbell Bench Lateral Step Up
added.namePl: Wejście boczne na ławkę ze sztangą
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back and stand beside a bench.
Put the inside foot flat on the bench.
Press through that heel and stand up on the bench.
Lower the other foot back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Balance Glute Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie pośladkowe z równowagą stojąc z gumą
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or hold it under your standing foot.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and brace your abs.
Kick the other leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Return slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Lying Oblique V Up
added.namePl: Skośne v-upy z hantlem w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lift your legs and torso together, angling toward one side.
Reach the dumbbell toward your feet.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Military Press Russian Twist with Legs Floor Off
added.namePl: Wyciskanie żołnierskie z russian twist i nogami nad podłogą z hantlami
instructions: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower them, then twist your torso to one side.
Twist to the other side and repeat the sequence.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Military Press in Out Leg Raise on Floor
added.namePl: Wyciskanie żołnierskie z unoszeniem nóg do środka i na zewnątrz w siadzie z hantlami
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Pull your knees in, then extend the legs out as the weights stay up.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Repeat, keeping your back long and core braced.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Military Hold Alternate Leg Raise on Floor
added.namePl: Utrzymanie hantli nad głową z naprzemiennym unoszeniem nóg w siadzie
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back a little and press the dumbbells overhead.
Keep your arms locked and steady.
Raise one leg off the floor.
Lower it and raise the other leg.
Keep alternating, then lower the weights.

added.name: Side and Front in Out
added.namePl: Bok i przód do środka i na zewnątrz
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back, hands behind you for support.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Extend your legs out to one side and pull them back in.
Extend them straight in front and pull back in.
Repeat the pattern on the other side.

added.name: Plank Alternate Anti Gravity Pull Up
added.namePl: Naprzemienne podciąganie antygrawitacyjne w podporze
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Pull one arm up and back toward your ribs.
Return it to the floor under control.
Alternate arms without rocking your hips.
