added.name: Dumbbell Alternate V Up
added.namePl: Naprzemienne v-upy z hantlami
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms overhead.
Lift your torso and one leg at the same time.
Reach the weights toward your raised foot.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Alternate legs each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Military Press Russian Twist with Legs Floor Off V. 2
added.namePl: Wyciskanie żołnierskie z russian twist i nogami nad podłogą z hantlami v. 2
instructions: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead and lower them.
Twist your torso to one side, then the other.
Keep your chest tall and breathe steadily.

added.name: Dumbbell Overhead Sit Up with Legs on Bench
added.namePl: Brzuszki z hantlem nad głową z nogami na ławce
instructions: Lie on the floor with calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest or overhead.
Curl up into a sit-up, keeping your arms extended.
Reach toward your knees at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

added.name: Band Lying Bent Knee Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ugiętego kolana w leżeniu z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet or anchored.
Place your hands by your sides and brace your core.
Bring your knees toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your feet slowly without arching your back.

added.name: Barbell Bench Press (Side Pov)
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi na ławce (widok z boku)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Touch lightly and press back up over your shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched throughout.

added.name: Kettlebell Incline Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki z kettlebellami na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze the chest to bring the weights back together.
Control the weights and keep your wrists stable.

added.name: Kettlebell Seated Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie kettlebelli bokiem w siadzie
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Lever Cross Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie na maszynie na krzyż
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down and across toward your torso.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Return slowly to a full stretch.

added.name: Dumbbell Z Press V. 2
added.namePl: Wyciskanie z hantlami w z-pressie v. 2
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back tall.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders under control.
Avoid leaning back during the press.

added.name: Dumbbell Alternate Z Press
added.namePl: Naprzemienne wyciskanie z hantlami w z-pressie
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it and press the other arm.
Keep alternating without tilting your torso.

added.name: Deep Push Up on Parallel Bars
added.namePl: Głęboka pompka na poręczach równoległych
instructions: Grip two parallel bars and hold a straight plank position.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in one line throughout.

added.name: Sitting Scapular Adduction
added.namePl: Przywodzenie łopatek w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides or held in front.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Pull your shoulder blades together and slightly down.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

added.name: Sitting Scapular Adduction V. 2
added.namePl: Przywodzenie łopatek w siadzie v. 2
instructions: Sit tall with elbows bent and hands by your ribs.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your elbows back and pinch your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 2-3 seconds.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Swimming Crawl Style
added.namePl: Pływanie kraulem
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing one arm forward and over in a crawl stroke.
Alternate arms in a smooth, continuous rhythm.
Rotate your torso slightly with each stroke.
Keep going at a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Lateral Hurdle Jump
added.namePl: Skok boczny przez płotek
instructions: Stand beside a low hurdle with feet together.
Swing your arms and jump sideways over it.
Land softly on both feet with knees bent.
Jump straight back over the other way.
Keep your ground contact quick and controlled.

added.name: Band Assisted Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z gumą wspomagającą
instructions: Anchor a band across a rack or set of bars at chest height.
Rest your torso on the band in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press up using the bounce of the band as help.
Keep your body in a straight line.

added.name: Uneven Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie nierówne
instructions: Hang from the bar with one hand higher or on a towel and the other lower.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Lead with the working arm and pull your chin toward the bar.
Lower yourself under control.
Switch the hand positions on the next set.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing T Spine Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli z rotacją piersiową stojąc
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Wrist Full Push Up
added.namePl: Pełna pompka na nadgarstkach
instructions: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers and keep your wrists stacked.
Lower your chest to the floor under control.
Press back to the top.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.

added.name: Downward Dog Push Up Against Wall
added.namePl: Pompka psa z głową w dół przy ścianie
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it with hips back.
Lower your head toward the wall, bending the elbows.
Push explosively away from the wall.
Land softly back into the start position.
Keep your core braced and back flat.

added.name: Stability Ball Rollout on Knees
added.namePl: Rollout na piłce gimnastycznej na kolanach
instructions: Kneel facing a stability ball with your forearms resting on top.
Brace your abs and keep your hips in line with your back.
Roll the ball forward, extending your body.
Stop before your lower back sags.
Pull the ball back in using your abs.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Hands Torsion
added.namePl: Skręty dłoni z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell by its handle in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate your forearms and wrists inward and outward.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

added.name: Weight Plate Standing Hands Torsion
added.namePl: Skręty dłoni z talerzem stojąc
instructions: Stand holding a plate at its sides in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate the plate left and right using your wrists and forearms.
Move slowly and under control.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Reverse Curl Rotate
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion nachwytem z rotacją z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip at your thighs.
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows tucked.
At the top, rotate your forearms so the palms turn up.
Rotate back and lower slowly.
Keep your wrists strong and avoid swinging.

added.name: Lever Seated Single Leg Press V. 2
added.namePl: Wypychanie jednonóż na maszynie w siadzie v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine and put one foot on the platform.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the platform away until your leg is almost straight.
Lower slowly until your knee bends to about 90 degrees.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Lever Seated Leg Extension V. 3
added.namePl: Prostowanie nóg na maszynie w siadzie v. 3
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and shins behind the roller.
Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower with control.

added.name: Ez Barbell Standing Upright Row
added.namePl: Podciąganie sztangi łamanej wzdłuż tułowia stojąc
instructions: Stand tall holding the EZ bar with a shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs.
Pull it up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop around chest height without shrugging hard.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

added.name: Bodyweight Lying Alternate Legs Curl
added.namePl: Naprzemienne uginanie nóg w leżeniu z masą ciała
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top.
Lower the leg slowly.
Repeat with the other leg.
Alternate for the planned reps.

added.name: Side Shuffle High Knee
added.namePl: Krok dostawny w bok z wysokim kolanem
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Shuffle sideways for a few steps.
Lift your knees high with each step.
Stay light on your feet and pump your arms.
Change direction and continue for 30-60 seconds.

added.name: Cable Seated Reverse Shrug
added.namePl: Odwrotne szrugsy na wyciągu w siadzie
instructions: Sit with a low cable behind you, holding the handle behind your back.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders up and slightly back.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly to the start.

added.name: Inline Skating
added.namePl: Jazda na rolkach
instructions: Put on skates, helmet and pads, and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Push one skate out to the side and glide on the other.
Alternate pushes with a relaxed arm swing.
Keep your chest up and your weight over the skates.
Skate at a steady pace for 10-30 minutes.
Slow down gradually to stop.

added.name: Lever Seated Calf Press V. 2
added.namePl: Wypychanie łydek na maszynie w siadzie v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Extend your knees almost fully.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly for a good stretch.

added.name: Lever Seated Single Calf Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie łydek jednonóż na maszynie w siadzie
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Rest the other foot on the floor or the support.
Press up through your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calf.
Lower your heel slowly for a full stretch.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Criss Cross Stepback Hops
added.namePl: Skoki krzyżowe z krokiem w tył
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Hop and cross one foot in front of the other.
Hop back out, then step one foot back behind you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.
Alternate sides for the planned time.

added.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge Abduction
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy z odwodzeniem z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band just above your knees.
Press through your heels to lift your hips.
At the top, push your knees apart against the band.
Bring the knees back together.
Lower your hips slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Resistance Band Lying Bent Knee Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie biodra z ugiętym kolanem w leżeniu z gumą
instructions: Lie on your side with the band above your knees and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and rest your head on your arm.
Lift your top knee up against the band without rolling back.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your feet together like a clamshell.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Seated Bent Knee Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie z ugiętym kolanem w siadzie z gumą
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with the band just above your knees.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press your knees out against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring the knees back slowly.
Keep your back straight throughout.

added.name: Resistance Band Lying Leg Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Unoszenie nóg w leżeniu z gumą v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with the band around your feet or anchored behind your head.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs together toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop just above the floor.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Resistance Band Side Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok boczny z gumą
instructions: Stand with the band under your feet or around your thighs, feet together.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Squat Step Out
added.namePl: Przysiad z wyjściem w bok z gumą
instructions: Place the band around your thighs and stand with feet hip-width.
Sit into a squat and stay low.
Step one foot out to the side against the band.
Bring the other foot in to follow.
Take several steps, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Balance Glute Kickback V. 2
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie pośladkowe z równowagą stojąc z gumą v. 2
instructions: Place the band around your ankles and stand tall on one leg.
Hold a wall or rail for balance if needed.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee.
Kick the other leg back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly without leaning forward.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Lateral Step and Squat
added.namePl: Krok boczny z przysiadem z gumą
instructions: Put the band around your thighs and stand tall.
Step one foot out to the side.
Sit down into a squat.
Stand up and bring your feet together.
Keep the knees from caving in.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Bulgarian Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z gumą
instructions: Stand in front of a bench, band under your front foot and held at your shoulders.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Keep your torso tall.
Press through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Back Kick
added.namePl: Kopnięcie w tył w klęku z gumą
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the band around your foot and hands.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Kneeling Leg Half Circle
added.namePl: Półkola nogą w klęku z gumą
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the band around your thighs or foot.
Lift one leg out to the side with a bent knee.
Sweep it in a half circle, back and up.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Reverse the circle to return.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Plank Jack
added.namePl: Plank jack z gumą
instructions: Place the band above your knees and get into a high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Repeat at a steady pace.

added.name: Resistance Band Lying Hyperextension Abduction
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja z odwodzeniem w leżeniu z gumą
instructions: Lie face down with the band around your ankles.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Open your legs out against the band.
Bring them back together and lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

added.name: Resistance Band Air Bike V. 2
added.namePl: Rowerek powietrzny z gumą v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, band around your feet.
Lift your shoulders and bring one knee toward your chest.
Rotate your opposite elbow toward that knee.
Extend the other leg against the band.
Alternate in a pedalling motion.
Keep a steady rhythm.

added.name: Opposite Arm and Leg Raise Against Wall
added.namePl: Unoszenie przeciwnej ręki i nogi przy ścianie
instructions: Stand facing a wall in a bent over position with your hands on it.
Brace your core.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold for a second without twisting.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

added.name: Floor T Raise V. 2
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w t z podłogi v. 2
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor and neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by pinching your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower with control.

added.name: Ring Wide Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie szerokim chwytem na kółkach
instructions: Grab the rings with a wide overhand grip and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest toward the rings, driving elbows down and out.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

added.name: Kettlebell Plank Pass Through
added.namePl: Przekładanie kettlebella w podporze przodem
instructions: Start in a high plank with a kettlebell beside one hand.
Spread your feet wide for balance.
Grab the kettlebell and slide it across under your body.
Place it down on the other side.
Keep your hips level and repeat in the other direction.

added.name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie goryla z kettlebellami
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor between your wide stance.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grab both handles.
Row one kettlebell to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it and row the other side.
Keep your hips and shoulders square.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Single Arm Y Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla w y jednorącz na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Raise your arm forward and up in a Y shape, thumb up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Scapular External Rotation
added.namePl: Rotacja zewnętrzna łopatek z hantlami stojąc
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your upper arm still and your shoulder blade pulled back and down.
Rotate your forearm outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Scapular External Rotation (Front Pov)
added.namePl: Rotacja zewnętrzna łopatek z hantlami stojąc (widok z przodu)
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm against your side.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Barbell Hook Grip Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg ze sztangą chwytem hakowym
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it with your thumbs under your fingers.
Hinge down, brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out with hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar under control by hinging at the hips first.

added.name: Hanging Front Lever Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie do front lever w zwisie
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your core.
Raise your straight body up toward horizontal, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top position for a moment.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Powell Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli powella na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight below your shoulder.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, leading with your elbow, up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

added.name: Seated Frog Half to Full Sit Up
added.namePl: Brzuszki żabki od półsiadu do pełnego siadu
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out.
Lower your back halfway to the floor under control.
Pause, then lower fully to lie flat.
Curl your torso back up to sitting, using your abs.
Keep your feet together and avoid yanking on your neck.

added.name: Sitting Uppercut on Chair
added.namePl: Sierpowy w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your fists up by your chin.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso and punch one fist upward in an uppercut.
Snap it back and punch with the other hand.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

added.name: Suspension Trainer Pike
added.namePl: Pike na zawieszeniu
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and get into a plank with hands on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and body in a line.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, pulling your feet in.
Pause at the top with legs fairly straight.
Lower back to plank with control.

added.name: Suspension Trainer Front Plank
added.namePl: Deska przodem na zawieszeniu
instructions: Set your feet in the straps and place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold without letting your hips sag or rise.
Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold.

added.name: Bottle Weighted Gorilla Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie goryla z butelkami
instructions: Stand wide with a bottle on the floor between your feet and hinge forward.
Keep your back flat and grip a bottle in each hand.
Row one bottle up to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it, then row with the other side.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Hip Thrusts on Knees
added.namePl: Hip thrust na kolanach z gumą
instructions: Kneel with a band anchored low in front and looped around your hips.
Start with your hips back and chest up.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes hard.
Pause at full hip extension.
Return slowly and repeat.

added.name: Suspension Trainer Squat Power Pull
added.namePl: Przysiad z mocnym przyciąganiem na zawieszeniu
instructions: Hold the straps with arms extended and sink into a squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up through your legs.
As you rise, pull the straps toward your chest.
Lower your arms and sit back into the next squat.

added.name: Resistance Band Leg Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie nogi z gumą
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it low and loop it on one foot.
Stand tall holding something for balance.
Kick the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

added.name: Resistance Band Walk
added.namePl: Chód z gumą
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Sit into a slight squat with feet hip width apart.
Step sideways, keeping tension in the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the band go slack.
Walk back the other way to even it out.

added.name: Trap Bar Overhead Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę ze sztangą trap bar
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and hold it at shoulder height with a neutral grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause, then lower to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

added.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge from Deficit
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z hantlami z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand with your front foot on a low platform, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee steady.
Push through the front heel to return.
Finish reps and switch legs.

added.name: Lever Leg Extension (Inward Toes)
added.namePl: Prostowanie nóg na maszynie (palce do wewnątrz)
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad on your lower shins.
Turn your toes slightly inward.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads for a second.
Lower the weight slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Hyperextension
added.namePl: Hiperekstensja z hantlem
instructions: Set up on a hyperextension bench with the pads at your hips.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise up until your body forms a straight line.
Avoid overarching at the top.

added.name: Hopping Pendulum
added.namePl: Wahadło skokowe
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing the free leg across behind you for balance.
Land softly and stay controlled.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.

added.name: Wide Plank Side Tap
added.namePl: Szeroka deska z dotykaniem boków
instructions: Start in a high plank with feet wider than your hips.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one hand and tap your opposite hip or thigh.
Return the hand and tap with the other side.
Move slowly without rocking.

added.name: Smith Sumo Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo na maszynie smitha
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push your feet into the floor and stand tall.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back.

added.name: Lever Hip Thrust (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Hip thrust na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and belt secured over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

added.name: Pull Up (Negative)
added.namePl: Podciąganie (negatywne)
instructions: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds.
Stop at a full hang with straight arms.
Step back up and repeat.

added.name: Wall Plank
added.namePl: Deska przy ścianie
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your forearms or hands on it.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a slanted line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your head neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Step in to finish.

added.name: Weighted Full Squat from Deficit
added.namePl: Pełny przysiad z obciążeniem z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low plate or platform, holding a weight at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Squat as deep as comfortable.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.

added.name: Reverse Lunge High Knee Forward Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z wysokim kolanem do wykroku w przód
instructions: Stand tall with hands on hips.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive that back leg forward into a high knee.
Step the same leg forward into a forward lunge.
Push back to standing and switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Elevated Two Legs Hip Thrust
added.namePl: Hip thrust na dwóch nogach z podwyższenia
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Crunch Against Wall
added.namePl: Spięcia brzucha przy ścianie
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet and calves resting on a wall, knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Planche Dip on Parallel Bars
added.namePl: Dipy planche na poręczach równoległych
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean forward and shift your weight over your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your body under control.
Keep your core tight and elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.

added.name: Cable Standing Neutral Grip Fly
added.namePl: Rozpiętki chwytem neutralnym stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Set the pulleys at chest height and grab the handles.
Step forward with a staggered stance and a slight elbow bend.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs for a moment.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

added.name: Overhead Sit Up with Legs on Bench
added.namePl: Brzuszki z rękami nad głową i nogami na ławce
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, keeping your arms by your ears.
Reach toward your knees.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Staggered Leg Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy z rozstawionymi nogami
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, one foot forward of the other.
Press through both heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your hips level.
Lower slowly.
Switch the foot position halfway through.

added.name: Straight Leg Glute Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek biodrowy na prostych nogach
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Press your heels down and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your ribs down.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Standing Front and Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli przodem i bokiem stojąc
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms to the front up to shoulder height.
Lower them back down.
Raise them out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower with control and repeat.

added.name: Single Leg Lateral Hop
added.namePl: Skok boczny na jednej nodze
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways a short distance.
Land softly on the same foot and hold your balance.
Hop back the other way.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Spider Mountain Climber
added.namePl: Wspinaczka pająka
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the outside of your elbow.
Return that foot and switch legs.
Keep your hips low and your core braced.
Move at a quick, controlled pace.

added.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat with Calf Raise
added.namePl: Przysiad goblet z hantlem ze wspięciem na palce
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to standing.
Rise onto your toes at the top.
Lower your heels and go into the next squat.

added.name: Double Plank Jack to 4 Mountain Climber
added.namePl: Podwójny plank jack do wspinaczki 4
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Jump your feet wide and together twice.
Do four mountain climbers, driving your knees alternately.
Keep your hips level.
Flow through the sequence at a steady pace.

added.name: Ring Archer Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie łucznika na kółkach
instructions: Hang from rings with a wide grip.
Pull up toward one hand, leaving the other arm straight.
Reach the top with your chin by that hand.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep.

added.name: Ring One Arm Pull Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie jednorącz na kółkach
instructions: Hang from one ring with a firm grip.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Pull your chin up toward the ring.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Complete reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Forward Backward Hop
added.namePl: Skoki w przód i w tył
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Hop forward a short distance on the balls of your feet.
Hop back to the start.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent.
Keep a quick tempo.
Repeat for the planned time.

added.name: Dumbbell Goblet Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo goblet z hantlem
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down between your legs.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.

added.name: Kettlebell Swing to Goblet Squat
added.namePl: Wymach kettlebella do przysiadu goblet
instructions: Swing the kettlebell up to chest height from a hip hinge.
Catch it at your chest in a goblet hold.
Sit into a deep squat.
Stand up and lower the bell back between your legs.
Hinge and swing again.

added.name: Dumbbell Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski goblet z hantlem
instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Push through the front heel and switch legs after your reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat from Deficit
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z hantlami z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand with your front foot on a low platform and your rear foot on a bench.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower until your back knee is near the floor.
Keep your front knee steady.
Drive up and switch legs.

added.name: Bodyweight Heel Elevated Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z uniesionymi piętami z masą ciała
instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and front heel on a small plate.
Hold your hands at your chest.
Lower straight down.
Keep your front knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

added.name: Barbell Zercher Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski zercher ze sztangą
instructions: Rest the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Put your rear foot on a bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up and switch legs.

added.name: Parallel Bars Bent Knee Inverted Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie odwrócone z ugiętymi kolanami na poręczach równoległych
instructions: Lie under parallel bars and grab them.
Bend your knees with feet on the floor.
Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest to the bars.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Jumping Jack High Knee
added.namePl: Pajacyki z wysokim kolanem
instructions: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out and raise your arms overhead.
Jump back in and bring one knee high.
Alternate knees each rep.
Stay light on your feet.

added.name: Squat Jack
added.namePl: Pajacyki w przysiadzie
instructions: Start in a squat with hands at your chest.
Jump your feet out wide.
Hop back to the narrow squat stance.
Stay low the whole time.
Land softly and keep your chest up.

added.name: Wall Sit (Narrow Stance)
added.namePl: Przysiad przy ścianie (wąska postawa)
instructions: Lean your back on a wall with feet close together.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep knees over ankles.
Hold for 20-60 seconds.
Slide back up slowly.

added.name: Wall Sit from Deficit
added.namePl: Przysiad przy ścianie z podwyższenia
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your back on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your back flat.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Slide up carefully.

added.name: Dumbbell Goblet Wall Sit
added.namePl: Przysiad przy ścianie z hantlem goblet
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and lean on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your knees above your ankles.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Stand up slowly.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż z masą ciała
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower down with control.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

added.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Squat with Support
added.namePl: Przysiad jednonóż z podparciem z masą ciała
instructions: Hold a stable support with one hand.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted.
Lower down as far as you can with control.
Use the support only as much as needed.
Push up and switch legs.

added.name: Kettlebell Swing Clean Grip Front Squat
added.namePl: Wymach kettlebella do przysiadu przedniego chwytem zarzutu
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

added.name: Cable Split Stance Single Arm Row
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w rozkroku na wyciągu
instructions: Stand in a split stance facing a low cable.
Grab the handle with one hand.
Row to your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Keep your torso steady.
Return slowly and switch sides.

added.name: Barbell Bent Arm Pullover V. 2
added.namePl: Pullover ze sztangą z ugiętymi ramionami v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your chest.
Keep a slight elbow bend.
Lower the bar behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down.

added.name: Dumbbell Hack Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad hack z hantlami
instructions: Hold dumbbells behind you with your heels slightly raised.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down.
Stay tall.
Drive up through your feet.

added.name: Cable Front Squat with V Bar
added.namePl: Przysiad przedni na wyciągu z uchwytem v
instructions: Hold a V bar at chest height.
Stand a step back from the cable.
Squat down with your elbows up.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand up.

added.name: Kettlebell Contralateral Reverse Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z kettlebellem po przeciwnej stronie
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the opposite leg.
Lower until the back knee nears the floor.
Push through the front foot.
Finish reps and switch sides.

added.name: Kettlebell Ipsilateral Reverse Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z kettlebellem po tej samej stronie
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the leg on the same side.
Lower under control.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up and switch sides.

added.name: Cable Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown
added.namePl: Ściąganie drążka chwytem neutralnym na wyciągu
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown station, thighs secured, and grab the neutral-grip handle.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are fully extended.

added.name: Cable Kneeling High Low Anti Rotation Chop
added.namePl: Rąbanie z antyrotacją z góry do dołu w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Kneel side-on to a high cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Chop the handle diagonally down across your body, arms mostly straight.
Do not let your torso rotate; the arms and shoulders do the travel.
Return slowly under control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Twist Turn Lift
added.namePl: Skręt, obrót i uniesienie
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and arms extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Twist your torso and bring your knees toward one side.
Turn back through the centre and lift again.
Repeat to the other side, keeping the movement smooth and controlled.

added.name: Cable Ipsilateral Glute Dominant Step Up
added.namePl: Wejście na podwyższenie z naciskiem na pośladki na wyciągu po tej samej stronie
instructions: Stand in front of a box with a cable handle in the hand on your working side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Single Arm High Row with Chest Support
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie do góry jednorącz na wyciągu z podparciem klatki
instructions: Set a handle on a high pulley and lean your chest against the support.
Grab the handle with one hand and let your arm extend.
Pull your elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the pull.
Return slowly to full extension, finish your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Weighted Front Raise Hold
added.namePl: Utrzymanie obciążenia uniesionego przodem
instructions: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Raise it straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Keep your arms nearly straight and your ribs down.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, for 20-40 seconds.
Lower the plate slowly with control.

added.name: Cable Kneeling Glute Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie pośladkowe w klęku na wyciągu
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kneel on hands and knees facing it.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the cuffed leg back and up.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Glute Dominant Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z hantlami z naciskiem na pośladki
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Lying Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull w leżeniu na wyciągu
instructions: Lie on your back with the cable set low behind your head and hold the rope ends.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring out and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Cable Incline Rear Delt Fly with Back Support
added.namePl: Odwrotne rozpiętki na tylne aktony na ławce skośnej na wyciągu z podparciem pleców
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cable stations.
Grab the opposite handles, arms hanging with a slight bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder level.
Pause and squeeze your rear delts.
Lower slowly without swinging.

added.name: Sled Glute Dominant Leg Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie nóg z naciskiem na pośladki na suwnicy
instructions: Sit in the sled and place your feet high and wide on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the seat.
Push through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
Lower under control for each rep.

added.name: Cable High Row with Chest Support
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie do góry na wyciągu z podparciem klatki
instructions: Set the cable high and lean your chest against the support pad.
Grab the handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back and slightly down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly to the start.

added.name: Dumbbell Contralateral Glute Dominant Bulgarian Split Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad bułgarski z hantlami z naciskiem na pośladki po przeciwnej stronie
instructions: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Put your back foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Jack Burpee V. 2
added.namePl: Burpee jack v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.

added.name: Barbell Banded Bench Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi leżąc z gumami
instructions: Set bands on the bar and lie on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Unrack the bar over your chest with a firm grip.
Lower it to your mid chest under control.
Press up and out until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet down.

added.name: Barbell Pin Bench Press Conventional Grip
added.namePl: Wyciskanie sztangi z kołków chwytem klasycznym
instructions: Set the pins at a height just above your chest and lie on the bench.
Grab the bar at about shoulder-width plus a little.
Pause the bar on the pins to remove momentum.
Press the bar straight up until your arms lock out.
Lower back to the pins with control and reset for each rep.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z hantlami w opadzie tułowia
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

added.name: Landmine Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z landmine
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

added.name: Landmine Overhead Rear Lunge
added.namePl: Wykrok w tył z landmine nad głową
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you rise, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulder while you lunge back again.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Ipsilateral Single Leg Stiff Leg Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg na prostych nogach jednonóż z hantlem po tej samej stronie
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Sitting Alternate Knee to Elbow Twist
added.namePl: Naprzemienny skręt łokieć do kolana w siadzie
instructions: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

added.name: Cable Half Kneeling Face Pull
added.namePl: Face pull w półklęku na wyciągu
instructions: Set a rope at head height and half kneel facing the stack.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly. Switch the leading knee after your set.

added.name: Cable Standing Supinated Face Pull (With Rope)
added.namePl: Face pull podchwytem stojąc na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Set the rope at face height and grip it with your palms facing up.
Step back and stand tall.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows leading.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

added.name: Standing Supinated Face Pull (With Towels)
added.namePl: Face pull podchwytem stojąc (z ręcznikami)
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.

added.name: Dumbbell Prone W Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w w z hantlami leżąc przodem
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Kettlebell Swing Clean Grip Front Squat V. 2
added.namePl: Wymach kettlebella do przysiadu przedniego chwytem zarzutu v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

added.name: Dead Bug V. 3
added.namePl: Dead bug v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides with a slow tempo.
Keep your ribs down.

added.name: Reverse Air Cycling
added.namePl: Odwrotne rowerowanie w powietrzu
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your hips slightly with hands under your glutes.
Raise your legs.
Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set time or reps.

added.name: Side Plank Twist Arm Delt Raise
added.namePl: Skręt w podporze bokiem z unoszeniem ramienia
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Explosive Dynamic Plank
added.namePl: Dynamiczna deska wybuchowa
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Rest when your form slips.

added.name: Lever Overhead Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową na maszynie
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back supported.
Grip the handles overhead with your elbows pointing up.
Extend your arms until they are almost straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly behind your head.

added.name: Dumbbell Incline Triceps Kickback
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia z hantlem na ławce skośnej
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.

added.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Triceps Kickback
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramienia z hantlem w klęku
instructions: Kneel beside a bench with one hand and the same-side knee on it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.
Extend your elbow to kick the weight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Plate Push
added.namePl: Pchanie talerza
instructions: Stand with a weight plate held at your chest, elbows bent.
Brace your abs and bend your knees slightly.
Push the plate out explosively with both arms.
Fully extend your arms.
Pull the plate back to your chest with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Landmine Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg z landmine
instructions: Load one end of the barbell in a landmine and stand facing it, feet hip-width.
Hinge back and grip the bar end with both hands.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Lower the bar under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Lever Push Up with Towels
added.namePl: Pompka z ręcznikami na maszynie
instructions: Place your hands on towels on the floor in a plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Dumbbell Seated Triceps Extension V. 2
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion z hantlem w siadzie v. 2
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core tight.
Repeat for the planned reps.

added.name: Cable Seated Unilateral Bicep Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia jednostronne w siadzie na wyciągu
instructions: Sit facing a low cable and hold the handle with one hand.
Rest your elbow near your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your set.

added.name: Cable Seated Single Arm Unilateral Bicep Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramienia jednorącz jednostronne w siadzie na wyciągu
instructions: Sit upright with a low cable handle in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Curl up toward your shoulder without leaning back.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower under control, then switch arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge Chest Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantli w mostku biodrowym
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.

added.name: Dumbbell Bent over Y Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w y z hantlami w opadzie tułowia
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise both arms forward and up at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly under control.
Keep your neck long and avoid swinging your torso.

added.name: Resistance Band 45 Degree Hip Extension Glute Focused
added.namePl: Wyprost biodra pod kątem 45 stopni z gumą z naciskiem na pośladki
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree hip extension bench with the band anchored under your feet and held across your upper back.
Cross your arms or hold the band at your shoulders.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to come back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch your lower back at the top.

added.name: Resistance Band Wide Stance Anti Rotation Chop
added.namePl: Rąbanie z antyrotacją w szerokim rozkroku z gumą
instructions: Anchor the band at one side and stand sideways with your feet wide.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core.
Press or chop diagonally while keeping your torso square.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

added.name: Kettlebell Wood Chop
added.namePl: Rąbanie drwala z kettlebellem
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands and stand with your feet wide.
Start with it high beside one shoulder.
Rotate and chop down to the opposite knee.
Pivot your back foot as you turn.
Return with control and switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Hip Thrust V. 2
added.namePl: Hip thrust jednonóż z hantlem v. 2
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Weighted Plate Push Up
added.namePl: Pompka z talerzem
instructions: Have a partner place a plate on your upper back, or set it carefully yourself.
Get into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

added.name: Cable Straight Leg Diagonal Kickback
added.namePl: Odkopnięcie po przekątnej prostą nogą na wyciągu
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Keep your leg straight and kick it back and slightly out to the side.
Squeeze your glute at the top without leaning forward.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Negative Biceps Leg Concentration Curl
added.namePl: Negatywne uginanie ramienia z podparciem łokcia o udo
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and hold a weight in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the weight up with help from your other hand if needed.
Lower it very slowly over about 3 to 4 seconds.
Keep your upper arm still against your leg.
Do your reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Balance Hip Abduction
added.namePl: Odwodzenie biodra z równowagą stojąc z gumą
instructions: Put a band around your ankles and stand on one leg.
Hold something for balance if needed.
Lift the free leg out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs after your set.

added.name: Cable Standing Crossover
added.namePl: Krzyżowanie linek stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Set the pulleys at a high position and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Bring your hands together in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands cross.
Return slowly to a stretch.

added.name: Resistance Band Lying Leg Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie nóg w leżeniu z gumą
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a band around your feet, holding the ends.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Press your feet away until your legs are almost straight.
Control the band as it pulls you back.
Repeat for your reps.

added.name: Triceps Dip on High Parallel Bars
added.namePl: Dipy na wysokich poręczach równoległych
instructions: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.

added.name: Wide Chin Up
added.namePl: Podciąganie podchwytem szerokim chwytem
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

added.name: Cable Standing Hip Flexion
added.namePl: Zgięcie biodra stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Attach an ankle strap and face away from a low cable.
Hold a support for balance.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.

added.name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg sumo z hantlem
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and a dumbbell between your feet.
Hinge down and grab it with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the weight under control.

added.name: Cable Reverse Woodchop
added.namePl: Odwrotne rąbanie drwala na wyciągu
instructions: Set the cable low and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and rotate your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

added.name: Lying Knee Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie kolan w leżeniu
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without arching.

added.name: Sitting Woodchopper on a Chair
added.namePl: Rąbanie drwala w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall on a chair and clasp your hands together.
Raise your arms diagonally up to one side.
Chop down across your body to the opposite knee.
Rotate through your torso.
Alternate sides at an easy pace.

added.name: Sitting Prayer Chest Squeeze on a Chair
added.namePl: Ściskanie dłoni modlitewne w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall on a chair.
Bring your palms together in front of your chest.
Press your palms firmly into each other.
Hold for 10-15 seconds.
Release and repeat.

added.name: Sitting Russian Twist on a Chair
added.namePl: Russian twist w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit near the edge of a chair and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall.

added.name: Deep Knee Bend
added.namePl: Głęboki przysiad
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down as deep as you can.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up to standing.

added.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise Plank
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantli bokiem w podporze przodem
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Brace your core and widen your feet.
Lift one dumbbell out to the side.
Avoid twisting your hips.
Lower and alternate arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Underhand Renegade Row
added.namePl: Renegade row z hantlami podchwytem
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells, palms facing forward.
Widen your feet for balance.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Renegade Row on Stability Ball
added.namePl: Renegade row z hantlami na piłce gimnastycznej
instructions: Place your feet on a stability ball and your hands on dumbbells.
Brace into a strong plank.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

added.name: Resistance Band Renegade Row
added.namePl: Renegade row z gumą
instructions: Anchor a band and get into a plank facing it.
Hold the band in one hand.
Row your elbow back to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Return slowly and alternate arms.

added.name: Dumbbell Renegade Row Walk
added.namePl: Renegade row z hantlami w marszu
instructions: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row one dumbbell up.
Place it down and step the hands forward.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your hips level.

added.name: Biceps Curl Under Table
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion pod stołem
instructions: Lie under a strong table and grip its edge with an underhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the table by bending the elbows.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown (With Rope Attachment)
added.namePl: Ściąganie prostych ramion na wyciągu (z liną)
instructions: Set a rope on a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hinge forward slightly with arms extended.
Pull the rope down to your thighs.
Spread the rope at the bottom.
Return slowly.

added.name: Cable Half Kneeling Single Arm Row V. 2
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie jednorącz w półklęku na wyciągu v. 2
instructions: Half kneel facing the cable with the handle in one hand.
Keep your torso tall.
Row your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

added.name: Resistance Band Drag Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z przeciąganiem wzdłuż tułowia z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the handles at your thighs.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Curl by dragging your hands up your body while the elbows move behind you.
Squeeze at the top for a moment.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.

added.name: Hamstring Bridge
added.namePl: Mostek na mięśniach tylnej strony uda
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels placed a bit farther from your hips.
Press your heels into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

added.name: Resistance Band Standing Single Arm Lateral Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramienia bokiem jednorącz stojąc z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand at your side.
Keep a slight bend in the elbow and your torso still.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Resistance Band Overhead Shoulder Press V. 2
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę z gumą v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep ribs down.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders under control.
Repeat without leaning back.

added.name: Kettlebell Side Swing V. 2
added.namePl: Wymach boczny z kettlebellem v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold a kettlebell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and swing it up and across to one side.
Let it fall back through your legs and swing to the other side.
Keep your back flat throughout.

added.name: Kettlebell Weighted Russian Twist
added.namePl: Russian twist z kettlebellem
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands at your chest.
Keep your back straight and rotate your torso to one side.
Touch the kettlebell lightly near the floor.
Rotate to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your feet down or lifted if you can stay stable.

added.name: Step Out from Squat
added.namePl: Wyjście w bok z przysiadu
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Squat down by pushing your hips back.
Stand up while stepping one foot out to the side.
Bring that foot back in and squat again.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

added.name: Lever Angled Leg Press
added.namePl: Wypychanie nóg pod kątem na maszynie
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back flat on the pad and feet on the platform shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees out.

added.name: Side Floor Tap Plank
added.namePl: Deska z dotykaniem podłogi w bok
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet wide.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Reach one hand out to tap the floor at the side without twisting your hips.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.

added.name: Seated Lean Back on a Chair
added.namePl: Odchylanie tułowia w tył w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.

added.name: Seated Cross Body Punch on a Chair
added.namePl: Cios krzyżowy w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Keep a quick, smooth rhythm.

added.name: Seated Forward Roll Up on a Chair
added.namePl: Zwijanie tułowia w przód w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your arms crossed or reaching forward.
Tuck your chin and round your lower back.
Roll your spine forward one segment at a time.
Reach toward your knees and pause.
Roll back up slowly to a tall position.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

added.name: Bosu Ball Balance Counterbalanced Skater Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad łyżwiarza z przeciwwagą na piłce bosu
instructions: Stand on one foot on the bosu ball and hold your arms in front for balance.
Reach the free leg back behind you.
Sit your hips back and lower into a single-leg squat.
Drive through the standing foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Opposite Shoulder Press
added.namePl: Wyciskanie hantla nad głowę w klęku po przeciwnej stronie
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in the hand opposite the raised knee.
Keep your torso tall and glutes tight.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Twist Down Up Raise
added.namePl: Unoszenie hantla ze skrętem z dołu do góry w klęku
instructions: Kneel on both knees and hold one dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your hips square.
Twist and lift the dumbbell diagonally up across your body.
Reverse the path back down to the hip.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Kneeling to Standing Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad z klęku do stania
instructions: Kneel on both knees with your torso upright.
Step one foot forward and then the other so both feet are flat.
Press up to stand, then sit back into a squat.
Return to kneeling under control.
Alternate which foot steps first.

added.name: Bodyweight Tibialis Raise Wall Supported
added.namePl: Unoszenie palców (piszczelowy) przy ścianie z masą ciała
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a bit in front of you.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep the movement smooth and repeat.

added.name: Mid Back Elbow Squeeze
added.namePl: Ściskanie łokci na środku pleców
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your neck relaxed.

added.name: Lever Seated Leg Curl (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Uginanie nóg na maszynie w siadzie (z talerzami)
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad above your ankles.
Keep your back against the support.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstrings briefly.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

added.name: Resistance Band Sumo Squat
added.namePl: Przysiad sumo z gumą
instructions: Stand on the band with feet wider than shoulders and toes angled out.
Hold the band at your chest or shoulders.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

added.name: Chinese Plank
added.namePl: Chińska deska
instructions: Set up in a plank on your forearms with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily and hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down to rest.

added.name: Dumbbell Preacher Swing Curl
added.namePl: Uginanie ramion z wymachem na modlitewniku z hantlem
instructions: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad and hold dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Keep your shoulders down.
Curl the weights up with a small drive from the bottom.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

added.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Horizontal Triceps Extension
added.namePl: Poziome prostowanie ramienia jednorącz stojąc na wyciągu
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand facing away holding the handle by your shoulder.
Take a split stance for balance.
Extend your arm forward until it is straight.
Return slowly while keeping the elbow still.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

added.name: Seated Elbow Chest Fly on a Chair
added.namePl: Rozpiętki z łokciami w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

added.name: Seated Chest Press on a Chair
added.namePl: Wyciskanie klatki w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Bring your hands to chest height and press your palms together.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Draw them back to your chest slowly.

added.name: Seated Decline Chest Press on a Chair
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na skosie głową w dół w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands at chest height.
Press them diagonally down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the chest and repeat.

added.name: Seated Pec Dec on a Chair
added.namePl: Pec dec w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Open them back to the sides under control.

added.name: Seated Incline Chest Press on a Chair
added.namePl: Wyciskanie na skosie głową w górę w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands near your chest.
Press them diagonally up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.

added.name: Seated Shoulder Press on a Chair
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your hands to shoulder height with elbows bent.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.

added.name: Seated Rotating Boxing Rolls on a Chair
added.namePl: Obracane uniki bokserskie w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists in a boxing guard.
Roll your arms in circles while rotating your trunk side to side.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.

added.name: Seated Shoulder Tap on a Chair
added.namePl: Dotykanie barków w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady.

added.name: Seated Overhead Triceps Extension on a Chair
added.namePl: Prostowanie ramion nad głową w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your arms overhead and bend your elbows so your hands drop behind your head.
Extend your arms back up until straight.
Lower slowly and keep your elbows pointing forward.

added.name: Sled Side Leg Press
added.namePl: Boczne wypychanie nóg na suwnicy
instructions: Position yourself on the sled in a side-facing posture with one foot on the platform.
Brace your core and keep your hips stable.
Push the platform away with the working leg.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

added.name: Cable Incline Y Raise with Back Support
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w y na ławce skośnej na wyciągu z podparciem pleców
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a cable handle in each hand.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly with straight arms.

added.name: Cable Incline Close Grip Shoulder Press with V Bar
added.namePl: Wyciskanie nad głowę wąskim chwytem na ławce skośnej na wyciągu z uchwytem v
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a cable and V bar anchored low behind you.
Hold the bar at chest height with a narrow grip.
Press upward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.
Keep your back against the pad.

added.name: Cable Incline Y Raise Wrist Straps with Back Support
added.namePl: Unoszenie ramion w y na ławce skośnej na wyciągu z paskami na nadgarstki i podparciem pleców
instructions: Fasten the wrist straps to the cables and lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape.
Squeeze your shoulders at the top.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Dumbbell Curtsey Lunge V. 2
added.namePl: Wykrok skrzyżny z hantlami v. 2
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and across behind the other leg.
Lower until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.

added.name: Weighted Bag Walking Lunge
added.namePl: Wykroki w marszu z workiem z obciążeniem
instructions: Hold the bag at your chest or on your shoulders.
Stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward.
Continue, alternating legs.

added.name: Torque Tank Push
added.namePl: Pchanie torque tank
instructions: Grip the handles of the tank and lean forward.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Drive with short, powerful steps.
Keep your hips low and push over the distance.
Rest and repeat.

added.name: Battling Rope Pull
added.namePl: Przyciąganie liny battle rope
instructions: Anchor the rope and hold the ends in a staggered stance.
Lean back slightly with your core tight.
Pull the rope toward you hand over hand.
Keep your chest tall and drive with your legs.
Return smoothly and repeat.

added.name: Burpee Jump Box
added.namePl: Burpee ze skokiem na skrzynię
instructions: Stand facing a box.
Drop into a squat, kick your feet back and lower into a push-up.
Jump your feet back in.
Explode up and jump onto the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.

added.name: Lever Romanian Deadlift (Plate Loaded)
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński na maszynie (z talerzami)
instructions: Stand in the machine and grip the handles with a flat back.
Keep a soft bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as you lower.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.

added.name: Seated Alternate Knee Extension on Chair
added.namePl: Naprzemienne prostowanie kolan w siadzie na krześle
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Straighten one knee by lifting the foot until the leg is level.
Squeeze your thigh, then lower slowly.
Switch legs and keep alternating.

added.name: Ring Pullover
added.namePl: Pullover na kółkach
instructions: Hang from the rings with an overhand grip.
Pull your hips up and bring your knees to your chest.
Rotate backward, pulling the body over the rings.
Lower under control.
Keep the movement smooth.

added.name: Split Squat Heel Raise
added.namePl: Wspięcia na palce w przysiadzie wykrocznym
instructions: Stand in a split stance with one foot well forward.
Lower into a split squat with an upright torso.
Push up through your front foot to stand.
Rise onto the toes of your back foot or both feet.
Lower your heel and repeat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Barbell Lying Seal Row on Rack
added.namePl: Wiosłowanie seal ze sztangą w leżeniu na stojaku
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench so the bar hangs below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Row the bar up toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

added.name: Leverage Single Leg Deadlift on Hack Squat Machine
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg jednonóż na maszynie hack
instructions: Step onto the machine platform and set your back against the pad.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Hinge at the hip and lower with control.
Drive through the standing foot to come back up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

added.name: Smith Staggered Stance Romanian Deadlift
added.namePl: Martwy ciąg rumuński w rozkroku na maszynie smitha
instructions: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
